name: CongruenceTheory.padicValNat_factorial_pow_ge
statement:
theorem padicValNat_factorial_pow_ge (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    ∀ c : ℕ, 1 ≤ c → 2 * c ≤ padicValNat p ((p ^ c)!) + 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Fact.mk hp
  intro c hc
  induction c with
  | zero => omega
  | succ c ih =>
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos c with hc0 | hc0
    · subst hc0
      have h1 : padicValNat p ((p ^ 1)!) = padicValNat p (1 !) + 1 := by
        have := padicValNat_factorial_mul (p := p) 1
        simpa using this
      simp only [pow_one] at h1
      simp [h1]
    · have hstep : padicValNat p ((p ^ (c + 1))!) = padicValNat p ((p ^ c)!) + p ^ c := by
        have := padicValNat_factorial_mul (p := p) (p ^ c)
        rwa [← pow_succ'] at this
      have hpc2 : 2 ≤ p ^ c := by
        calc (2:ℕ) ≤ p ^ 1 := by simpa using hp.two_le
          _ ≤ p ^ c := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hp.one_lt.le hc0
      have := ih hc0
      omega

name: CongruenceTheory.padicValNat_factorial_mono
statement:
theorem padicValNat_factorial_mono (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) :
    padicValNat p (m !) ≤ padicValNat p (n !)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Fact.mk hp
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := factorial_dvd_factorial h
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0; rw [h0, mul_zero] at ht; exact factorial_ne_zero n ht
  rw [ht, padicValNat.mul (factorial_ne_zero m) ht0]
  omega

name: CongruenceTheory.padicValNat_le_padicValNat_pred_factorial_add_one
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Fact.mk hp
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  set c := padicValNat p r with hc
  have hc2 : 2 ≤ c := by omega
  have hpcr : p ^ c ∣ r := pow_padicValNat_dvd
  have hrpc : p ^ c ≤ r := Nat.le_of_dvd hr hpcr
  have hstep2 : padicValNat p ((p ^ c)!) ≤ padicValNat p (r !) :=
    padicValNat_factorial_mono p hp hrpc
  have hstep3 := padicValNat_factorial_pow_ge p hp c (by omega)
  have hsfact : padicValNat p (s !) = padicValNat p s + padicValNat p ((s - 1)!) := by
    have hseq : s ! = s * (s - 1)! := by
      obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, s = t + 1 := ⟨s - 1, by omega⟩
      simp [Nat.factorial_succ]
    rw [hseq, padicValNat.mul (by omega) (factorial_ne_zero _)]
  have hsm1 : padicValNat p ((s - 1)!) ≤ c - 2 := by omega
  have hsu : s - 1 < p ^ (c - 1) := by
    by_contra hge
    push Not at hge
    have hmono := padicValNat_factorial_mono p hp hge
    have hgrow := padicValNat_factorial_pow_ge p hp (c - 1) (by omega)
    omega
  have hsle : s ≤ p ^ (c - 1) := by omega
  have hps : p ^ (padicValNat p s) ∣ s := pow_padicValNat_dvd
  have hps' : p ^ (padicValNat p s) ≤ s := Nat.le_of_dvd hs hps
  have hple : p ^ (padicValNat p s) ≤ p ^ (c - 1) := hps'.trans hsle
  have hvs : padicValNat p s ≤ c - 1 :=
    (Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_right hp.one_lt).mp hple
  omega

name: CongruenceTheory.mixed_support_factorial_le
statement:
theorem mixed_support_factorial_le (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) {n k a b r s : ℕ}
    (hpa : p ^ a ∣ n) (hpb : p ^ b ∣ k) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrn : r ≤ n) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (hsk : s ≤ k)
    (hle : padicValNat p (r !) ≤ padicValNat p (s !)) :
    a + b + min (padicValNat p (r !)) (padicValNat p (s !)) ≤
      padicValNat p (n.descFactorial r) + padicValNat p (k.descFactorial s) + 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Fact.mk hp
  rw [min_eq_left hle]
  have han : a ≤ padicValNat p n := by
    rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn0
    · omega
    · exact (padicValNat_dvd_iff_le hn0).mp hpa
  
  have hchoose_n : n.factorization p ≤ (n.choose r).factorization p + r.factorization p :=
    Nat.factorization_le_factorization_choose_add hrn (by omega)
  rw [Nat.factorization_def n hp, Nat.factorization_def (n.choose r) hp,
    Nat.factorization_def r hp] at hchoose_n
  
  have hdescn : n.descFactorial r = r ! * n.choose r :=
    Nat.descFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose n r
  have hvdescn : padicValNat p (n.descFactorial r) =
      padicValNat p (r !) + padicValNat p (n.choose r) := by
    rw [hdescn, padicValNat.mul (factorial_ne_zero r) (by
      rw [← Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]; exact Nat.choose_pos hrn)]
  
  have hdesck : k.descFactorial s = k * (k - 1).descFactorial (s - 1) := by
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, s = t + 1 := ⟨s - 1, by omega⟩
    simpa using Nat.succ_descFactorial_succ m t
  have hks1 : s - 1 ≤ k - 1 := by omega
  have hvdesck1 : padicValNat p ((k - 1).descFactorial (s - 1)) ≥ padicValNat p ((s - 1)!) := by
    have heq : (k - 1).descFactorial (s - 1) = (s - 1)! * (k - 1).choose (s - 1) :=
      Nat.descFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose (k - 1) (s - 1)
    have hposc : 0 < (k - 1).choose (s - 1) := Nat.choose_pos hks1
    rw [heq, padicValNat.mul (factorial_ne_zero _) (by omega)]
    omega
  have hvdeskpos : k ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hvdesck : padicValNat p (k.descFactorial s) =
      padicValNat p k + padicValNat p ((k - 1).descFactorial (s - 1)) := by
    rw [hdesck, padicValNat.mul hvdeskpos (by
      rw [← Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]; exact Nat.descFactorial_pos.mpr hks1)]
  have hbk : b ≤ padicValNat p k := by
    rcases eq_or_ne k 0 with rfl | hk0
    · omega
    · exact (padicValNat_dvd_iff_le hk0).mp hpb
  have hsub := padicValNat_le_padicValNat_pred_factorial_add_one p hp hr hs hle
  omega

name: CongruenceTheory.mixed_support_factorial
statement:
theorem mixed_support_factorial (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) {n k a b r s : ℕ}
    (hpa : p ^ a ∣ n) (hpb : p ^ b ∣ k) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrn : r ≤ n) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (hsk : s ≤ k) :
    a + b + min (padicValNat p (r !)) (padicValNat p (s !)) ≤
      padicValNat p (n.descFactorial r) + padicValNat p (k.descFactorial s) + 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total (padicValNat p (r !)) (padicValNat p (s !)) with hle | hle
  · exact mixed_support_factorial_le p hp hpa hpb hr hrn hs hsk hle
  · have := mixed_support_factorial_le p hp hpb hpa hs hsk hr hrn hle
    rw [min_comm] at this
    omega

name: CongruenceTheory.fall_eq_descFactorial
statement:
lemma fall_eq_descFactorial (n r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ n) :
    fall n r = (n.descFactorial r : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fall, Nat.descFactorial_eq_prod_range]
  push_cast
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hir : i < r := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
  have hin : i ≤ n := by omega
  omega

name: CongruenceTheory.factorial_eq_fall_mul
statement:
lemma factorial_eq_fall_mul (n r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ n) :
    (Nat.factorial n : ℚ) = (fall n r : ℚ) * (Nat.factorial (n - r) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fall_eq_descFactorial n r hr]
  push_cast
  rw [← Nat.factorial_mul_descFactorial hr]
  push_cast
  ring

name: CongruenceTheory.coeff_recurrence
statement:
lemma coeff_recurrence (F : ℚ⟦X⟧) (hF1 : constantCoeff F = 1) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), canonicalCoord (i + 1) F * coeff (n - i) F =
      coeff (n + 1) F * (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hkey := deriv_logOf_mul_self F hF1
  have hc := congrArg (coeff n) hkey
  rw [coeff_derivative, coeff_mul,
    Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ
      (fun i j => coeff i (d⁄dX ℚ (logOf F)) * coeff j F)] at hc
  rw [← hc]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [coeff_derivative]
  simp only [canonicalCoord]
  push_cast
  ring

name: CongruenceTheory.egfCoeff_recurrence
statement:
theorem egfCoeff_recurrence (F : ℚ⟦X⟧) (hF1 : constantCoeff F = 1) (n : ℕ) :
    egfCoeff F (n + 1) =
      ∑ r ∈ range (n + 1), (fall n r : ℚ) * canonicalCoord (r + 1) F * egfCoeff F (n - r)
proof:
:= by
  have hrec := coeff_recurrence F hF1 n
  have hmul := congrArg (fun x => (Nat.factorial n : ℚ) * x) hrec
  rw [Finset.mul_sum] at hmul
  have hlhs : (Nat.factorial n : ℚ) * (coeff (n + 1) F * (n + 1)) = egfCoeff F (n + 1) := by
    unfold egfCoeff
    rw [Nat.factorial_succ]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hlhs] at hmul
  rw [← hmul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r hr
  have hrn : r ≤ n := by
    have := Finset.mem_range.mp hr
    omega
  have hfe := factorial_eq_fall_mul n r hrn
  unfold egfCoeff
  rw [hfe]
  ring

name: CongruenceTheory.egfCoeff_eq_cVal
statement:
theorem egfCoeff_eq_cVal (F : ℚ⟦X⟧) (hF1 : constantCoeff F = 1) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, egfCoeff F n = cVal (fun j => canonicalCoord j F) n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    match n with
    | 0 =>
      unfold egfCoeff cVal evalAt
      rw [C_zero]
      simp [hF1]
    | m + 1 =>
      rw [egfCoeff_recurrence F hF1 m]
      have hev := congrArg (evalAt (fun j => canonicalCoord j F)) (C_succ m)
      simp only [map_sum, map_mul] at hev
      show _ = evalAt (fun j => canonicalCoord j F) (C (m + 1))
      rw [hev]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r hr
      have hrm : r ≤ m := by
        have := Finset.mem_range.mp hr
        omega
      have hihr : egfCoeff F (m - r) = cVal (fun j => canonicalCoord j F) (m - r) :=
        ih (m - r) (by omega)
      rw [cVal] at hihr
      rw [hihr]
      have hXeval :
          evalAt (fun j => canonicalCoord j F) (MvPolynomial.X (r + 1)) =
            canonicalCoord (r + 1) F := by
        simp [evalAt]
      rw [hXeval]
      have hfeval :
          evalAt (fun j => canonicalCoord j F) ((fall m r : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ)) =
            (fall m r : ℚ) := by
        simp [evalAt]
      rw [hfeval]
      ring

name: CongruenceTheory.general_defect_main
statement:
theorem general_defect_main (F : ℚ⟦X⟧) (hF1 : constantCoeff F = 1) (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    egfCoeff F (n + k) - egfCoeff F n * egfCoeff F k =
      (k : ℚ) * evalAt (fun j => canonicalCoord j F) (Qpoly n k hk)
proof:
:= by
  rw [egfCoeff_eq_cVal F hF1, egfCoeff_eq_cVal F hF1, egfCoeff_eq_cVal F hF1]
  exact base_change_mod (fun j => canonicalCoord j F) n k hk

name: CongruenceTheory.evalAt_intCast
statement:
theorem evalAt_intCast (z : ℕ → ℤ) (P : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) :
    evalAt (fun j => ((z j : ℤ) : ℚ)) P = ((MvPolynomial.eval z P : ℤ) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  induction P using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a => simp [evalAt]
  | add p q hp hq => rw [map_add, map_add, hp, hq]; push_cast; ring
  | mul_X p j hp =>
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, hp]
    simp [evalAt]

name: CongruenceTheory.general_defect_integral
statement:
theorem general_defect_integral (F : ℚ⟦X⟧) (hF1 : constantCoeff F = 1)
    (z : ℕ → ℤ) (hz : ∀ m, canonicalCoord m F = (z m : ℚ)) (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    ∃ w : ℤ, egfCoeff F (n + k) - egfCoeff F n * egfCoeff F k = (k : ℚ) * (w : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨MvPolynomial.eval z (Qpoly n k hk), ?_⟩
  rw [general_defect_main F hF1 n k hk]
  congr 1
  rw [show (fun j => canonicalCoord j F) = (fun j => ((z j : ℤ) : ℚ)) from funext hz]
  exact evalAt_intCast z (Qpoly n k hk)

name: CongruenceTheory.totalDegree_C_le
statement: theorem totalDegree_C_le : ∀ n : ℕ, (C n).totalDegree ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    match n with
    | 0 => rw [C_zero]; simp
    | m + 1 =>
      rw [C_succ]
      apply le_trans (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_finsetSum _ _)
      apply Finset.sup_le
      intro r hr
      have hrm : r ≤ m := by
        have := Finset.mem_range.mp hr; omega
      have hcast : ((fall m r : ℤ) : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) = MvPolynomial.C (fall m r) := by simp
      have step1 :
          (((fall m r : ℤ) : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) *
              (MvPolynomial.X (r + 1) * C (m - r))).totalDegree ≤
            ((fall m r : ℤ) : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ).totalDegree +
              (MvPolynomial.X (r + 1) * C (m - r)).totalDegree :=
        MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul _ _
      have step2 : ((fall m r : ℤ) : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ).totalDegree = 0 := by
        rw [hcast]; exact MvPolynomial.totalDegree_C _
      have step3 :
          (MvPolynomial.X (r + 1) * C (m - r) : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ).totalDegree ≤
            (MvPolynomial.X (r + 1) : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ).totalDegree + (C (m - r)).totalDegree :=
        MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul _ _
      have step4 : (MvPolynomial.X (r + 1) : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ).totalDegree ≤ 1 :=
        (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_X (r + 1)).le
      have step5 : (C (m - r)).totalDegree ≤ m - r := ih (m - r) (by omega)
      omega

name: CongruenceTheory.totalDegree_C_mul_eq
statement:
theorem totalDegree_C_mul_eq {k : ℤ} (hk : k ≠ 0) (Q : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) :
    (MvPolynomial.C k * Q).totalDegree = Q.totalDegree
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MvPolynomial.smul_eq_C_mul]
  unfold MvPolynomial.totalDegree
  rw [MvPolynomial.support_smul_eq hk]

name: CongruenceTheory.totalDegree_Qpoly_le
statement: theorem totalDegree_Qpoly_le (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : (Qpoly n k hk).totalDegree ≤ n + k
proof:
:= by
  have hspec := Qpoly_spec n k hk
  have hkne : (k : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : k ≠ 0)
  have heq : (MvPolynomial.C (k : ℤ) * Qpoly n k hk).totalDegree = (Qpoly n k hk).totalDegree :=
    totalDegree_C_mul_eq hkne (Qpoly n k hk)
  rw [← heq, ← hspec]
  calc (C (n + k) - C n * C k).totalDegree
      ≤ max (C (n + k)).totalDegree (C n * C k).totalDegree := MvPolynomial.totalDegree_sub _ _
    _ ≤ max (n + k) (n + k) := by
        apply max_le_max
        · exact totalDegree_C_le (n + k)
        · exact le_trans (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul _ _) (by
            have := totalDegree_C_le n; have := totalDegree_C_le k; omega)
    _ = n + k := by omega

name: CongruenceTheory.evalAt_totalDegree_denom_clear
statement:
theorem evalAt_totalDegree_denom_clear (Q : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) (N : ℕ) (hQ : Q.totalDegree ≤ N)
    (z : ℕ → ℤ) (D : ℕ) (hD : 0 < D) :
    ∃ w : ℤ, (w : ℚ) = (D : ℚ) ^ N * evalAt (fun j => (z j : ℚ) / (D : ℚ)) Q
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨∑ d ∈ Q.support, Q.coeff d * (D : ℤ) ^ (N - ∑ x ∈ d.support, d x) *
    ∏ i ∈ d.support, (z i) ^ (d i), ?_⟩
  show (_ : ℚ) = (D : ℚ) ^ N *
    MvPolynomial.eval₂ (Int.castRingHom ℚ) (fun j => (z j : ℚ) / (D : ℚ)) Q
  rw [MvPolynomial.eval₂_eq]
  push_cast
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_congr rfl]
  intro d hd
  have hsum_eq : (d.sum fun _ e => e) = ∑ x ∈ d.support, d x := rfl
  have hdle : (∑ x ∈ d.support, d x) ≤ N :=
    hsum_eq ▸ le_trans (MvPolynomial.le_totalDegree hd) hQ
  have hDne : (D : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hD.ne'
  simp only [div_pow]
  rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib, Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
  rw [show (D : ℚ) ^ N = (D : ℚ) ^ (N - ∑ x ∈ d.support, d x) * (D : ℚ) ^ ∑ x ∈ d.support, d x by
    rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega]
  have hprodne : (D : ℚ) ^ (∑ x ∈ d.support, d x) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hDne
  field_simp
  simp only [Int.coe_castRingHom]
  ring

name: CongruenceTheory.general_defect_denom_clear
statement:
theorem general_defect_denom_clear (F : ℚ⟦X⟧) (hF1 : constantCoeff F = 1)
    (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (D : ℕ) (hD : 0 < D) (z : ℕ → ℤ)
    (hz : ∀ m, canonicalCoord m F = (z m : ℚ) / (D : ℚ)) :
    ∃ w : ℤ, (D : ℚ) ^ (n + k) * (egfCoeff F (n + k) - egfCoeff F n * egfCoeff F k) =
      (k : ℚ) * (w : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ :=
    evalAt_totalDegree_denom_clear (Qpoly n k hk) (n + k) (totalDegree_Qpoly_le n k hk) z D hD
  refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
  rw [general_defect_main F hF1 n k hk,
    show (fun j => canonicalCoord j F) = (fun j => (z j : ℚ) / (D : ℚ)) from funext hz]
  linear_combination -(k : ℚ) * hw

name: CongruenceTheory.coeff_counterF
statement:
theorem coeff_counterF (n : ℕ) :
    coeff n counterF = if n = 0 then 1 else if n = 2 then (1 / 2 : ℚ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [counterF, coeff_mk]

name: CongruenceTheory.egfCoeff_counterF_0
statement: theorem egfCoeff_counterF_0 : egfCoeff counterF 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold egfCoeff; rw [coeff_counterF]; simp

name: CongruenceTheory.egfCoeff_counterF_2
statement: theorem egfCoeff_counterF_2 : egfCoeff counterF 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold egfCoeff; rw [coeff_counterF]; norm_num

name: CongruenceTheory.egfCoeff_counterF_4
statement: theorem egfCoeff_counterF_4 : egfCoeff counterF 4 = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold egfCoeff; rw [coeff_counterF]; norm_num

name: CongruenceTheory.no_universal_shift_law_for_all_integral_egf
statement:
theorem no_universal_shift_law_for_all_integral_egf :
    egfCoeff counterF 0 = 1 ∧ egfCoeff counterF 2 = 1 ∧ egfCoeff counterF 4 = 0 ∧
      egfCoeff counterF 4 - egfCoeff counterF 2 * egfCoeff counterF 2 = -1 ∧
      ¬ ((2 : ℤ) ∣ (-1 : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨egfCoeff_counterF_0, egfCoeff_counterF_2, egfCoeff_counterF_4, ?_, by decide⟩
  rw [egfCoeff_counterF_2, egfCoeff_counterF_4]
  ring

name: CongruenceTheory.sum_divisors_mul_prime_pow_reindex
statement:
theorem sum_divisors_mul_prime_pow_reindex (m p r : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hpm : ¬ p ∣ m)
    (f : ℕ → ℤ) :
    ∑ d ∈ (m * p ^ r).divisors, f d =
      ∑ e ∈ m.divisors, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), f (e * p ^ i)
proof:
:= by
  have hcop : m.Coprime (p ^ r) :=
    Nat.Coprime.pow_right r ((hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr hpm).symm)
  rw [hcop.divisors_mul, Finset.sum_map]
  simp only [Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk]
  trans (∑ x ∈ m.divisors ×ˢ (p ^ r).divisors, f (x.1 * x.2))
  · exact Finset.sum_attach (m.divisors ×ˢ (p ^ r).divisors) (fun x => f (x.1 * x.2))
  trans (∑ e ∈ m.divisors, ∑ q ∈ (p ^ r).divisors, f (e * q))
  · exact Finset.sum_product' m.divisors (p ^ r).divisors (fun a b => f (a * b))
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro e _
  rw [Nat.divisors_prime_pow hp, Finset.sum_map]
  rfl

name: CongruenceTheory.div_calc
statement:
lemma div_calc (e c p r i : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hene0 : e ≠ 0) (hi : i ≤ r) :
    e * c * p ^ r / (e * p ^ i) = c * p ^ (r - i)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : e * c * p ^ r = (e * p ^ i) * (c * p ^ (r - i)) := by
    rw [show e * p ^ i * (c * p ^ (r - i)) = e * (c * (p ^ i * p ^ (r - i))) from by ring]
    rw [← pow_add, show i + (r - i) = r from by omega]
    ring
  rw [heq]
  exact Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hene0) (pow_pos hp.pos i))

name: CongruenceTheory.key_identity
statement:
theorem key_identity (m p r : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hpm : ¬ p ∣ m) (hm : m ≠ 0) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (w : ℕ → ℤ) :
    ∑ d ∈ (m * p ^ r).divisors, (μ (m * p ^ r / d) : ℤ) * w d =
      ∑ e ∈ m.divisors,
        ((μ (m / e) : ℤ) * w (e * p ^ r) - (μ (m / e) : ℤ) * w (e * p ^ (r - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_divisors_mul_prime_pow_reindex m p r hp hpm (fun d => (μ (m * p ^ r / d) : ℤ) * w d)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro e he
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Nat.mem_divisors.mp he).1
  have hene0 : e ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hc; exact hm hc
  have hce : m / e = c := by rw [hc, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hene0)]
  have hdiv : ∀ i ≤ r, m * p ^ r / (e * p ^ i) = c * p ^ (r - i) := by
    intro i hi
    rw [hc]; exact div_calc e c p r i hp hene0 hi
  have hcopce : c.Coprime p := by
    apply (hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr ?_).symm
    intro hpc
    apply hpm
    rw [hc]
    exact Dvd.dvd.mul_left hpc e
  have hmul : ∀ i ≤ r, (μ (m * p ^ r / (e * p ^ i)) : ℤ) =
      (μ c : ℤ) * (μ (p ^ (r - i)) : ℤ) := by
    intro i hi
    rw [hdiv i hi]
    have := isMultiplicative_moebius.map_mul_of_coprime (hcopce.pow_right (r - i))
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hexpand : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), (μ (m * p ^ r / (e * p ^ i)) : ℤ) * w (e * p ^ i) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), (μ c : ℤ) * (μ (p ^ (r - i)) : ℤ) * w (e * p ^ i) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [hmul i (by simpa using Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)), mul_assoc]
  rw [hexpand, hce]
  rw [show ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), (μ c : ℤ) * (μ (p ^ (r - i)) : ℤ) * w (e * p ^ i) =
      ∑ i ∈ ({r - 1, r} : Finset ℕ), (μ c : ℤ) * (μ (p ^ (r - i)) : ℤ) * w (e * p ^ i) from by
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_subset
    · intro x hx
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
      rw [Finset.mem_range]; omega
    · intro x hx hxnot
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, not_or] at hxnot
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at hx
      have hz : (μ (p ^ (r - x)) : ℤ) = 0 := by
        have hpp := moebius_apply_prime_pow hp (show r - x ≠ 0 by omega)
        rw [if_neg (by omega)] at hpp
        exact_mod_cast hpp
      rw [hz]; ring]
  rw [Finset.sum_pair (by omega : r - 1 ≠ r)]
  have h1 : (μ (p ^ (r - r)) : ℤ) = 1 := by simp
  have h2 : (μ (p ^ (r - (r - 1))) : ℤ) = -1 := by
    rw [show r - (r - 1) = 1 by omega, pow_one]
    exact_mod_cast moebius_apply_prime hp
  rw [h1, h2]
  ring

name: CongruenceTheory.moebius_inversion
statement:
theorem moebius_inversion (w : ℕ → ℤ) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    w m = ∑ d ∈ m.divisors, MTrans w d
proof:
:= by
  have hiff := @sum_eq_iff_sum_smul_moebius_eq ℤ _ (MTrans w) w
  have hrhs : ∀ n > 0, ∑ x ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, (μ x.1 : ℤ) • w x.2 = MTrans w n := by
    intro n _
    rw [Nat.sum_divisorsAntidiagonal' (f := fun a b => (μ a : ℤ) • w b)]
    simp only [MTrans, smul_eq_mul]
  exact ((hiff.mpr hrhs) m hm).symm

name: CongruenceTheory.gauss_of_dvd_forall
statement:
theorem gauss_of_dvd_forall (w : ℕ → ℤ) (hyp : ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N → (N : ℤ) ∣ MTrans w N)
    (p m r : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hpm : ¬ p ∣ m) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hr : 1 ≤ r) :
    (p : ℤ) ^ r ∣ (w (m * p ^ r) - w (m * p ^ (r - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  have hinv := moebius_inversion (fun e => w (e * p ^ r) - w (e * p ^ (r - 1))) m (by omega)
  have hG : ∀ d ∈ m.divisors, (p : ℤ) ^ r ∣
      MTrans (fun e => w (e * p ^ r) - w (e * p ^ (r - 1))) d := by
    intro d hd
    have hdm : d ∣ m := (Nat.mem_divisors.mp hd).1
    have hd0 : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hd
    have hpd : ¬ p ∣ d := fun h => hpm (h.trans hdm)
    have hkeyd := key_identity d p r hp hpd (by omega) hr w
    have hMTeq : MTrans w (d * p ^ r) =
        MTrans (fun e => w (e * p ^ r) - w (e * p ^ (r - 1))) d := by
      rw [MTrans, MTrans, hkeyd]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun e _ => (mul_sub (μ (d / e) : ℤ) (w (e * p ^ r))
        (w (e * p ^ (r - 1)))).symm)
    have hdvd : ((d * p ^ r : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ MTrans w (d * p ^ r) :=
      hyp (d * p ^ r) (Nat.mul_pos hd0 (pow_pos hp.pos r))
    have hdvd2 : (p : ℤ) ^ r ∣ MTrans w (d * p ^ r) := by
      refine dvd_trans ?_ hdvd
      push_cast
      exact Dvd.intro_left (d : ℤ) rfl
    rwa [hMTeq] at hdvd2
  have hdvdsum : (p : ℤ) ^ r ∣ ∑ d ∈ m.divisors,
      MTrans (fun e => w (e * p ^ r) - w (e * p ^ (r - 1))) d := Finset.dvd_sum hG
  rw [← hinv] at hdvdsum
  exact hdvdsum

name: CongruenceTheory.dvd_forall_of_gauss
statement:
theorem dvd_forall_of_gauss (w : ℕ → ℤ)
    (hgauss : ∀ p r m : ℕ, p.Prime → 1 ≤ r → ¬ p ∣ m →
      (p : ℤ) ^ r ∣ (w (m * p ^ r) - w (m * p ^ (r - 1))))
    (N : ℕ) (hN : N ≠ 0) : (N : ℤ) ∣ MTrans w N
proof:
:= by
  rw [Int.ofNat_dvd_left, Nat.dvd_iff_prime_pow_dvd_dvd]
  intro p k hp hpk
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk0 | hkpos
  · subst hk0; simp
  · set r := N.factorization p with hr_def
    have hrk : k ≤ r := by
      rw [hr_def]
      exact (Nat.Prime.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hp hN).mp hpk
    have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := by omega
    set m := N / p ^ r with hm_def
    have hNe : N = m * p ^ r := by
      rw [hm_def, Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.ordProj_dvd N p)]
    have hpm : ¬ p ∣ m := not_dvd_ordCompl hp hN
    have hm1 : m ≠ 0 := by
      intro hm0
      rw [hm0, zero_mul] at hNe
      exact hN hNe
    have hkey := key_identity m p r hp hpm hm1 hr1 w
    have hprM : (p : ℤ) ^ r ∣ MTrans w N := by
      rw [MTrans, hNe, hkey]
      apply Finset.dvd_sum
      intro e he
      have hem : e ∣ m := (Nat.mem_divisors.mp he).1
      have hpe : ¬ p ∣ e := fun h => hpm (h.trans hem)
      have hdvd := hgauss p r e hp hr1 hpe
      have heq : (μ (m / e) : ℤ) * w (e * p ^ r) - (μ (m / e) : ℤ) * w (e * p ^ (r - 1)) =
          (μ (m / e) : ℤ) * (w (e * p ^ r) - w (e * p ^ (r - 1))) := by ring
      rw [heq]
      exact Dvd.dvd.mul_left hdvd _
    have hfinal : (p : ℤ) ^ k ∣ MTrans w N := (pow_dvd_pow (p : ℤ) hrk).trans hprM
    rwa [← Int.ofNat_dvd_left, Nat.cast_pow]

name: CongruenceTheory.gauss_iff
statement:
theorem gauss_iff (w : ℕ → ℤ) :
    (∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N → (N : ℤ) ∣ MTrans w N) ↔
      (∀ p r m : ℕ, p.Prime → 1 ≤ r → 1 ≤ m → ¬ p ∣ m →
        (p : ℤ) ^ r ∣ (w (m * p ^ r) - w (m * p ^ (r - 1))))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hyp p r m hp hr hm hpm
    exact gauss_of_dvd_forall w hyp p m r hp hpm hm hr
  · intro hgauss N hN
    exact dvd_forall_of_gauss w (fun p r m hp hr hpm => hgauss p r m hp hr (by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with hm0 | hm0
      · subst hm0; simp at hpm
      · omega) hpm) N hN.ne'

name: CongruenceTheory.Cmod_zero
statement: lemma Cmod_zero (k : ℕ) : Cmod k 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [Cmod, C_zero]

name: CongruenceTheory.Cmod_succ
statement:
lemma Cmod_succ (k n : ℕ) :
    Cmod k (n + 1) =
      ∑ r ∈ range (n + 1),
        ((fall n r : ℤ) : MvPolynomial ℕ (ZMod k)) * (MvPolynomial.X (r + 1) * Cmod k (n - r))
proof:
:= by
  simp [Cmod, C_succ, map_sum]

name: CongruenceTheory.fall_mod_eq
statement:
lemma fall_mod_eq (k n r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ n) :
    ((fall (n + k) r : ℤ) : MvPolynomial ℕ (ZMod k)) = ((fall n r : ℤ) : MvPolynomial ℕ (ZMod k))
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((fall (n + k) r : ℤ) : ZMod k) = ((fall n r : ℤ) : ZMod k) := by
    simp only [fall, Int.cast_prod]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro i _
    push_cast
    rw [ZMod.natCast_self]
    ring
  have hC := congrArg (MvPolynomial.C (σ := ℕ) (R := ZMod k)) h
  simpa [map_intCast] using hC

name: CongruenceTheory.fall_dvd_of_lt
statement: lemma fall_dvd_of_lt (n r k : ℕ) (h : n < r) : (k : ℤ) ∣ fall (n + k) r
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : n ∈ range r := Finset.mem_range.mpr h
  have hterm : (fun i : ℕ => ((n + k : ℕ) : ℤ) - (i : ℤ)) n = (k : ℤ) := by
    show ((n + k : ℕ) : ℤ) - (n : ℤ) = (k : ℤ)
    push_cast; ring
  have hdvd : (fun i : ℕ => ((n + k : ℕ) : ℤ) - (i : ℤ)) n ∣ fall (n + k) r := by
    rw [fall]
    exact Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem (fun i : ℕ => ((n + k : ℕ) : ℤ) - (i : ℤ)) hmem
  rwa [hterm] at hdvd

name: CongruenceTheory.universal_shift_mod
statement:
theorem universal_shift_mod (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, Cmod k (n + k) = Cmod k k * Cmod k n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    match n with
    | 0 => simp [Cmod_zero]
    | m + 1 =>
      have hsplit : range (m + k + 1) = range (m + 1) ∪ Ico (m + 1) (m + k + 1) := by
        rw [range_eq_Ico, range_eq_Ico, Finset.Ico_union_Ico_eq_Ico] <;> omega
      have hdisj : Disjoint (range (m + 1)) (Ico (m + 1) (m + k + 1)) := by
        rw [range_eq_Ico]
        exact Finset.Ico_disjoint_Ico_consecutive 0 (m + 1) (m + k + 1)
      have hgoal : m + 1 + k = (m + k) + 1 := by omega
      rw [hgoal, Cmod_succ]
      rw [hsplit, Finset.sum_union hdisj]
      have hzero :
          ∑ r ∈ Ico (m + 1) (m + k + 1),
            ((fall (m + k) r : ℤ) : MvPolynomial ℕ (ZMod k)) *
              (MvPolynomial.X (r + 1) * Cmod k (m + k - r)) = 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro r hr
        obtain ⟨hr1, _⟩ := Finset.mem_Ico.mp hr
        have hdvd : (k : ℤ) ∣ fall (m + k) r := fall_dvd_of_lt m r k (by omega)
        have hzmod : ((fall (m + k) r : ℤ) : ZMod k) = 0 := by
          rwa [ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
        have hcast : ((fall (m + k) r : ℤ) : MvPolynomial ℕ (ZMod k)) = 0 := by
          have hC := congrArg (MvPolynomial.C (σ := ℕ) (R := ZMod k)) hzmod
          simpa [map_intCast] using hC
        rw [hcast]
        ring
      rw [hzero, add_zero]
      have hmain :
          ∑ r ∈ range (m + 1),
            ((fall (m + k) r : ℤ) : MvPolynomial ℕ (ZMod k)) *
              (MvPolynomial.X (r + 1) * Cmod k (m + k - r)) =
          Cmod k k * Cmod k (m + 1) := by
        rw [Cmod_succ, Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro r hr
        have hrm : r ≤ m := by
          have := Finset.mem_range.mp hr
          omega
        have hfall : ((fall (m + k) r : ℤ) : MvPolynomial ℕ (ZMod k)) =
            ((fall m r : ℤ) : MvPolynomial ℕ (ZMod k)) :=
          fall_mod_eq k m r hrm
        have hsub : m + k - r = (m - r) + k := by omega
        have hih : Cmod k ((m - r) + k) = Cmod k k * Cmod k (m - r) :=
          ih (m - r) (by omega)
        rw [hfall, hsub, hih]
        ring
      rw [hmain]

name: CongruenceTheory.dvdCoeffs_of_map_eq_zero
statement:
lemma dvdCoeffs_of_map_eq_zero {k : ℕ} {P : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ}
    (h : MvPolynomial.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod k)) P = 0) : DvdCoeffs k P
proof:
:= by
  intro d
  have hc := congrArg (MvPolynomial.coeff d) h
  rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_map, MvPolynomial.coeff_zero] at hc
  rw [show (Int.castRingHom (ZMod k)) (MvPolynomial.coeff d P) =
      ((MvPolynomial.coeff d P : ℤ) : ZMod k) from rfl] at hc
  rwa [ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hc

name: CongruenceTheory.dvdCoeffs_of_Cmod_eq
statement:
lemma dvdCoeffs_of_Cmod_eq {k n n' : ℕ} (h : Cmod k n = Cmod k n') :
    DvdCoeffs k (C n - C n')
proof:
:=
  dvdCoeffs_of_map_eq_zero (by rw [map_sub]; exact sub_eq_zero.mpr h)

name: CongruenceTheory.universal_shift_lcm
statement:
theorem universal_shift_lcm (n k : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    DvdCoeffs (Nat.lcm n k) (C (n + k) - C n * C k)
proof:
:= by
  have hmodk : DvdCoeffs k (C (n + k) - C k * C n) :=
    dvdCoeffs_of_map_eq_zero (by
      rw [map_sub, map_mul]; exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (universal_shift_mod k hk n))
  have hmodn : DvdCoeffs n (C (k + n) - C n * C k) :=
    dvdCoeffs_of_map_eq_zero (by
      rw [map_sub, map_mul]; exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (universal_shift_mod n hn k))
  have e1 : C (n + k) - C k * C n = C (n + k) - C n * C k := by ring
  have e2 : C (k + n) - C n * C k = C (n + k) - C n * C k := by rw [show k + n = n + k by omega]
  rw [e1] at hmodk
  rw [e2] at hmodn
  intro d
  have hk' : (k : ℤ) ∣ MvPolynomial.coeff d (C (n + k) - C n * C k) := hmodk d
  have hn' : (n : ℤ) ∣ MvPolynomial.coeff d (C (n + k) - C n * C k) := hmodn d
  set x := MvPolynomial.coeff d (C (n + k) - C n * C k) with hx
  have hkabs : k ∣ x.natAbs := by
    have := Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs.mpr hk'
    simpa using this
  have hnabs : n ∣ x.natAbs := by
    have := Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs.mpr hn'
    simpa using this
  have hlcm : Nat.lcm n k ∣ x.natAbs := Nat.lcm_dvd hnabs hkabs
  have hcast : ((Nat.lcm n k : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ (x.natAbs : ℤ) := Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr hlcm
  exact Int.dvd_natAbs.mp hcast

name: CongruenceTheory.not_dvd_factorial_of_lt
statement: theorem not_dvd_factorial_of_lt (p n : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (h : n < p) : ¬ p ∣ n !
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [hp.one_lt.ne']
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Nat.factorial_succ]
    intro hdvd
    rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hp).mp hdvd with h1 | h2
    · have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) h1; omega
    · exact ih (by omega) h2

name: CongruenceTheory.replicate_count_le
statement: theorem replicate_count_le (m : Multiset ℕ) (n : ℕ) : Multiset.replicate (m.count n) n ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [Multiset.le_iff_count]
  intro a
  rw [Multiset.count_replicate]
  by_cases h : a = n
  · subst h; simp
  · rw [if_neg (Ne.symm h)]; exact Nat.zero_le _

name: CongruenceTheory.multiset_sum_le_of_le
statement: theorem multiset_sum_le_of_le (m1 m2 : Multiset ℕ) (h : m1 ≤ m2) : m1.sum ≤ m2.sum
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Multiset.le_iff_exists_add.mp h
  simp [Multiset.sum_add]

name: CongruenceTheory.not_dvd_centralizer_size
statement:
theorem not_dvd_centralizer_size (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin p)) (hg1 : g ≠ 1)
    (hgp : g.cycleType ≠ {p}) :
    ¬ p ∣ ((p - g.cycleType.sum)! * g.cycleType.prod *
      (∏ n ∈ g.cycleType.toFinset, (g.cycleType.count n)!))
proof:
:= by
  have hppos : 0 < p := hp.pos
  have hne : g.cycleType ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hg1 (Equiv.Perm.cycleType_eq_zero.mp h0)
  have hsum_le : g.cycleType.sum ≤ p := by
    have := Equiv.Perm.sum_cycleType_le g; simpa using this
  have hallt : ∀ x ∈ g.cycleType, 2 ≤ x ∧ x < p := by
    intro x hx
    have h2 := Equiv.Perm.two_le_of_mem_cycleType hx
    have hxle : x ≤ g.cycleType.sum := Multiset.single_le_sum (fun y _ => Nat.zero_le y) x hx
    refine ⟨h2, ?_⟩
    by_contra hge
    push Not at hge
    have hxp : x = p := le_antisymm (hxle.trans hsum_le) hge
    apply hgp
    have hcons : g.cycleType = x ::ₘ g.cycleType.erase x := (Multiset.cons_erase hx).symm
    have herasesum : (g.cycleType.erase x).sum = 0 := by
      have hsum_eq : g.cycleType.sum = x + (g.cycleType.erase x).sum := by
        conv_lhs => rw [hcons]
        rw [Multiset.sum_cons]
      omega
    have herase0 : g.cycleType.erase x = 0 := by
      by_contra hne0
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Multiset.exists_mem_of_ne_zero hne0
      have := Multiset.single_le_sum (fun z _ => Nat.zero_le z) y hy
      have hy2 : 2 ≤ y := Equiv.Perm.two_le_of_mem_cycleType (Multiset.mem_of_mem_erase hy)
      omega
    rw [hcons, herase0, hxp]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨x0, hx0⟩ := Multiset.exists_mem_of_ne_zero hne
  have hS2 : 2 ≤ g.cycleType.sum :=
    le_trans (hallt x0 hx0).1 (Multiset.single_le_sum (fun y _ => Nat.zero_le y) x0 hx0)
  have hlt1 : p - g.cycleType.sum < p := by omega
  have h1 : ¬ p ∣ (p - g.cycleType.sum)! := not_dvd_factorial_of_lt p (p - g.cycleType.sum) hp hlt1
  have h2 : ¬ p ∣ g.cycleType.prod := by
    intro hdvd
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxdvd⟩ := (Nat.Prime.prime hp).exists_mem_multiset_dvd hdvd
    have hx2 := (hallt x hx).1
    have hxp := (hallt x hx).2
    have hxle := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega : 0 < x) hxdvd
    omega
  have h3 : ¬ p ∣ ∏ n ∈ g.cycleType.toFinset, (g.cycleType.count n)! := by
    intro hdvd
    obtain ⟨n, hnmem, hndvd⟩ := (Nat.Prime.prime hp).exists_mem_finset_dvd hdvd
    have hn2 : 2 ≤ n := Equiv.Perm.two_le_of_mem_cycleType (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp hnmem)
    have hcnt_le : g.cycleType.count n * n ≤ g.cycleType.sum := by
      have hle := replicate_count_le g.cycleType n
      have hsm := multiset_sum_le_of_le _ _ hle
      rwa [Multiset.sum_replicate, smul_eq_mul] at hsm
    have hcnt_lt : g.cycleType.count n < p := by nlinarith
    exact not_dvd_factorial_of_lt p (g.cycleType.count n) hp hcnt_lt hndvd
  intro hdvd
  rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hp).mp hdvd with hdvd12 | hdvd3
  · rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hp).mp hdvd12 with hd1 | hd2
    · exact h1 hd1
    · exact h2 hd2
  · exact h3 hdvd3

name: CongruenceTheory.prime_dvd_isConj_card
proof:
:= by
  have heq := Equiv.Perm.card_isConj_mul_eq g
  have hz := not_dvd_centralizer_size p hp g hg1 hgp
  have hpdvd : p ∣ Nat.card {h : Equiv.Perm (Fin p) | IsConj g h} *
      ((Fintype.card (Fin p) - g.cycleType.sum)! * g.cycleType.prod *
        (∏ n ∈ g.cycleType.toFinset, (g.cycleType.count n)!)) := by
    rw [heq, Fintype.card_fin]
    exact Nat.dvd_factorial hp.pos (le_refl p)
  rw [Fintype.card_fin] at hpdvd
  rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hp).mp hpdvd with h1 | h2
  · exact h1
  · exact absurd h2 hz

name: CongruenceTheory.Cperm_prime_decomp
statement:
theorem Cperm_prime_decomp (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    ∃ Q : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ,
      Cperm p = (MvPolynomial.X 1 : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) ^ p +
        ((p - 1)! : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) * MvPolynomial.X p + (p : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) * Q
proof:
:= by
  set s := Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Equiv.Perm (Fin p) => g ≠ 1 ∧ g.cycleType ≠ {p}) with hs
  have key : ∀ x ∈ s, (p : ℤ) ∣ ((s.filter (IsConj x)).card : ℤ) := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [hs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hx
    have hclass_eq : s.filter (IsConj x) = Finset.univ.filter (IsConj x) := by
      ext y
      simp only [hs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      constructor
      · exact fun h => h.2
      · intro hy
        refine ⟨?_, hy⟩
        obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := isConj_iff.mp hy
        constructor
        · intro hy1
          apply hx.1
          have hxeq : x = c⁻¹ * y * c := by rw [← hc]; group
          rw [hy1] at hxeq
          simpa using hxeq
        · intro hycyc
          apply hx.2
          have hcyc_eq : y.cycleType = x.cycleType := by rw [← hc, Equiv.Perm.cycleType_conj]
          rw [hcyc_eq] at hycyc
          exact hycyc
    rw [hclass_eq]
    have hcardeq : Nat.card {h : Equiv.Perm (Fin p) | IsConj x h} =
        (Finset.univ.filter (IsConj x)).card := by
      rw [Nat.card_eq_card_toFinset]
      congr 1
      ext y
      simp
    have hpf := prime_dvd_isConj_card p hp x hx.1 hx.2
    rw [hcardeq] at hpf
    exact_mod_cast hpf
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := dvd_sum_of_const_on_classes IsConj
    (fun x => IsConj.refl x) (fun x y h => h.symm) (fun x y z h1 h2 => h1.trans h2)
    ci (fun x y hxy => by obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := isConj_iff.mp hxy; rw [← hc, ci_conj])
    p s key
  refine ⟨Q, ?_⟩
  have hsplit : (Cperm p : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) =
      ci (1 : Equiv.Perm (Fin p)) +
        ∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Equiv.Perm (Fin p) => g.cycleType = ({p} : Multiset ℕ)),
          ci g + ∑ g ∈ s, ci g := by
    rw [Cperm]
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Finset.univ (· = (1 : Equiv.Perm (Fin p)))]
    rw [show (Finset.univ.filter (· = (1 : Equiv.Perm (Fin p)))) = {1} from by ext g; simp]
    rw [Finset.sum_singleton]
    rw [show (Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Equiv.Perm (Fin p) => ¬ g = 1)) =
        (Finset.univ.filter
          (fun g : Equiv.Perm (Fin p) => g.cycleType = ({p} : Multiset ℕ))) ∪ s
        from by
      ext g
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_union, hs]
      constructor
      · intro hg1
        by_cases hgp : g.cycleType = {p}
        · exact Or.inl hgp
        · exact Or.inr ⟨hg1, hgp⟩
      · rintro (h | h)
        · intro hcontra
          rw [hcontra] at h
          simp at h
        · exact h.1]
    rw [Finset.sum_union]
    · ring
    · rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
      intro g hg1 hg2
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, hs] at hg1 hg2
      exact hg2.2 hg1
  rw [hsplit, hQ]
  have hci1 : ci (1 : Equiv.Perm (Fin p)) = (MvPolynomial.X 1 : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) ^ p := by
    simp [ci, Equiv.Perm.cycleType_one]
  have hcip : ∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Equiv.Perm (Fin p) => g.cycleType = ({p} :
      Multiset ℕ)), ci g = ((p - 1)! : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) * MvPolynomial.X p := by
    have hciform : ∀ g : Equiv.Perm (Fin p), g.cycleType = ({p} : Multiset ℕ) →
        ci g = MvPolynomial.X p := by
      intro g hg
      simp only [ci, hg, Fintype.card_fin, Multiset.sum_singleton, Multiset.map_singleton,
        Multiset.prod_singleton]
      have : p - p = 0 := by omega
      rw [this, pow_zero, one_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun g hg => hciform g (Finset.mem_filter.mp hg).2)]
    rw [Finset.sum_const]
    have hcard := card_singleCycle_eq_choose_mul (α := Fin p) p hp.two_le
    rw [Fintype.card_fin, Nat.choose_self, one_mul] at hcard
    rw [hcard]
    ring
  rw [hci1, hcip]

name: CongruenceTheory.AwPerm_prime_cong
statement:
theorem AwPerm_prime_cong (w : ℕ → ℤ) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    (p : ℤ) ∣ (AwPerm w p - (w 1 - w p))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Fact.mk hp
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := Cperm_prime_decomp p hp
  have hAw : AwPerm w p = w 1 ^ p + ((p - 1)! : ℤ) * w p + (p : ℤ) * MvPolynomial.eval w Q := by
    rw [AwPerm, hQ]
    simp only [map_add, map_mul, map_pow, MvPolynomial.eval_X, map_natCast]
  rw [hAw]
  have hfermat : (p : ℤ) ∣ (w 1 ^ p - w 1) := by
    have := ZMod.pow_card (w 1 : ZMod p)
    have hcast : ((w 1 ^ p - w 1 : ℤ) : ZMod p) = 0 := by
      push_cast
      rw [this]
      ring
    exact_mod_cast (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd _ _).mp hcast
  have hwilson : (p : ℤ) ∣ (((p - 1)! : ℤ) + 1) := by
    have hw := ZMod.wilsons_lemma p
    have hcast : (((p - 1)! + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := by
      push_cast
      rw [hw]
      ring
    have h2 : p ∣ ((p - 1)! + 1) := (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff _ _).mp hcast
    exact_mod_cast h2
  have key : w 1 ^ p + ((p - 1)! : ℤ) * w p + (p : ℤ) * MvPolynomial.eval w Q - (w 1 - w p) =
      (w 1 ^ p - w 1) + (((p - 1)! : ℤ) + 1) * w p + (p : ℤ) * MvPolynomial.eval w Q := by
    ring
  rw [key]
  exact dvd_add (dvd_add hfermat (Dvd.dvd.mul_right hwilson (w p)))
    (Dvd.intro (MvPolynomial.eval w Q) rfl)

name: CongruenceTheory.Aw_succ
statement:
lemma Aw_succ (w : ℕ → ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    Aw w (n + 1) = ∑ r ∈ range (n + 1), fall n r * (w (r + 1) * Aw w (n - r))
proof:
:= by
  unfold Aw
  rw [C_succ, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => ?_
  simp [map_mul, map_intCast]

name: CongruenceTheory.Aw_zero
statement: lemma Aw_zero (w : ℕ → ℤ) : Aw w 0 = 1
proof: := by simp [Aw, C_zero]

name: CongruenceTheory.Aw_one
statement: lemma Aw_one (w : ℕ → ℤ) : Aw w 1 = w 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Aw_succ]; simp [fall, Aw_zero]

name: CongruenceTheory.Aw_two
statement: lemma Aw_two (w : ℕ → ℤ) : Aw w 2 = w 1 ^ 2 + w 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Aw_succ]
  simp [Finset.sum_range_succ, fall, Aw_one, Aw_zero]
  ring

name: CongruenceTheory.Aw_three
statement: lemma Aw_three (w : ℕ → ℤ) : Aw w 3 = w 1 ^ 3 + 3 * w 1 * w 2 + 2 * w 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [Aw_succ]
  simp [Finset.sum_range_succ, fall, Aw_one, Aw_two, Aw_zero]
  ring

name: CongruenceTheory.Aw_four
statement:
lemma Aw_four (w : ℕ → ℤ) :
    Aw w 4 = w 1 ^ 4 + 6 * w 1 ^ 2 * w 2 + 3 * w 2 ^ 2 + 8 * w 1 * w 3 + 6 * w 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [Aw_succ]
  simp [Finset.sum_range_succ, fall, Aw_one, Aw_two, Aw_three, Aw_zero]
  ring

name: CongruenceTheory.Aw_eq_AwPerm
statement: lemma Aw_eq_AwPerm (w : ℕ → ℤ) (n : ℕ) : Aw w n = AwPerm w n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Aw, AwPerm, Cperm_eq_C]

name: CongruenceTheory.Aw_two_mul_eq_AwPermSum
statement: lemma Aw_two_mul_eq_AwPermSum (w : ℕ → ℤ) (n : ℕ) : Aw w (n + n) = AwPermSum w n
proof:
:= by
  have h : Fintype.card (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) = n + n := by simp
  rw [Aw_eq_AwPerm, AwPerm, AwPermSum, CpermSum, Cperm_eq_sum_of_card_eq h]

name: CongruenceTheory.Aw_two_adic
statement:
theorem Aw_two_adic (w : ℕ → ℤ) (s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) :
    (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 * s - 1) ∣ Aw w (2 ^ (s + 1)) - Aw w (2 ^ s) * Aw w (2 ^ s)
proof:
:= by
  have h := AwPerm_two_adic_dynamics s hs w
  rw [Aw_eq_AwPerm w (2 ^ s)]
  have e : Aw w (2 ^ (s + 1)) = AwPermSum w (2 ^ s) := by
    rw [← Aw_two_mul_eq_AwPermSum]; congr 1; ring
  rw [e]; exact h

name: CongruenceTheory.sq_congr_two
statement:
lemma sq_congr_two {x y : ℤ} {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (h : (2 : ℤ) ^ r ∣ x - y) :
    (2 : ℤ) ^ (r + 1) ∣ x ^ 2 - y ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h
  have h2 : (2 : ℤ) ∣ x - y := by
    refine ⟨2 ^ (r - 1) * k, ?_⟩
    rw [hk]
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, r = m + 1 := ⟨r - 1, by omega⟩
    simp [pow_succ]; ring
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := h2
  have hsum : x + y = 2 * (y + j) := by linarith
  refine ⟨k * (y + j), ?_⟩
  have : x ^ 2 - y ^ 2 = (x - y) * (x + y) := by ring
  rw [this, hk, hsum, pow_succ]; ring

name: CongruenceTheory.dvd_of_zmod_zero
statement:
lemma dvd_of_zmod_zero {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {x : ℤ} (h : ((x : ℤ) : ZMod n) = 0) :
    (n : ℤ) ∣ x
proof: := (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd x n).mp h

name: CongruenceTheory.aux_r1
statement: lemma aux_r1 (a b : ℤ) : (2 : ℤ) ∣ (a ^ 2 + b) - (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  have : (((a ^ 2 + b) - (a + b) : ℤ) : ZMod 2) = 0 := by
    push_cast
    generalize (a : ZMod 2) = x
    generalize (b : ZMod 2) = y
    revert x y; decide
  exact_mod_cast dvd_of_zmod_zero this

name: CongruenceTheory.aux_r2
proof:
:= by
  have : ((((a ^ 4 + 6 * a ^ 2 * b + 3 * b ^ 2 + 8 * a * c + 6 * d)
      - ((a + b) ^ 2 + 2 * (b + d)) : ℤ)) : ZMod 4) = 0 := by
    push_cast
    generalize (a : ZMod 4) = x
    generalize (b : ZMod 4) = y
    generalize (c : ZMod 4) = z
    generalize (d : ZMod 4) = t
    revert x y z t; decide
  exact_mod_cast dvd_of_zmod_zero this

name: CongruenceTheory.aux_r4
proof:
:= by
  have : ((((a ^ 4 + 4 * a ^ 2 * b + 4 * b ^ 2) ^ 2 - a ^ 8 : ℤ)) : ZMod 16) = 0 := by
    push_cast
    generalize (a : ZMod 16) = x
    generalize (b : ZMod 16) = y
    revert x y; decide
  exact_mod_cast dvd_of_zmod_zero this

name: CongruenceTheory.power_of_two_r1
statement: theorem power_of_two_r1 (w : ℕ → ℤ) : (2 : ℤ) ∣ Aw w 2 - (w 1 + w 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Aw_two]; exact aux_r1 _ _

name: CongruenceTheory.power_of_two_r2
statement:
theorem power_of_two_r2 (w : ℕ → ℤ) :
    (4 : ℤ) ∣ Aw w 4 - ((w 1 + w 2) ^ 2 + 2 * (w 2 + w 4))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Aw_four]; exact aux_r2 _ _ _ _

name: CongruenceTheory.power_of_two_r3
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (8 : ℤ) ∣ Aw w 8 - Aw w 4 * Aw w 4 := by
    simpa using Aw_two_adic w 2 (by norm_num)
  have h2 : (2 : ℤ) ^ 2 ∣ Aw w 4 - ((w 1 + w 2) ^ 2 + 2 * (w 2 + w 4)) := by
    simpa using power_of_two_r2 w
  have h3 : (8 : ℤ) ∣ Aw w 4 ^ 2 - ((w 1 + w 2) ^ 2 + 2 * (w 2 + w 4)) ^ 2 := by
    simpa using sq_congr_two (by norm_num : 1 ≤ 2) h2
  have key : Aw w 8 - ((w 1 + w 2) ^ 4 + 4 * (w 1 + w 2) ^ 2 * (w 2 + w 4)
      + 4 * (w 2 + w 4) ^ 2)
      = (Aw w 8 - Aw w 4 * Aw w 4)
        + (Aw w 4 ^ 2 - ((w 1 + w 2) ^ 2 + 2 * (w 2 + w 4)) ^ 2) := by ring
  rw [key]; exact dvd_add h1 h3

name: CongruenceTheory.power_of_two_r4
statement: theorem power_of_two_r4 (w : ℕ → ℤ) : (16 : ℤ) ∣ Aw w 16 - (w 1 + w 2) ^ 8
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (16 : ℤ) ∣ Aw w 16 - Aw w 8 * Aw w 8 := by
    have := Aw_two_adic w 3 (by norm_num)
    have h32 : (16 : ℤ) ∣ (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 * 3 - 1) := by norm_num
    simpa using dvd_trans h32 this
  have h2 : (2 : ℤ) ^ 3 ∣ Aw w 8 - ((w 1 + w 2) ^ 4 + 4 * (w 1 + w 2) ^ 2 * (w 2 + w 4)
      + 4 * (w 2 + w 4) ^ 2) := by simpa using power_of_two_r3 w
  have h3 : (16 : ℤ) ∣ Aw w 8 ^ 2 - ((w 1 + w 2) ^ 4 + 4 * (w 1 + w 2) ^ 2 * (w 2 + w 4)
      + 4 * (w 2 + w 4) ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
    simpa using sq_congr_two (by norm_num : 1 ≤ 3) h2
  have h4 := aux_r4 (w 1 + w 2) (w 2 + w 4)
  have key : Aw w 16 - (w 1 + w 2) ^ 8
      = (Aw w 16 - Aw w 8 * Aw w 8)
        + (Aw w 8 ^ 2 - ((w 1 + w 2) ^ 4 + 4 * (w 1 + w 2) ^ 2 * (w 2 + w 4)
          + 4 * (w 2 + w 4) ^ 2) ^ 2)
        + (((w 1 + w 2) ^ 4 + 4 * (w 1 + w 2) ^ 2 * (w 2 + w 4)
          + 4 * (w 2 + w 4) ^ 2) ^ 2 - (w 1 + w 2) ^ 8) := by ring
  rw [key]; exact dvd_add (dvd_add h1 h3) h4

name: CongruenceTheory.power_of_two_residue
statement:
theorem power_of_two_residue (w : ℕ → ℤ) :
    ∀ r : ℕ, 4 ≤ r → (2 : ℤ) ^ r ∣ Aw w (2 ^ r) - (w 1 + w 2) ^ (2 ^ (r - 1))
proof:
:= by
  intro r hr
  induction r, hr using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => simpa using power_of_two_r4 w
  | succ r hr ih =>
    have h1 := Aw_two_adic w r (by omega)
    have h2 := sq_congr_two (by omega : 1 ≤ r) ih
    have hle : (2 : ℤ) ^ (r + 1) ∣ (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 * r - 1) :=
      pow_dvd_pow 2 (by omega)
    have h1' := dvd_trans hle h1
    have e : (w 1 + w 2) ^ (2 ^ (r + 1 - 1)) = ((w 1 + w 2) ^ (2 ^ (r - 1))) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← pow_mul]
      congr 1
      obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, r = m + 1 := ⟨r - 1, by omega⟩
      simp [pow_succ]
    rw [e]
    have key : Aw w (2 ^ (r + 1)) - ((w 1 + w 2) ^ (2 ^ (r - 1))) ^ 2
        = (Aw w (2 ^ (r + 1)) - Aw w (2 ^ r) * Aw w (2 ^ r))
          + (Aw w (2 ^ r) ^ 2 - ((w 1 + w 2) ^ (2 ^ (r - 1))) ^ 2) := by ring
    rw [key]; exact dvd_add h1' h2

name: CongruenceTheory.odd_pow_two_pow
statement:
lemma odd_pow_two_pow (g : ℤ) (hg : Odd g) :
    ∀ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r → (2 : ℤ) ^ r ∣ g ^ (2 ^ (r - 1)) - 1
proof:
:= by
  intro r hr
  induction r, hr using Nat.le_induction with
  | base =>
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hg
    exact ⟨k, by simp [hk]⟩
  | succ r hr ih =>
    have h := sq_congr_two (y := 1) (by omega : 1 ≤ r) (by simpa using ih)
    have e : g ^ (2 ^ (r + 1 - 1)) = (g ^ (2 ^ (r - 1))) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← pow_mul]; congr 1
      obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, r = m + 1 := ⟨r - 1, by omega⟩
      simp [pow_succ]
    rw [e]; simpa using h

name: CongruenceTheory.even_pow_two_pow
statement:
lemma even_pow_two_pow (g : ℤ) (hg : Even g) (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) :
    (2 : ℤ) ^ r ∣ g ^ (2 ^ (r - 1))
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (2 : ℤ) ∣ g := even_iff_two_dvd.mp hg
  have hlt : r ≤ 2 ^ (r - 1) := by
    have := Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := r - 1)
    omega
  exact dvd_trans (pow_dvd_pow 2 hlt) (pow_dvd_pow_of_dvd h2 _)

name: CongruenceTheory.power_of_two_zero_one
statement:
theorem power_of_two_zero_one (w : ℕ → ℤ) (r : ℕ) (hr : 4 ≤ r) :
    (Odd (w 1 + w 2) → (2 : ℤ) ^ r ∣ Aw w (2 ^ r) - 1) ∧
    (Even (w 1 + w 2) → (2 : ℤ) ^ r ∣ Aw w (2 ^ r))
proof:
:= by
  have hmain := power_of_two_residue w r hr
  constructor
  · intro hodd
    have h1 := odd_pow_two_pow _ hodd r (by omega)
    have key : Aw w (2 ^ r) - 1 = (Aw w (2 ^ r) - (w 1 + w 2) ^ (2 ^ (r - 1)))
        + ((w 1 + w 2) ^ (2 ^ (r - 1)) - 1) := by ring
    rw [key]; exact dvd_add hmain h1
  · intro heven
    have h1 := even_pow_two_pow _ heven r (by omega)
    have key : Aw w (2 ^ r) = (Aw w (2 ^ r) - (w 1 + w 2) ^ (2 ^ (r - 1)))
        + (w 1 + w 2) ^ (2 ^ (r - 1)) := by ring
    rw [key]; exact dvd_add hmain h1

name: CongruenceTheory.coeff_neg_one_pow_mul_X_pow
statement:
private lemma coeff_neg_one_pow_mul_X_pow (d k e : ℕ) :
    coeff e (((-1 : ℚ⟦X⟧)) ^ d * X ^ k) = if e = k then (-1 : ℚ) ^ d else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [show ((-1 : ℚ⟦X⟧)) ^ d = (PowerSeries.C ((-1 : ℚ) ^ d)) from by rw [map_pow]; simp]
  rw [coeff_C_mul, coeff_X_pow]
  split_ifs <;> ring

name: CongruenceTheory.coeff_logOf_one_sub_X_pow
statement:
theorem coeff_logOf_one_sub_X_pow (N : ℕ) (hN : N ≠ 0) (e : ℕ) :
    coeff e (logOf (1 - X ^ N : ℚ⟦X⟧)) =
      if h : N ∣ e ∧ e ≠ 0 then (-1 : ℚ) / (e / N) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [logOf_eq, show (1 - X ^ N : ℚ⟦X⟧) - 1 = -X ^ N from by ring]
  have hsubst : HasSubst (-X ^ N : ℚ⟦X⟧) := by
    apply HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero'
    simp [hN]
  rw [coeff_subst' hsubst]
  by_cases he0 : e = 0
  · subst he0
    rw [finsum_eq_single _ 0]
    · simp
    · intro d hd
      rw [neg_pow, ← pow_mul, coeff_neg_one_pow_mul_X_pow]
      rw [if_neg]
      · simp
      · intro h
        apply hd
        have : N * d = 0 := h.symm
        rcases Nat.mul_eq_zero.mp this with h1 | h1
        · exact absurd h1 hN
        · exact h1
  · by_cases hdvd : N ∣ e
    · rw [dif_pos ⟨hdvd, he0⟩]
      rw [finsum_eq_single _ (e / N)]
      · rw [neg_pow, ← pow_mul, coeff_neg_one_pow_mul_X_pow]
        rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdvd]
        rw [if_pos rfl]
        rw [coeff_log]
        have hen0 : e / N ≠ 0 := by
          intro h
          apply he0
          have := Nat.div_mul_cancel hdvd
          rw [h, zero_mul] at this
          omega
        rw [if_neg hen0]
        simp only [smul_eq_mul, Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply, pow_succ]
        have hsq : ((-1 : ℚ)) ^ (e / N * 2) = 1 :=
          Even.neg_one_pow ⟨e / N, by ring⟩
        have hNe : ((e / N : ℕ) : ℚ) = (e : ℚ) / (N : ℚ) :=
          Nat.cast_div hdvd (by exact_mod_cast hN)
        rw [hNe]
        have hNne : (N : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hN
        have heNne : (e : ℚ) / (N : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
          rw [← hNe]; exact_mod_cast hen0
        field_simp
        have hsq2 : (((-1 : ℚ)) ^ (e / N)) ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [← pow_mul]; exact hsq
        rw [hsq2]
      · intro j hj
        rw [neg_pow, ← pow_mul, coeff_neg_one_pow_mul_X_pow]
        rw [if_neg]
        · simp
        · contrapose hj
          have hj' : j = e / N := by
            rw [hj, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left j (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hN)]
          exact hj'
    · rw [dif_neg (fun h => hdvd h.1)]
      apply finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
      intro j
      rw [neg_pow, ← pow_mul, coeff_neg_one_pow_mul_X_pow]
      rw [if_neg]
      · simp
      · contrapose hdvd
        exact ⟨j, hdvd⟩

name: CongruenceTheory.constantCoeff_tlog
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_tlog (F : A⟦X⟧) (hF : constantCoeff F = 1) (t : A) :
    constantCoeff (PowerSeries.C t * logOf F) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_mul, constantCoeff_logOf hF, mul_zero]

name: CongruenceTheory.constantCoeff_rpow
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_rpow (F : A⟦X⟧) (hF : constantCoeff F = 1) (t : A) :
    constantCoeff (rpow F t) = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold rpow
  rw [constantCoeff_subst_of_const_zero (exp A) (PowerSeries.C t * logOf F)
    (constantCoeff_tlog F hF t)
    (HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' (constantCoeff_tlog F hF t))]
  exact constantCoeff_exp

name: CongruenceTheory.logOf_rpow
statement:
theorem logOf_rpow (F : A⟦X⟧) (hF : constantCoeff F = 1) (t : A) :
    logOf (rpow F t) = PowerSeries.C t * logOf F
proof:
:= by
  unfold rpow
  exact logOf_exp (PowerSeries.C t * logOf F) (constantCoeff_tlog F hF t)

name: CongruenceTheory.le_order_rpow_sub_one
statement:
theorem le_order_rpow_sub_one (F : ℚ⟦X⟧) (hF : constantCoeff F = 1) (t : ℚ) :
    (logOf F).order ≤ (rpow F t - 1).order
proof:
:= by
  unfold rpow
  have hg : (PowerSeries.C t * logOf F : ℚ⟦X⟧).constantCoeff = 0 := constantCoeff_tlog F hF t
  have hexp1 : (PowerSeries.exp ℚ - 1 : ℚ⟦X⟧).constantCoeff = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, constantCoeff_exp]; simp
  have key := PowerSeries.le_order_subst_right' hg hexp1
  have heq : ((PowerSeries.exp ℚ - 1 : ℚ⟦X⟧)).subst (PowerSeries.C t * logOf F) =
      (PowerSeries.exp ℚ).subst (PowerSeries.C t * logOf F) - 1 := by
    rw [PowerSeries.subst_sub (HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' hg),
      subst_one_eq (HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' hg)]
  rw [heq] at key
  refine le_trans ?_ key
  have hmul := PowerSeries.le_order_mul (PowerSeries.C t : ℚ⟦X⟧) (logOf F)
  refine le_trans ?_ hmul
  exact le_add_self

name: CongruenceTheory.le_order_logOf_one_sub_X_pow
statement:
theorem le_order_logOf_one_sub_X_pow (n : ℕ) :
    ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ (logOf (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧)).order
proof:
:= by
  rw [logOf_eq]
  have h1 : (-X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧).constantCoeff = 0 := by simp
  have h2 : (PowerSeries.log ℚ).constantCoeff = 0 := PowerSeries.constantCoeff_log
  have := PowerSeries.le_order_subst_right' h1 h2
  rw [show (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) - 1 = -X ^ (n + 1) by ring] at *
  rw [show ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) = (-X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧).order from ?_]
  · exact this
  · rw [PowerSeries.order_neg]; simp [PowerSeries.order_X_pow]

name: CongruenceTheory.le_order_eulerFactor_sub_one
statement:
theorem le_order_eulerFactor_sub_one (n : ℕ) (b : ℚ) :
    ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ (rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-b) - 1).order
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : constantCoeff (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) = 1 := by simp
  exact le_trans (le_order_logOf_one_sub_X_pow n) (le_order_rpow_sub_one _ h1 (-b))

name: CongruenceTheory.multipliable_eulerFactors
statement:
theorem multipliable_eulerFactors (b : ℕ → ℚ) :
    Multipliable (fun n : ℕ => rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b (n + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun n : ℕ => rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b (n + 1)))) =
      (fun n : ℕ => 1 + (rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b (n + 1))) - 1)) := by
    funext n; ring
  rw [heq]
  apply PowerSeries.WithPiTopology.multipliable_one_add_of_tendsto_order_atTop_nhds_top
  rw [ENat.tendsto_nhds_top_iff_natCast_lt]
  intro n
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop n] with m hm
  calc (n : ℕ∞) < ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_of_le hm
    _ ≤ (rpow (1 - X ^ (m + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b (m + 1))) - 1).order :=
        le_order_eulerFactor_sub_one m (b (m + 1))

name: CongruenceTheory.order_prod_one_add_sub_one_gt
statement:
theorem order_prod_one_add_sub_one_gt (g : ℕ → ℚ⟦X⟧) (s : Finset ℕ) (e : ℕ)
    (hg : ∀ i ∈ s, (e : ℕ∞) < (g i).order) :
    (e : ℕ∞) < (∏ i ∈ s, (1 + g i) - 1).order
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha]
    have step : (∏ i ∈ insert a s, (1 + g i)) - 1 =
        (∏ i ∈ s, (1 + g i) - 1) + (∏ i ∈ s, (1 + g i)) * g a := by
      rw [Finset.prod_insert ha]; ring
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha] at step
    rw [step]
    have h1 : (e : ℕ∞) < (∏ i ∈ s, (1 + g i) - 1).order :=
      ih (fun i hi => hg i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
    have h2 : (e : ℕ∞) < ((∏ i ∈ s, (1 + g i)) * g a).order := by
      apply lt_of_lt_of_le (hg a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s))
      calc (g a).order ≤ (∏ i ∈ s, (1 + g i)).order + (g a).order := le_add_self
        _ ≤ ((∏ i ∈ s, (1 + g i)) * g a).order := PowerSeries.le_order_mul _ _
    calc (e : ℕ∞) < min ((∏ i ∈ s, (1 + g i) - 1).order) (((∏ i ∈ s, (1 + g i)) * g a).order) :=
          lt_min h1 h2
      _ ≤ _ := PowerSeries.min_order_le_order_add _ _

name: CongruenceTheory.coeff_tprod_eq_coeff_prod_range
statement:
theorem coeff_tprod_eq_coeff_prod_range (g : ℕ → ℚ⟦X⟧)
    (hM : Multipliable (fun n => 1 + g n : ℕ → ℚ⟦X⟧)) (e N : ℕ)
    (hg : ∀ n ≥ N, (e : ℕ∞) < (g n).order) :
    coeff e (∏' n, (1 + g n)) = coeff e (∏ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 + g n))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hM
  rw [hL.tprod_eq]
  have hcont : Tendsto (fun s : Finset ℕ => coeff e (∏ b ∈ s, (1 + g b))) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (coeff e L)) :=
    (PowerSeries.WithPiTopology.continuous_coeff (R := ℚ) e).continuousAt.tendsto.comp hL
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun s : Finset ℕ => coeff e (∏ b ∈ s, (1 + g b))) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (coeff e (∏ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 + g n)))) := by
    apply tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_eq
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (Finset.range N)] with s hs
    have hsplit : s = Finset.range N ∪ (s \ Finset.range N) :=
      (Finset.union_sdiff_of_subset hs).symm
    have hdisj : Disjoint (Finset.range N) (s \ Finset.range N) := Finset.disjoint_sdiff
    rw [hsplit, Finset.prod_union hdisj]
    have hR : (e : ℕ∞) < (∏ i ∈ s \ Finset.range N, (1 + g i) - 1).order := by
      apply order_prod_one_add_sub_one_gt
      intro i hi
      have : i ≥ N := by
        have := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hi
        by_contra h
        push Not at h
        exact this.2 (Finset.mem_range.mpr h)
      exact hg i this
    set R := ∏ i ∈ s \ Finset.range N, (1 + g i) with hRdef
    have hReq : R = 1 + (R - 1) := by ring
    rw [hReq, mul_add, mul_one, map_add]
    have hzero : coeff e ((∏ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 + g n)) * (R - 1)) = 0 := by
      apply PowerSeries.coeff_of_lt_order
      apply lt_of_lt_of_le hR
      calc (R - 1).order = (0 : ℕ∞) + (R - 1).order := by rw [zero_add]
        _ ≤ (∏ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 + g n)).order + (R - 1).order := by
            gcongr; exact zero_le
        _ ≤ ((∏ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 + g n)) * (R - 1)).order := PowerSeries.le_order_mul _ _
    rw [hzero, add_zero]
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hcont hconst

name: CongruenceTheory.order_pow_sub_pow_gt
statement:
theorem order_pow_sub_pow_gt (A B : ℚ⟦X⟧) (e : ℕ) (h : (e : ℕ∞) < (A - B).order) :
    ∀ d : ℕ, (e : ℕ∞) < (A ^ d - B ^ d).order
proof:
:= by
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero => simp
  | succ d ih =>
    have step : A ^ (d + 1) - B ^ (d + 1) = A * (A ^ d - B ^ d) + (A - B) * B ^ d := by ring
    rw [step]
    have h1 : (e : ℕ∞) < (A * (A ^ d - B ^ d)).order := by
      apply lt_of_lt_of_le ih
      calc (A ^ d - B ^ d).order ≤ (A).order + (A ^ d - B ^ d).order := le_add_self
        _ ≤ (A * (A ^ d - B ^ d)).order := PowerSeries.le_order_mul _ _
    have h2 : (e : ℕ∞) < ((A - B) * B ^ d).order := by
      apply lt_of_lt_of_le h
      calc (A - B).order ≤ (A - B).order + (B ^ d).order := le_self_add
        _ ≤ ((A - B) * B ^ d).order := PowerSeries.le_order_mul _ _
    calc (e : ℕ∞) < min ((A * (A ^ d - B ^ d)).order) (((A - B) * B ^ d).order) := lt_min h1 h2
      _ ≤ _ := PowerSeries.min_order_le_order_add _ _

name: CongruenceTheory.coeff_logOf_congr
statement:
theorem coeff_logOf_congr (F G : ℚ⟦X⟧) (hF : constantCoeff F = 1) (hG : constantCoeff G = 1)
    (e : ℕ) (h : (e : ℕ∞) < (F - G).order) :
    coeff e (logOf F) = coeff e (logOf G)
proof:
:= by
  have hFG1 : (F - 1) - (G - 1) = F - G := by ring
  rw [logOf_eq, logOf_eq, coeff_subst' (hasSubst_sub_one hF), coeff_subst' (hasSubst_sub_one hG)]
  apply finsum_congr
  intro d
  congr 1
  by_cases hd0 : d = 0
  · simp [hd0]
  · have hpow : (e : ℕ∞) < ((F - 1) ^ d - (G - 1) ^ d).order := by
      apply order_pow_sub_pow_gt
      rwa [hFG1]
    have := PowerSeries.coeff_of_lt_order e hpow
    rw [map_sub] at this
    linarith [sub_eq_zero.mp this]

name: CongruenceTheory.constantCoeff_prod_range
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_prod_range (g : ℕ → ℚ⟦X⟧) (hg : ∀ n, constantCoeff (1 + g n : ℚ⟦X⟧) = 1)
    (N : ℕ) : constantCoeff (∏ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 + g n) : ℚ⟦X⟧) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_prod]
  exact Finset.prod_eq_one (fun n _ => hg n)

name: CongruenceTheory.logOf_prod_range
statement:
theorem logOf_prod_range (g : ℕ → ℚ⟦X⟧) (hg : ∀ n, constantCoeff (1 + g n : ℚ⟦X⟧) = 1)
    (N : ℕ) :
    logOf (∏ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 + g n)) = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, logOf (1 + g n)
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp [logOf_one]
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    rw [logOf_mul _ _ (constantCoeff_prod_range g hg N) (hg N), ih]

name: CongruenceTheory.le_order_logOf_of_constantCoeff_eq_one
statement:
theorem le_order_logOf_of_constantCoeff_eq_one (F : ℚ⟦X⟧) (hF : constantCoeff F = 1) :
    (F - 1).order ≤ (logOf F).order
proof:
:= by
  rw [logOf_eq]
  exact PowerSeries.le_order_subst_right' (by simp [hF]) (by simp)

name: CongruenceTheory.hasSum_coeff_logOf
statement:
theorem hasSum_coeff_logOf (g : ℕ → ℚ⟦X⟧) (hg1 : ∀ n, constantCoeff (1 + g n : ℚ⟦X⟧) = 1)
    (hM : Multipliable (fun n => 1 + g n : ℕ → ℚ⟦X⟧))
    (horder : ∀ e : ℕ, ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, (e : ℕ∞) < (g n).order) (e : ℕ) :
    HasSum (fun n => coeff e (logOf (1 + g n))) (coeff e (logOf (∏' n, (1 + g n))))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := horder e
  have hcoeffs :
      ∀ d ≤ e, coeff d (∏' n, (1 + g n)) = coeff d (∏ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 + g n)) := by
    intro d hd
    apply coeff_tprod_eq_coeff_prod_range g hM d N
    intro n hn
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (by exact_mod_cast hd) (hN n hn)
  have hstep :
      ((e + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ((∏' n, (1 + g n)) - (∏ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 + g n))).order := by
    apply PowerSeries.nat_le_order
    intro i hi
    rw [map_sub, hcoeffs i (by omega), sub_self]
  have horderdiff :
      (e : ℕ∞) < ((∏' n, (1 + g n)) - (∏ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 + g n))).order := by
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ hstep
    exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self e
  have hcc1 : constantCoeff (∏' n, (1 + g n) : ℚ⟦X⟧) = 1 := by
    have h0 := hcoeffs 0 (Nat.zero_le e)
    simpa [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, constantCoeff_prod_range g hg1] using h0
  have key : coeff e (logOf (∏' n, (1 + g n))) =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, coeff e (logOf (1 + g n)) := by
    rw [coeff_logOf_congr _ _ hcc1 (constantCoeff_prod_range g hg1 N) e horderdiff,
      logOf_prod_range g hg1 N, map_sum]
  rw [key]
  apply hasSum_sum_of_ne_finset_zero (s := Finset.range N)
  intro n hn
  apply PowerSeries.coeff_of_lt_order
  apply lt_of_lt_of_le (hN n (by simpa using hn))
  have := le_order_logOf_of_constantCoeff_eq_one (1 + g n) (hg1 n)
  simpa using this

name: CongruenceTheory.logOf_tprod
statement:
theorem logOf_tprod (g : ℕ → ℚ⟦X⟧) (hg1 : ∀ n, constantCoeff (1 + g n : ℚ⟦X⟧) = 1)
    (hM : Multipliable (fun n => 1 + g n : ℕ → ℚ⟦X⟧))
    (horder : ∀ e : ℕ, ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, (e : ℕ∞) < (g n).order) :
    logOf (∏' n, (1 + g n)) = ∑' n, logOf (1 + g n)
proof:
:= by
  have hSummable : Summable (fun n => logOf (1 + g n) : ℕ → ℚ⟦X⟧) :=
    (PowerSeries.WithPiTopology.summable_iff_summable_coeff _).mpr
      (fun e => (hasSum_coeff_logOf g hg1 hM horder e).summable)
  apply PowerSeries.ext
  intro e
  rw [(hasSum_coeff_logOf g hg1 hM horder e).tsum_eq.symm]
  exact ((PowerSeries.WithPiTopology.hasSum_iff_hasSum_coeff (R := ℚ) |>.mp
    hSummable.hasSum) e).tsum_eq

name: CongruenceTheory.b_int_iff_dvd
statement:
theorem b_int_iff_dvd (w : ℕ → ℤ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (∃ z : ℤ, b w n = z) ↔ (n : ℤ) ∣ MTrans w n
proof:
:= by
  unfold b
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
    have : (MTrans w n : ℚ) = z * n := by
      rw [← hz]
      field_simp
    have hz2 : (MTrans w n : ℤ) = z * n := by exact_mod_cast this
    exact ⟨z, by rw [hz2, mul_comm]⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
    rw [hc]
    push_cast
    field_simp

name: CongruenceTheory.euler_integrality_ii_iff_iii
statement:
theorem euler_integrality_ii_iff_iii (w : ℕ → ℤ) :
    (∀ n ≥ 1, ∃ z : ℤ, b w n = z) ↔ (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → (n : ℤ) ∣ MTrans w n)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h n hn
    exact (b_int_iff_dvd w n hn).mp (h n hn)
  · intro h n hn
    exact (b_int_iff_dvd w n hn).mpr (h n hn)

name: CongruenceTheory.rpow_natCast
statement:
theorem rpow_natCast (F : ℚ⟦X⟧) (hF : constantCoeff F = 1) (n : ℕ) :
    rpow F (n : ℚ) = F ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : logOf (rpow F (n : ℚ)) = logOf (F ^ n) := by
    rw [logOf_rpow F hF, logOf_pow F hF n]
    congr 1
  have h2 : constantCoeff (rpow F (n : ℚ)) = 1 := constantCoeff_rpow F hF n
  have h3 : constantCoeff (F ^ n) = 1 := by rw [map_pow, hF, one_pow]
  have := exp_logOf (rpow F (n : ℚ)) h2
  rw [h1] at this
  rw [← this, exp_logOf _ h3]

name: CongruenceTheory.rpow_neg_natCast
statement:
theorem rpow_neg_natCast (F : ℚ⟦X⟧) (hF : constantCoeff F = 1) (n : ℕ) :
    rpow F (-(n : ℚ)) = geomSubst (F ^ n) (by rw [map_pow, hF, one_pow])
proof:
:= by
  have hFn : constantCoeff (F ^ n) = 1 := by rw [map_pow, hF, one_pow]
  have h1 : logOf (rpow F (-(n : ℚ))) = logOf (geomSubst (F ^ n) hFn) := by
    rw [logOf_rpow F hF, logOf_inv (F ^ n) hFn, logOf_pow F hF n]
    rw [show (PowerSeries.C (-(n : ℚ)) : ℚ⟦X⟧) = -(n : ℚ⟦X⟧) from by
      rw [map_neg, map_natCast]]
    ring
  have h2 : constantCoeff (rpow F (-(n : ℚ))) = 1 := constantCoeff_rpow F hF _
  have h3 : constantCoeff (geomSubst (F ^ n) hFn) = 1 := constantCoeff_geomSubst (F ^ n) hFn
  have := exp_logOf (rpow F (-(n : ℚ))) h2
  rw [h1] at this
  rw [← this, exp_logOf _ h3]

name: CongruenceTheory.EF_spec
statement: theorem EF_spec (n : ℕ) : (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℤ⟦X⟧) * EF n = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply PowerSeries.mul_invOfUnit
  simp

name: CongruenceTheory.map_EF_eq_geomSubst
statement:
theorem map_EF_eq_geomSubst (n : ℕ) :
    (EF n).map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) = geomSubst (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (by simp)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) * (EF n).map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) = 1 := by
    have := congrArg (PowerSeries.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) (EF_spec n)
    simp only [map_mul, map_sub, map_one, map_pow, PowerSeries.map_X] at this
    convert this using 2
  have h2 : (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) * geomSubst (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (by simp) = 1 :=
    f_mul_geomSubst _ _
  have hunit : IsUnit (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) := isUnit_iff_constantCoeff.mpr (by simp)
  exact hunit.mul_left_cancel (h1.trans h2.symm)

name: CongruenceTheory.geomSubst_pow
statement:
theorem geomSubst_pow (F : ℚ⟦X⟧) (hF : constantCoeff F = 1) (m : ℕ) :
    (geomSubst F hF) ^ m = geomSubst (F ^ m) (by rw [map_pow, hF, one_pow])
proof:
:= by
  have hFm : constantCoeff (F ^ m) = 1 := by rw [map_pow, hF, one_pow]
  have h1 : F ^ m * (geomSubst F hF) ^ m = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_pow, f_mul_geomSubst F hF, one_pow]
  have h2 : F ^ m * geomSubst (F ^ m) hFm = 1 := f_mul_geomSubst _ _
  have hunit : IsUnit (F ^ m) := isUnit_iff_constantCoeff.mpr (by rw [hFm]; exact isUnit_one)
  exact hunit.mul_left_cancel (h1.trans h2.symm)

name: CongruenceTheory.map_Efactor
statement:
theorem map_Efactor (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ) :
    (Efactor n k).map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) = rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (k : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Efactor
  by_cases hk : 0 ≤ k
  · rw [if_pos hk]
    have hcast : (k.toNat : ℚ) = (k : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast Int.toNat_of_nonneg hk
    rw [map_pow]
    have hmap1 : (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℤ⟦X⟧).map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) = (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) := by
      simp
    rw [hmap1, ← hcast]
    exact (rpow_natCast (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (by simp) k.toNat).symm
  · rw [if_neg hk]
    push Not at hk
    have hcast : ((-k).toNat : ℚ) = -(k : ℚ) := by
      have := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (show (0 : ℤ) ≤ -k by omega)
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hcast2 : (k : ℚ) = -(((-k).toNat : ℕ) : ℚ) := by rw [hcast]; ring
    rw [map_pow, map_EF_eq_geomSubst, hcast2,
      rpow_neg_natCast (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (by simp) (-k).toNat,
      geomSubst_pow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (by simp) (-k).toNat]

name: CongruenceTheory.coeff_finiteProd_int
statement:
theorem coeff_finiteProd_int (w : ℕ → ℤ) (z : ℕ → ℤ) (hz : ∀ n, b w n = (z n : ℚ))
    (N : ℕ) (e : ℕ) :
    ∃ m : ℤ,
      coeff e (∏ n ∈ Finset.range N, rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1)))) = (m : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : ∏ n ∈ Finset.range N, rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1))) =
      (∏ n ∈ Finset.range N, Efactor n (-(z (n + 1)))).map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) := by
    rw [map_prod]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro n _
    rw [map_Efactor]
    congr 1
    rw [hz]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [heq, coeff_map]
  exact ⟨coeff e (∏ n ∈ Finset.range N, Efactor n (-(z (n + 1)))), rfl⟩

name: CongruenceTheory.euler_integrality_ii_imp_i
statement:
theorem euler_integrality_ii_imp_i (w : ℕ → ℤ) (z : ℕ → ℤ) (hz : ∀ n, b w n = (z n : ℚ)) (e : ℕ) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, coeff e (AwSeries w) = (m : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [euler_product w]
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := (horder_eulerFactors w) e
  have hM : Multipliable (fun n : ℕ => 1 + (rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1))) - 1)) := by
    have heq : (fun n : ℕ => rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1)))) =
        (fun n : ℕ => 1 + (rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1))) - 1)) := by
      funext n; ring
    rw [← heq]; exact multipliable_eulerFactors (b w)
  have hcoeff : coeff e (∏' n, rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1)))) =
      coeff e (∏ n ∈ Finset.range N, rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1)))) := by
    have heq : (fun n : ℕ => rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1)))) =
        (fun n : ℕ => 1 + (rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1))) - 1)) := by
      funext n; ring
    rw [heq]
    exact coeff_tprod_eq_coeff_prod_range _ hM e N hN
  rw [hcoeff]
  exact coeff_finiteProd_int w z hz N e

name: CongruenceTheory.coeff_AwSeries_eq_coeff_prod_range
statement:
theorem coeff_AwSeries_eq_coeff_prod_range (w : ℕ → ℤ) (N : ℕ) :
    coeff N (AwSeries w) =
      coeff N (∏ n ∈ Finset.range N, rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [euler_product w]
  have heq : (fun n : ℕ => rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1)))) =
      (fun n : ℕ => 1 + (rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1))) - 1)) := by funext n; ring
  have hM : Multipliable (fun n : ℕ => 1 + (rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1))) - 1)) := by
    rw [← heq]; exact multipliable_eulerFactors (b w)
  rw [heq]
  apply coeff_tprod_eq_coeff_prod_range _ hM N N
  intro n hn
  have h1 : (N : ℕ∞) < ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : N < n + 1)
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (le_order_eulerFactor_sub_one n (b w (n + 1)))

name: CongruenceTheory.prod_range_split_top
statement:
theorem prod_range_split_top (w : ℕ → ℤ) (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    ∏ n ∈ Finset.range N, rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1))) =
      (∏ n ∈ Finset.range (N - 1), rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1)))) *
        rpow (1 - X ^ N : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w N))
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : Finset.range N = insert (N - 1) (Finset.range (N - 1)) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [show N = (N - 1) + 1 from by omega]
    rw [Finset.range_add_one]
  rw [hsplit, Finset.prod_insert (by simp)]
  rw [show N - 1 + 1 = N from by omega]
  ring

name: CongruenceTheory.head_prod_int
statement:
theorem head_prod_int (w : ℕ → ℤ) (z : ℕ → ℤ) (M : ℕ)
    (hz : ∀ n ∈ Finset.range M, b w (n + 1) = (z (n + 1) : ℚ)) :
    ∃ H : ℤ⟦X⟧, (∏ n ∈ Finset.range M, rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1)))) =
      H.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) ∧ constantCoeff H = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨∏ n ∈ Finset.range M, Efactor n (-(z (n + 1))), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [map_prod]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro n hn
    rw [map_Efactor]
    congr 1
    rw [hz n hn]
    push_cast
    ring
  · rw [map_prod]
    apply Finset.prod_eq_one
    intro n _
    unfold Efactor
    split_ifs with hk
    · rw [map_pow]; simp
    · rw [map_pow]
      have hconst1 : constantCoeff (EF n) = 1 := by
        have h1 := EF_spec n
        have h2 := congrArg constantCoeff h1
        rw [map_mul, map_one] at h2
        have h3 : constantCoeff (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℤ⟦X⟧) = 1 := by simp
        rw [h3, one_mul] at h2
        exact h2
      rw [hconst1]; simp

name: CongruenceTheory.coeff_rpow_one_sub_X_pow_le
statement:
theorem coeff_rpow_one_sub_X_pow_le (N e : ℕ) (hN : N ≠ 0) (he : e ≤ N) (t : ℚ) :
    coeff e (rpow (1 - X ^ N : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-t)) = if e = 0 then 1 else if e = N then t else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold rpow
  set h : ℚ⟦X⟧ := PowerSeries.C (-t) * logOf (1 - X ^ N : ℚ⟦X⟧) with hdef
  have horder : (N : ℕ∞) ≤ h.order := by
    rw [hdef]
    calc (N : ℕ∞) ≤ (logOf (1 - X ^ N : ℚ⟦X⟧)).order := by
          have := le_order_logOf_one_sub_X_pow (N - 1)
          rwa [show N - 1 + 1 = N from by omega] at this
      _ = (0 : ℕ∞) + (logOf (1 - X ^ N : ℚ⟦X⟧)).order := by rw [zero_add]
      _ ≤ (PowerSeries.C (-t) : ℚ⟦X⟧).order + (logOf (1 - X ^ N : ℚ⟦X⟧)).order := by
          gcongr; exact zero_le
      _ ≤ _ := PowerSeries.le_order_mul _ _
  have hsubst : HasSubst h := HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' (by
    have := PowerSeries.coeff_of_lt_order (φ := h) 0 (by
      apply lt_of_lt_of_le _ horder
      exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hN)
    rwa [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff] at this)
  rw [coeff_subst' hsubst]
  have hzero : ∀ d, 2 ≤ d → coeff d (PowerSeries.exp ℚ) • coeff e (h ^ d) = 0 := by
    intro d hd2
    have horderpow : (2 * N : ℕ∞) ≤ (h ^ d).order := by
      calc (2 * N : ℕ∞) ≤ (d : ℕ∞) * (N : ℕ∞) := by
            have hdc : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ (d : ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast hd2
            calc (2 * N : ℕ∞) = (2 : ℕ∞) * (N : ℕ∞) := by push_cast; ring
              _ ≤ (d : ℕ∞) * (N : ℕ∞) := by gcongr
        _ ≤ d • h.order := by rw [nsmul_eq_mul]; gcongr
        _ ≤ (h ^ d).order := PowerSeries.le_order_pow _ _
    have hlt : (e : ℕ∞) < (h ^ d).order := by
      apply lt_of_lt_of_le _ horderpow
      have hN1 : 1 ≤ N := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hN
      have : e < 2 * N := by omega
      exact_mod_cast this
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_of_lt_order e hlt, smul_zero]
  have hsupp : Function.support (fun d => coeff d (PowerSeries.exp ℚ) • coeff e (h ^ d)) ⊆
      (({0, 1} : Finset ℕ) : Set ℕ) := by
    intro d hd
    simp only [Function.mem_support] at hd
    simp only [Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    by_contra hdmem
    push Not at hdmem
    exact hd (hzero d (by omega))
  rw [finsum_eq_finsetSum_of_support_subset _ hsupp]
  rw [show ({0, 1} : Finset ℕ) = insert 0 {1} from rfl, Finset.sum_insert (by decide),
    Finset.sum_singleton]
  simp only [pow_zero, pow_one]
  have hc0 : coeff 0 (1 : ℚ⟦X⟧) = 1 := by simp
  by_cases he0 : e = 0
  · rw [he0, if_pos rfl, hc0]
    have h2 : coeff 0 h = 0 := by
      rw [hdef, coeff_C_mul]
      have hlog := coeff_logOf_one_sub_X_pow N hN 0
      rw [dif_neg (fun hc => hc.2 rfl)] at hlog
      rw [hlog]; ring
    rw [h2]; simp
  · rw [if_neg he0]
    have hc0' : coeff e (1 : ℚ⟦X⟧) = 0 := by rw [coeff_one]; simp [he0]
    rw [hc0']
    by_cases heN : e = N
    · rw [if_pos heN]
      have h2 : coeff e h = t := by
        rw [hdef, coeff_C_mul, heN]
        have hlog := coeff_logOf_one_sub_X_pow N hN N
        rw [dif_pos ⟨dvd_refl N, hN⟩] at hlog
        rw [hlog]; field_simp
      rw [h2]; simp
    · rw [if_neg heN]
      have h2 : coeff e h = 0 := by
        rw [hdef, coeff_C_mul]
        have hdvd : ¬(N ∣ e) := by
          intro hcontra
          rcases hcontra with ⟨c, hc⟩
          have hcpos : 0 < c := by
            rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos c with h0 | h0
            · rw [h0, mul_zero] at hc; exact absurd hc he0
            · exact h0
          have hecases : e = N := by
            rw [hc]
            have hc1 : c = 1 := by
              rcases Nat.lt_or_ge c 2 with hlt | hge
              · omega
              · exfalso
                have : N * 2 ≤ N * c := by
                  apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
                  omega
                omega
            rw [hc1, mul_one]
          exact heN hecases
        have hlog := coeff_logOf_one_sub_X_pow N hN e
        rw [dif_neg (fun hc => hdvd hc.1)] at hlog
        rw [hlog]; ring
      rw [h2]; simp

name: CongruenceTheory.coeff_N_step
statement:
theorem coeff_N_step (w : ℕ → ℤ) (z : ℕ → ℤ) (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (hz : ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (N - 1), b w (n + 1) = (z (n + 1) : ℚ)) :
    ∃ H : ℤ⟦X⟧, coeff N (AwSeries w) = coeff N (H.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) + b w N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨H, hHeq, hHconst⟩ := head_prod_int w z (N - 1) hz
  refine ⟨H, ?_⟩
  rw [coeff_AwSeries_eq_coeff_prod_range, prod_range_split_top w N hN, hHeq]
  rw [coeff_mul]
  rw [Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ
    (fun i j => coeff i (H.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) * coeff j (rpow (1 - X ^ N : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w N))))]
  have hterm : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      coeff i (H.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) * coeff (N - i) (rpow (1 - X ^ N : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w N))) =
        (if i = N then coeff N (H.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) else 0) +
          (if i = 0 then b w N else 0) := by
    intro i hi
    have hiN : i ≤ N := by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hi; omega
    rw [coeff_rpow_one_sub_X_pow_le N (N - i) (by omega : N ≠ 0) (by omega) (b w N)]
    have hHc0 : coeff 0 (H.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) = 1 := by
      simp [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, hHconst]
    rcases eq_or_ne i 0 with hi0 | hi0
    · have hNi : N - i ≠ 0 := by omega
      have hNiN : N - i = N := by omega
      rw [if_neg hNi, if_pos hNiN, if_neg (show i ≠ N from by omega), if_pos hi0, hi0, hHc0]
      ring
    · rcases eq_or_ne i N with hiN | hiN
      · have hNi0 : N - i = 0 := by omega
        rw [hNi0, if_pos rfl, if_pos hiN, if_neg hi0]
        rw [hiN]
        ring
      · have hNi : N - i ≠ 0 := by omega
        have hNiN : N - i ≠ N := by omega
        rw [if_neg hNi, if_neg hNiN, mul_zero, if_neg hiN, if_neg hi0]
        ring
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' (Finset.range (N + 1)) N (fun _ => coeff N (H.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)))]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' (Finset.range (N + 1)) 0 (fun _ => b w N)]
  simp [Finset.mem_range]

name: CongruenceTheory.euler_integrality_i_imp_ii
statement:
theorem euler_integrality_i_imp_ii (w : ℕ → ℤ)
    (hi : ∀ e : ℕ, ∃ m : ℤ, coeff e (AwSeries w) = (m : ℚ)) :
    ∀ N ≥ 1, ∃ z : ℤ, b w N = z
proof:
:= by
  intro N
  induction N using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ N ihN =>
    intro hN1
    have hz : ∀ n, ∃ zn : ℤ, (n ≥ 1 → n < N → b w n = zn) ∧ (¬(n ≥ 1 ∧ n < N) → zn = 0) := by
      intro n
      by_cases hcase : n ≥ 1 ∧ n < N
      · obtain ⟨zn, hzn⟩ := ihN n hcase.2 hcase.1
        exact ⟨zn, fun _ _ => hzn, fun hc => absurd hcase hc⟩
      · exact ⟨0, fun h1 h2 => absurd ⟨h1, h2⟩ hcase, fun _ => rfl⟩
    choose zfun hzfun1 hzfun2 using hz
    have hzeq : ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (N - 1), b w (n + 1) = (zfun (n + 1) : ℚ) := by
      intro n hn
      have hn' := Finset.mem_range.mp hn
      exact hzfun1 (n + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    obtain ⟨H, hHstep⟩ := coeff_N_step w zfun N hN1 hzeq
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hi N
    have hmH : coeff N (H.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) = ((coeff N H : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
      rw [coeff_map]; rfl
    set mH : ℤ := coeff N H with hmHdef
    refine ⟨m - mH, ?_⟩
    rw [hm, hmH] at hHstep
    have hbN : b w N = (m : ℚ) - (mH : ℚ) := by linarith [hHstep]
    rw [hbN]
    push_cast
    ring

name: CongruenceTheory.dvd_sum_of_const_on_classes
statement:
theorem dvd_sum_of_const_on_classes (r : ι → ι → Prop) (hrefl : ∀ x, r x x)
    (hsymm : ∀ x y, r x y → r y x) (htrans : ∀ x y z, r x y → r y z → r x z)
    [DecidableRel r] (f : ι → MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) (hf : ∀ x y, r x y → f x = f y)
    (d : ℕ) :
    ∀ s : Finset ι, (∀ x ∈ s, (d : ℤ) ∣ ((s.filter (r x)).card : ℤ)) →
      ∃ Q : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ, ∑ x ∈ s, f x = (d : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) * Q
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  induction s using Finset.strongInduction with
  | _ s ih =>
    intro hcard
    rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | ⟨x0, hx0⟩
    · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    · set c := s.filter (r x0) with hcdef
      have hx0c : x0 ∈ c := by simp [hcdef, hrefl x0, hx0]
      have hcsub : c ⊆ s := Finset.filter_subset _ _
      have hsdiffssubset : s \ c ⊂ s := Finset.sdiff_ssubset hcsub ⟨x0, hx0c⟩
      have hsplit : s = c ∪ s \ c := (Finset.union_sdiff_of_subset hcsub).symm
      have hdisj : Disjoint c (s \ c) := Finset.disjoint_sdiff
      have hconst : ∀ x ∈ c, f x = f x0 := by
        intro x hx
        simp only [hcdef, Finset.mem_filter] at hx
        exact (hf x0 x hx.2).symm
      have hcsum : ∑ x ∈ c, f x = (c.card : ℤ) • f x0 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hconst, Finset.sum_const]
        simp [zsmul_eq_mul]
      obtain ⟨Qc, hQc⟩ : ∃ Qc, (c.card : ℤ) = (d : ℤ) * Qc := hcard x0 hx0
      have hcsum' : ∑ x ∈ c, f x = (d : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) * ((Qc : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) * f x0) := by
        rw [hcsum, hQc]
        simp only [zsmul_eq_mul, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast]
        ring
      have hrec : ∀ x ∈ s \ c, (d : ℤ) ∣ (((s \ c).filter (r x)).card : ℤ) := by
        intro x hx
