        have hxs : x ∈ s := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hx).1
        have hxc : x ∉ c := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hx).2
        have heq : (s \ c).filter (r x) = s.filter (r x) := by
          ext y
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_sdiff]
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨⟨hys, _⟩, hry⟩
            exact ⟨hys, hry⟩
          · rintro ⟨hys, hry⟩
            refine ⟨⟨hys, ?_⟩, hry⟩
            intro hyc
            simp only [hcdef, Finset.mem_filter] at hyc
            exact hxc (by
              simp only [hcdef, Finset.mem_filter]
              exact ⟨hxs, htrans x0 y x hyc.2 (hsymm x y hry)⟩)
        rw [heq]
        exact hcard x hxs
      obtain ⟨Qrest, hQrest⟩ := ih (s \ c) hsdiffssubset hrec
      refine ⟨(Qc : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) * f x0 + Qrest, ?_⟩
      rw [hsplit, Finset.sum_union hdisj, hcsum', hQrest]
      ring

name: CongruenceTheory.Cperm_mul
statement:
theorem Cperm_mul (n k : ℕ) :
    Cperm n * Cperm k =
      ∑ p : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) × Equiv.Perm (Fin k), ci (Equiv.Perm.sumCongr p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Cperm, Finset.sum_mul_sum, ← ci_sumCongr]
  symm
  exact Fintype.sum_prod_type
    (f := fun p : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) × Equiv.Perm (Fin k) =>
      ci (Equiv.Perm.sumCongr p.1 p.2))

name: CongruenceTheory.ciExp_add
statement:
lemma ciExp_add (a a' : ℕ) (m m' : Multiset ℕ) :
    ciExp a m + ciExp a' m' = ciExp (a + a') (m + m')
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, ciExp_apply, Multiset.count_add]
  by_cases hj : j = 1 <;> simp [hj] <;> omega

name: CongruenceTheory.multiset_add_eq_singleton_iff
statement:
lemma multiset_add_eq_singleton_iff {A B : Multiset ℕ} {x : ℕ} :
    A + B = {x} ↔ (A = {x} ∧ B = 0) ∨ (A = 0 ∧ B = {x})
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hcard : Multiset.card A + Multiset.card B = 1 := by
      rw [← Multiset.card_add, h]; simp
    have hcase : Multiset.card A = 0 ∨ Multiset.card A = 1 := by omega
    rcases hcase with hA | hA
    · right
      have hA0 : A = 0 := Multiset.card_eq_zero.mp hA
      refine ⟨hA0, ?_⟩
      rw [hA0, zero_add] at h
      exact h
    · left
      obtain ⟨a, hAa⟩ := Multiset.card_eq_one.mp hA
      have hB0 : B = 0 := Multiset.card_eq_zero.mp (by omega)
      rw [hAa, hB0, add_zero] at h
      have hax : a = x := Multiset.mem_singleton.mp (h ▸ Multiset.mem_singleton_self a)
      rw [hAa, hax]
      exact ⟨rfl, hB0⟩
  · rintro (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩) <;> simp

name: CongruenceTheory.coeff_ci_sumCongr_target
statement:
lemma coeff_ci_sumCongr_target {n k : ℕ} (p : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) × Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) :
    MvPolynomial.coeff (ciExp (n + k - 2) {2}) (ci (Equiv.Perm.sumCongr p.1 p.2)) =
      (if p.1.cycleType = {2} ∧ p.2.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ) else 0) +
      (if p.1.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) ∧ p.2.cycleType = {2} then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ci_sumCongr, ci_eq_monomial, ci_eq_monomial, MvPolynomial.monomial_mul, one_mul,
    MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial]
  have hn : p.1.cycleType.sum ≤ n := by
    have := Equiv.Perm.sum_cycleType_le p.1; simpa using this
  have hk : p.2.cycleType.sum ≤ k := by
    have := Equiv.Perm.sum_cycleType_le p.2; simpa using this
  have hgne : ∀ x ∈ p.1.cycleType, x ≠ 1 := fun x hx => by
    have := Equiv.Perm.two_le_of_mem_cycleType hx; omega
  have hgne' : ∀ x ∈ p.2.cycleType, x ≠ 1 := fun x hx => by
    have := Equiv.Perm.two_le_of_mem_cycleType hx; omega
  have hgnesum : ∀ x ∈ p.1.cycleType + p.2.cycleType, x ≠ 1 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Multiset.mem_add] at hx
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · exact hgne x hx
    · exact hgne' x hx
  have h2ne : ∀ x ∈ ({2} : Multiset ℕ), x ≠ 1 := by intro x hx; simp at hx; omega
  have key : (ciExp (n - p.1.cycleType.sum) p.1.cycleType +
      ciExp (k - p.2.cycleType.sum) p.2.cycleType = ciExp (n + k - 2) ({2} : Multiset ℕ)) ↔
      (p.1.cycleType = {2} ∧ p.2.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ)) ∨
        (p.1.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) ∧ p.2.cycleType = {2}) := by
    rw [ciExp_add, ciExp_eq_iff hgnesum h2ne, ← multiset_add_eq_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · exact fun h => h.2
    · intro h
      refine ⟨?_, h⟩
      have hsum2 : p.1.cycleType.sum + p.2.cycleType.sum = 2 := by
        have := congrArg Multiset.sum h; simpa using this
      omega
  simp only [key]
  by_cases h1 : p.1.cycleType = {2} ∧ p.2.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ)
  · have h2 : ¬ (p.1.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) ∧ p.2.cycleType = {2}) := by
      rintro ⟨h2a, -⟩
      rw [h1.1] at h2a
      exact absurd h2a (by decide)
    rw [if_pos (Or.inl h1), if_pos h1, if_neg h2]; ring
  · by_cases h2 : p.1.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) ∧ p.2.cycleType = {2}
    · rw [if_pos (Or.inr h2), if_neg h1, if_pos h2]; ring
    · rw [if_neg (not_or.mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩), if_neg h1, if_neg h2]; ring

name: CongruenceTheory.card_cycleType_zero
statement:
lemma card_cycleType_zero (N : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin N) => σ.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ))).card
      = 1
proof:
:= by
  have : (Finset.univ.filter (fun σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin N) => σ.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ))) =
      {1} := by
    ext σ
    simp [Equiv.Perm.cycleType_eq_zero]
  rw [this]; simp

name: CongruenceTheory.coeff_Cperm_mul
statement:
theorem coeff_Cperm_mul (n k : ℕ) :
    MvPolynomial.coeff (ciExp (n + k - 2) {2}) (Cperm n * Cperm k) =
      twoCycleCount n + twoCycleCount k
proof:
:= by
  rw [Cperm_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_sum]
  have hpt : ∀ p : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) × Equiv.Perm (Fin k),
      MvPolynomial.coeff (ciExp (n + k - 2) {2}) (ci (Equiv.Perm.sumCongr p.1 p.2)) =
      (if p.1.cycleType = ({2} : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ) else 0) *
        (if p.2.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ) else 0) +
      (if p.1.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ) else 0) *
        (if p.2.cycleType = ({2} : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ) else 0) := by
    intro p
    rw [coeff_ci_sumCongr_target]
    by_cases h1 : p.1.cycleType = ({2} : Multiset ℕ) <;>
      by_cases h2 : p.2.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) <;>
      by_cases h3 : p.1.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) <;>
      by_cases h4 : p.2.cycleType = ({2} : Multiset ℕ) <;>
      simp_all
  simp_rw [hpt]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  dsimp only
  have e1 : (∑ x : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), (if x.cycleType = ({2} : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)) *
      (∑ y : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), (if y.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)) =
      ∑ x : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), ∑ y : Equiv.Perm (Fin k),
        (if x.cycleType = {2} then (1 : ℤ) else 0) * (if y.cycleType = 0 then (1 : ℤ) else 0) :=
    Finset.sum_mul_sum Finset.univ Finset.univ _ _
  have e2 : (∑ x : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), (if x.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)) *
      (∑ y : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), (if y.cycleType = ({2} : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)) =
      ∑ x : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), ∑ y : Equiv.Perm (Fin k),
        (if x.cycleType = 0 then (1 : ℤ) else 0) * (if y.cycleType = {2} then (1 : ℤ) else 0) :=
    Finset.sum_mul_sum Finset.univ Finset.univ _ _
  rw [← e1, ← e2]
  have hz1 : (∑ x : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), (if x.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ) else 0))
      = 1 := by
    have heq : (∑ x : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), (if x.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ) else 0))
        = ((Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) => x.cycleType = 0)).card : ℤ) := by
      rw [Finset.card_filter]; push_cast; rfl
    rw [heq, card_cycleType_zero]; norm_num
  have hz2 : (∑ y : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), (if y.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ) else 0))
      = 1 := by
    have heq : (∑ y : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), (if y.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ) else 0))
        = ((Finset.univ.filter (fun y : Equiv.Perm (Fin k) => y.cycleType = 0)).card : ℤ) := by
      rw [Finset.card_filter]; push_cast; rfl
    rw [heq, card_cycleType_zero]; norm_num
  rw [hz1, hz2, mul_one, one_mul]
  simp only [twoCycleCount, Finset.card_filter]
  push_cast
  ring

name: CongruenceTheory.ci_eq_monomial'
statement:
lemma ci_eq_monomial' {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (g : Equiv.Perm α) :
    ci g = MvPolynomial.monomial (ciExp (Fintype.card α - g.cycleType.sum) g.cycleType)
      (1 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ci
  rw [pow_mul_multisetProd_eq_monomial]

name: CongruenceTheory.coeff_sum_ci_eq_card_cycleType
statement:
theorem coeff_sum_ci_eq_card_cycleType {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (m : Multiset ℕ) (hm2 : ∀ x ∈ m, 2 ≤ x) :
    MvPolynomial.coeff (ciExp (Fintype.card α - m.sum) m) (∑ g : Equiv.Perm α, ci g) =
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Equiv.Perm α => g.cycleType = m)).card : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_sum]
  have hcast : ((Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Equiv.Perm α => g.cycleType = m)).card : ℤ) =
      ∑ g : Equiv.Perm α, (if g.cycleType = m then (1 : ℤ) else 0) := by
    rw [Finset.card_filter]; push_cast; rfl
  rw [hcast]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro g _
  rw [ci_eq_monomial', MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial]
  have hgne : ∀ x ∈ g.cycleType, x ≠ 1 := fun x hx => by
    have := Equiv.Perm.two_le_of_mem_cycleType hx; omega
  have hmne : ∀ x ∈ m, x ≠ 1 := fun x hx => by have := hm2 x hx; omega
  by_cases hgm : g.cycleType = m
  · simp [hgm]
  · have hne : ciExp (Fintype.card α - g.cycleType.sum) g.cycleType ≠
        ciExp (Fintype.card α - m.sum) m := by
      intro hcontra
      exact hgm ((ciExp_eq_iff hgne hmne).mp hcontra).2
    simp [hne, Ne.symm hne, hgm]

name: CongruenceTheory.coeff_CpermPair
statement:
theorem coeff_CpermPair (n k : ℕ) :
    MvPolynomial.coeff (ciExp (n + k - 2) {2}) (CpermPair n k) =
      ((Finset.univ.filter
        (fun g : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k) => g.cycleType = ({2} : Multiset ℕ))).card : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin n ⊕ Fin k) = n + k := by simp
  have := coeff_sum_ci_eq_card_cycleType (α := Fin n ⊕ Fin k) ({2} : Multiset ℕ) (by
    intro x hx; simp at hx; omega)
  rw [hcard] at this
  exact this

name: CongruenceTheory.card_twoCycle_eq_choose
statement:
theorem card_twoCycle_eq_choose {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Equiv.Perm α => g.cycleType = ({2} : Multiset ℕ))).card =
      (Fintype.card α).choose 2
proof:
:= by
  have hcard := Equiv.Perm.card_of_cycleType α ({2} : Multiset ℕ)
  rw [show (Finset.univ.filter (fun σ : Equiv.Perm α => σ.cycleType = {2})) =
      ({g : Equiv.Perm α | g.cycleType = {2}} : Finset (Equiv.Perm α)) from rfl,
    hcard]
  by_cases hN : 2 ≤ Fintype.card α
  · rw [if_pos (by simp [hN]), Nat.choose_eq_factorial_div_factorial hN]
    simp only [Multiset.sum_singleton, Multiset.prod_singleton, Multiset.toFinset_singleton,
      Finset.prod_singleton, Multiset.count_singleton_self, Nat.factorial_one]
    have hdenom : (Fintype.card α - 2)! * 2 * 1 = (2 : ℕ)! * (Fintype.card α - 2)! := by
      norm_num [Nat.factorial]
      ring
    rw [hdenom]
  · rw [if_neg (by simp [hN]), Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega)]

name: CongruenceTheory.two_mul_card_twoCycle
statement:
theorem two_mul_card_twoCycle {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] :
    2 * ((Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Equiv.Perm α => g.cycleType = ({2} : Multiset ℕ))).card :
      ℤ) = (Fintype.card α : ℤ) * ((Fintype.card α : ℤ) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_twoCycle_eq_choose]
  have heq2 : 2 * ((Fintype.card α).choose 2) = (Fintype.card α) * (Fintype.card α - 1) := by
    rw [Nat.choose_two_right, mul_comm 2,
      Nat.div_two_mul_two_of_even (Nat.even_mul_pred_self (Fintype.card α))]
  have hcast : (2 : ℤ) * ((Fintype.card α).choose 2 : ℤ) =
      ((Fintype.card α) * (Fintype.card α - 1) : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast heq2
  rw [hcast]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Fintype.card α) with h | h
  · simp [h]
  · push_cast [Nat.cast_sub h]
    ring

name: CongruenceTheory.two_mul_twoCycleCount
statement: theorem two_mul_twoCycleCount (N : ℕ) : 2 * twoCycleCount N = (N : ℤ) * ((N : ℤ) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := two_mul_card_twoCycle (α := Fin N)
  rw [Fintype.card_fin] at h
  rw [show twoCycleCount N = ((Finset.univ.filter
      (fun g : Equiv.Perm (Fin N) => g.cycleType = ({2} : Multiset ℕ))).card : ℤ) from rfl]
  exact h

name: CongruenceTheory.coeff_defect_eq_nk
statement:
theorem coeff_defect_eq_nk (n k : ℕ) :
    MvPolynomial.coeff (ciExp (n + k - 2) {2}) (CpermPair n k - Cperm n * Cperm k) =
      (n : ℤ) * k
proof:
:= by
  rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_sub, coeff_CpermPair, coeff_Cperm_mul]
  have hpair := two_mul_card_twoCycle (α := Fin n ⊕ Fin k)
  simp only [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin] at hpair
  have key : 2 * (((Finset.univ.filter
      (fun g : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k) => g.cycleType = ({2} : Multiset ℕ))).card : ℤ) -
      (twoCycleCount n + twoCycleCount k)) = 2 * ((n : ℤ) * k) := by
    rw [mul_sub, hpair, mul_add, two_mul_twoCycleCount, two_mul_twoCycleCount]
    push_cast
    ring
  have h2 : (2 : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ h2 key

name: CongruenceTheory.Aw_finiteWidth
statement:
theorem Aw_finiteWidth (w : ℕ → ℤ) (h : ℕ) (hw : ∀ j, h < j → w j = 0) (n : ℕ) :
    Aw w (n + 1) =
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (min (n + 1) h), (fall n r : ℤ) * w (r + 1) * Aw w (n - r)
proof:
:= by
  have hfull : Aw w (n + 1) =
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (fall n r : ℤ) * w (r + 1) * Aw w (n - r) := by
    rw [Aw, C_succ, map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro r _
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, MvPolynomial.eval_X, map_intCast]
    show (fall n r : ℤ) * (w (r + 1) * Aw w (n - r)) = fall n r * w (r + 1) * Aw w (n - r)
    ring
  rw [hfull]
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset
  · intro x hx
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hx ⊢
    omega
  · intro r hr hrnot
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hr
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hrnot
    have : w (r + 1) = 0 := hw (r + 1) (by omega)
    rw [this]
    ring

name: CongruenceTheory.deriv_injective_of_const
statement:
theorem deriv_injective_of_const (f g : A⟦X⟧) (hderiv : d⁄dX A f = d⁄dX A g)
    (hconst : constantCoeff f = constantCoeff g) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  cases n with
  | zero => simpa using hconst
  | succ n =>
    have h := congrArg (coeff n) hderiv
    rw [coeff_derivative, coeff_derivative] at h
    have hcast : ((n : A) + 1) = algebraMap ℚ A ((n : ℚ) + 1) := by simp
    have hq : ((n : ℚ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hinv : algebraMap ℚ A ((n : ℚ) + 1) * algebraMap ℚ A ((n : ℚ) + 1)⁻¹ = 1 := by
      rw [← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hq, map_one]
    have h2 := congrArg (· * algebraMap ℚ A ((n : ℚ) + 1)⁻¹) h
    simp only [hcast, mul_assoc, hinv, mul_one] at h2
    exact h2

name: CongruenceTheory.coeff_one_add_X
statement:
lemma coeff_one_add_X (i : ℕ) :
    coeff i (1 + X : A⟦X⟧) = if i = 0 then 1 else if i = 1 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_add]
  rcases i with _ | _ | i
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp [coeff_X]

name: CongruenceTheory.geom_inv
statement: theorem geom_inv : (1 + X : A⟦X⟧) * (mk fun n => algebraMap ℚ A ((-1 : ℚ) ^ n)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [coeff_mul]
  rw [Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ
    (fun i j => coeff i (1 + X : A⟦X⟧) * coeff j (mk fun n => algebraMap ℚ A ((-1 : ℚ) ^ n)))]
  rcases n with _ | n
  · simp [coeff_one_add_X, coeff_one]
  · rw [show ∑ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1 + 1), coeff x (1 + X : A⟦X⟧) *
          coeff (n + 1 - x) (mk fun n => algebraMap ℚ A ((-1 : ℚ) ^ n)) =
        ∑ x ∈ ({0, 1} : Finset ℕ), coeff x (1 + X : A⟦X⟧) *
          coeff (n + 1 - x) (mk fun n => algebraMap ℚ A ((-1 : ℚ) ^ n)) from by
      symm
      apply Finset.sum_subset
      · intro x hx
        simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
        rw [Finset.mem_range]; omega
      · intro x hx hxnot
        simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, not_or] at hxnot
        rw [coeff_one_add_X, if_neg hxnot.1, if_neg hxnot.2]
        ring]
    rw [Finset.sum_pair (show (0 : ℕ) ≠ 1 by omega)]
    rw [coeff_one_add_X, coeff_one_add_X]
    simp only [reduceIte]
    rw [coeff_mk, coeff_mk]
    rw [show (n + 1 - 0 = n + 1) from by omega, show (n + 1 - 1 = n) from by omega]
    rw [coeff_one, if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)]
    have hsum : ((-1 : ℚ)) ^ (n + 1) + (-1 : ℚ) ^ n = 0 := by ring
    have hz : algebraMap ℚ A (((-1 : ℚ)) ^ (n + 1)) + algebraMap ℚ A ((-1 : ℚ) ^ n) = 0 := by
      rw [← map_add, hsum, map_zero]
    simp only [show (1 : ℕ) ≠ 0 from one_ne_zero, ite_self]
    linear_combination hz

name: CongruenceTheory.hasSubst_sub_one
statement: theorem hasSubst_sub_one {f : A⟦X⟧} (hf : constantCoeff f = 1) : HasSubst (f - 1)
proof:
:=
  HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' (by simp [hf])

name: CongruenceTheory.subst_one_eq
statement: theorem subst_one_eq {a : A⟦X⟧} (ha : HasSubst a) : (1 : A⟦X⟧).subst a = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coe_substAlgHom ha, map_one]

name: CongruenceTheory.f_mul_geomSubst
statement: theorem f_mul_geomSubst (f : A⟦X⟧) (hf : constantCoeff f = 1) : f * geomSubst f hf = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hsub := hasSubst_sub_one hf
  have heq : ((1 + X : A⟦X⟧) * (mk fun n => algebraMap ℚ A ((-1 : ℚ) ^ n))).subst (f - 1) =
      (1 : A⟦X⟧).subst (f - 1) := by rw [geom_inv]
  rw [subst_mul hsub, subst_add hsub, subst_one_eq hsub, subst_X hsub] at heq
  simp only [geomSubst]
  rw [show (1 : A⟦X⟧) + (f - 1) = f from by ring] at heq
  exact heq

name: CongruenceTheory.deriv_logOf_mul_self
statement:
theorem deriv_logOf_mul_self (f : A⟦X⟧) (hf : constantCoeff f = 1) :
    d⁄dX A (logOf f) * f = d⁄dX A f
proof:
:= by
  have hsub := hasSubst_sub_one hf
  rw [logOf_eq, derivative_subst A hsub]
  have hd : d⁄dX A (f - 1) = d⁄dX A f := by
    rw [Derivation.map_sub (d⁄dX A) f 1, Derivation.map_one_eq_zero (d⁄dX A), sub_zero]
  rw [hd, deriv_log]
  rw [show ((mk fun n => algebraMap ℚ A ((-1 : ℚ) ^ n)).subst (f - 1)) = geomSubst f hf from rfl]
  rw [mul_assoc]
  calc geomSubst f hf * (d⁄dX A f * f) = (geomSubst f hf * f) * d⁄dX A f := by ring
    _ = (f * geomSubst f hf) * d⁄dX A f := by ring
    _ = d⁄dX A f := by rw [f_mul_geomSubst f hf]; ring

name: CongruenceTheory.logOf_mul
statement:
theorem logOf_mul (f g : A⟦X⟧) (hf : constantCoeff f = 1) (hg : constantCoeff g = 1) :
    logOf (f * g) = logOf f + logOf g
proof:
:= by
  have hfg : constantCoeff (f * g) = 1 := by rw [map_mul, hf, hg, mul_one]
  apply deriv_injective_of_const
  · have h1 := deriv_logOf_mul_self (f * g) hfg
    have h2 := deriv_logOf_mul_self f hf
    have h3 := deriv_logOf_mul_self g hg
    have hleib0 := Derivation.leibniz (d⁄dX A) f g
    rw [smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul] at hleib0
    have hunit : IsUnit (f * g) := isUnit_iff_constantCoeff.mpr (by rw [hfg]; exact isUnit_one)
    apply hunit.mul_right_cancel
    rw [map_add, add_mul]
    linear_combination h1 - g * h2 - f * h3 + hleib0
  · rw [map_add, constantCoeff_logOf hfg, constantCoeff_logOf hf, constantCoeff_logOf hg, add_zero]

name: CongruenceTheory.canonicalCoord_mul
statement:
theorem canonicalCoord_mul (m : ℕ) (f g : A⟦X⟧) (hf : constantCoeff f = 1)
    (hg : constantCoeff g = 1) :
    canonicalCoord m (f * g) = canonicalCoord m f + canonicalCoord m g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [canonicalCoord, logOf_mul f g hf hg, map_add]
  ring

name: CongruenceTheory.constantCoeff_subst_of_const_zero
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_subst_of_const_zero (f g : A⟦X⟧) (hg : constantCoeff g = 0)
    (hsub : HasSubst g) : constantCoeff (f.subst g) = constantCoeff f
proof:
:= by
  show MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (subst g f) = constantCoeff f
  rw [constantCoeff_subst hsub f]
  rw [finsum_eq_single _ 0]
  · simp
  · intro d hd
    have hz : MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (g ^ d) = 0 := by
      show constantCoeff (g ^ d) = 0
      rw [map_pow, hg]
      exact zero_pow hd
    rw [hz, smul_zero]

name: CongruenceTheory.logOf_exp
statement: theorem logOf_exp (g : A⟦X⟧) (hg : constantCoeff g = 0) : logOf ((exp A).subst g) = g
proof:
:= by
  have hsub := HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' hg
  have hexp1 : constantCoeff ((exp A).subst g) = 1 := by
    rw [constantCoeff_subst_of_const_zero (exp A) g hg hsub, constantCoeff_exp]
  apply deriv_injective_of_const
  · have h1 := deriv_logOf_mul_self ((exp A).subst g) hexp1
    have hchain : d⁄dX A ((exp A).subst g) = (exp A).subst g * d⁄dX A g := by
      rw [derivative_subst A hsub, derivative_exp]
    have hunit : IsUnit ((exp A).subst g) :=
      isUnit_iff_constantCoeff.mpr (by rw [hexp1]; exact isUnit_one)
    apply hunit.mul_right_cancel
    rw [hchain] at h1
    linear_combination h1
  · rw [constantCoeff_logOf hexp1, hg]

name: CongruenceTheory.constantCoeff_geomSubst
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_geomSubst (f : A⟦X⟧) (hf : constantCoeff f = 1) :
    constantCoeff (geomSubst f hf) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := f_mul_geomSubst f hf
  have hc := congrArg constantCoeff h
  rw [map_mul, hf, map_one, one_mul] at hc
  exact hc

name: CongruenceTheory.ginv_mul_f
statement: theorem ginv_mul_f (f : A⟦X⟧) (hf : constantCoeff f = 1) : geomSubst f hf * f = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm]; exact f_mul_geomSubst f hf

name: CongruenceTheory.deriv_ginv_mul
statement:
theorem deriv_ginv_mul (f : A⟦X⟧) (hf : constantCoeff f = 1) :
    d⁄dX A (geomSubst f hf) * f = -(d⁄dX A f * geomSubst f hf)
proof:
:= by
  have hprod := f_mul_geomSubst f hf
  have hd := congrArg (d⁄dX A) hprod
  have hleib := Derivation.leibniz (d⁄dX A) f (geomSubst f hf)
  rw [smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul] at hleib
  rw [hleib, Derivation.map_one_eq_zero (d⁄dX A)] at hd
  linear_combination hd

name: CongruenceTheory.exp_logOf
statement: theorem exp_logOf (f : A⟦X⟧) (hf : constantCoeff f = 1) : (exp A).subst (logOf f) = f
proof:
:= by
  have hlogsub : HasSubst (logOf f) := HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' (constantCoeff_logOf hf)
  set h := (exp A).subst (logOf f) with hh_def
  set ginv := geomSubst f hf with hginv_def
  have hh1 : constantCoeff h = 1 := by
    rw [hh_def, constantCoeff_subst_of_const_zero (exp A) (logOf f) (constantCoeff_logOf hf)
      hlogsub, constantCoeff_exp]
  have hDh : d⁄dX A h = h * d⁄dX A (logOf f) := by
    rw [hh_def, derivative_subst A hlogsub, derivative_exp]
  have hDlogf := deriv_logOf_mul_self f hf
  have hfginv : f * ginv = 1 := by rw [hginv_def]; exact f_mul_geomSubst f hf
  have hDginv := deriv_ginv_mul f hf
  have key : d⁄dX A (logOf f) = d⁄dX A f * ginv := by
    linear_combination ginv * hDlogf - d⁄dX A (logOf f) * hfginv
  set k := h * ginv with hk_def
  have hDk : d⁄dX A k = 0 := by
    have hleib := Derivation.leibniz (d⁄dX A) h ginv
    rw [smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul] at hleib
    rw [hk_def, hleib]
    linear_combination h * (ginv * hDginv - d⁄dX A (geomSubst f hf) * hfginv) +
      ginv * hDh + h * ginv * key
  have hk1 : constantCoeff k = 1 := by
    rw [hk_def, map_mul, hh1, one_mul]
    have hc := congrArg constantCoeff hfginv
    rw [map_mul, hf, one_mul] at hc
    exact hc
  have hkeq1 : k = 1 := deriv_injective_of_const k 1 (by rw [hDk]; simp) (by rw [hk1]; simp)
  have heq : h * ginv = f * ginv := by rw [← hk_def, hkeq1, ← hfginv]
  have hunit_ginv : IsUnit ginv := isUnit_iff_constantCoeff.mpr (by
    rw [hginv_def, constantCoeff_geomSubst f hf]; exact isUnit_one)
  exact hunit_ginv.mul_left_cancel (by rw [mul_comm ginv h, mul_comm ginv f]; exact heq)

name: CongruenceTheory.logOf_one
statement: theorem logOf_one : logOf (1 : A⟦X⟧) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc1 : constantCoeff (1 : A⟦X⟧) = 1 := by simp
  have hd : d⁄dX A (logOf (1 : A⟦X⟧)) = d⁄dX A (0 : A⟦X⟧) := by
    have hh := deriv_logOf_mul_self (1 : A⟦X⟧) hc1
    simpa using hh
  exact deriv_injective_of_const _ _ (by rw [hd]) (by rw [constantCoeff_logOf hc1]; simp)

name: CongruenceTheory.logOf_inv
statement:
theorem logOf_inv (f : A⟦X⟧) (hf : constantCoeff f = 1) :
    logOf (geomSubst f hf) = -logOf f
proof:
:= by
  have h := logOf_mul f (geomSubst f hf) hf (constantCoeff_geomSubst f hf)
  rw [f_mul_geomSubst f hf, logOf_one] at h
  linear_combination -h

name: CongruenceTheory.canonicalCoord_inv
statement:
theorem canonicalCoord_inv (m : ℕ) (f : A⟦X⟧) (hf : constantCoeff f = 1) :
    canonicalCoord m (geomSubst f hf) = -canonicalCoord m f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [canonicalCoord, logOf_inv f hf, map_neg]
  ring

name: CongruenceTheory.logOf_pow
statement:
theorem logOf_pow (f : A⟦X⟧) (hf : constantCoeff f = 1) (n : ℕ) :
    logOf (f ^ n) = (n : A⟦X⟧) * logOf f
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [pow_zero, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul]; exact logOf_one
  | succ n ih =>
    have hfn1 : constantCoeff (f ^ n) = 1 := by rw [map_pow, hf, one_pow]
    have hstep : logOf (f ^ (n + 1)) = logOf (f ^ n) + logOf f := by
      rw [pow_succ, logOf_mul (f ^ n) f hfn1 hf]
    rw [hstep, ih]
    push_cast
    ring

name: CongruenceTheory.canonicalCoord_pow
statement:
theorem canonicalCoord_pow (m : ℕ) (f : A⟦X⟧) (hf : constantCoeff f = 1) (n : ℕ) :
    canonicalCoord m (f ^ n) = (n : A) * canonicalCoord m f
proof:
:= by
  have hcoeff : coeff m ((n : A⟦X⟧) * logOf f) = (n : A) * coeff m (logOf f) := by
    rw [← nsmul_eq_mul, map_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul]
  simp only [canonicalCoord, logOf_pow f hf n, hcoeff]
  ring

name: CongruenceTheory.ci_conj
statement:
lemma ci_conj {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (h g : Equiv.Perm α) :
    ci (h * g * h⁻¹) = ci g
proof:
:= by
  simp [ci, Equiv.Perm.cycleType_conj]

name: CongruenceTheory.cycleType_sumCongr_one_right
statement:
lemma cycleType_sumCongr_one_right {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m]
    [DecidableEq n] (σ : Equiv.Perm m) :
    (Equiv.Perm.sumCongr σ (1 : Equiv.Perm n)).cycleType = σ.cycleType
proof:
:= by
  set f : m ≃ Subtype (· ∈ Set.range (Sum.inl : m → m ⊕ n)) :=
    Equiv.ofInjective Sum.inl Sum.inl_injective with hf
  have hext : σ.extendDomain f = Equiv.Perm.sumCongr σ (1 : Equiv.Perm n) := by
    ext x
    cases x with
    | inl a =>
      have himg : (f a : m ⊕ n) = Sum.inl a := rfl
      rw [← himg, Equiv.Perm.extendDomain_apply_image]
      rfl
    | inr b =>
      have hnp : (Sum.inr b : m ⊕ n) ∉ Set.range (Sum.inl : m → m ⊕ n) := by
        rintro ⟨a, ha⟩; cases ha
      rw [Equiv.Perm.extendDomain_apply_not_subtype σ f hnp]
      simp
  rw [← hext, Equiv.Perm.cycleType_extendDomain]

name: CongruenceTheory.cycleType_sumCongr_one_left
statement:
lemma cycleType_sumCongr_one_left {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m]
    [DecidableEq n] (τ : Equiv.Perm n) :
    (Equiv.Perm.sumCongr (1 : Equiv.Perm m) τ).cycleType = τ.cycleType
proof:
:= by
  set f : n ≃ Subtype (· ∈ Set.range (Sum.inr : n → m ⊕ n)) :=
    Equiv.ofInjective Sum.inr Sum.inr_injective with hf
  have hext : τ.extendDomain f = Equiv.Perm.sumCongr (1 : Equiv.Perm m) τ := by
    ext x
    cases x with
    | inr b =>
      have himg : (f b : m ⊕ n) = Sum.inr b := rfl
      rw [← himg, Equiv.Perm.extendDomain_apply_image]
      rfl
    | inl a =>
      have hnp : (Sum.inl a : m ⊕ n) ∉ Set.range (Sum.inr : n → m ⊕ n) := by
        rintro ⟨b, hb⟩; cases hb
      rw [Equiv.Perm.extendDomain_apply_not_subtype τ f hnp]
      simp
  rw [← hext, Equiv.Perm.cycleType_extendDomain]

name: CongruenceTheory.disjoint_sumCongr_one
statement:
lemma disjoint_sumCongr_one {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (σ : Equiv.Perm m) (τ : Equiv.Perm n) :
    Equiv.Perm.Disjoint (Equiv.Perm.sumCongr σ (1 : Equiv.Perm n))
      (Equiv.Perm.sumCongr (1 : Equiv.Perm m) τ)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  cases x with
  | inl a => right; simp
  | inr b => left; simp

name: CongruenceTheory.cycleType_sumCongr
statement:
theorem cycleType_sumCongr {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (σ : Equiv.Perm m) (τ : Equiv.Perm n) :
    (Equiv.Perm.sumCongr σ τ).cycleType = σ.cycleType + τ.cycleType
proof:
:= by
  have hmul : Equiv.Perm.sumCongr σ τ =
      Equiv.Perm.sumCongr σ (1 : Equiv.Perm n) * Equiv.Perm.sumCongr (1 : Equiv.Perm m) τ := by
    ext x
    cases x with
    | inl a => simp
    | inr b => simp
  rw [hmul, (disjoint_sumCongr_one σ τ).cycleType_mul, cycleType_sumCongr_one_right,
    cycleType_sumCongr_one_left]

name: CongruenceTheory.ci_sumCongr
statement:
theorem ci_sumCongr {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (σ : Equiv.Perm m) (τ : Equiv.Perm n) :
    ci (Equiv.Perm.sumCongr σ τ) = ci σ * ci τ
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : Fintype.card (m ⊕ n) = Fintype.card m + Fintype.card n := Fintype.card_sum
  have hle1 : σ.cycleType.sum ≤ Fintype.card m := Equiv.Perm.sum_cycleType_le σ
  have hle2 : τ.cycleType.sum ≤ Fintype.card n := Equiv.Perm.sum_cycleType_le τ
  simp only [ci, cycleType_sumCongr, Multiset.sum_add, Multiset.map_add, Multiset.prod_add,
    hcard]
  rw [show Fintype.card m + Fintype.card n - (σ.cycleType.sum + τ.cycleType.sum) =
      (Fintype.card m - σ.cycleType.sum) + (Fintype.card n - τ.cycleType.sum) by omega,
    pow_add]
  ring

name: CongruenceTheory.Cperm_sq
statement:
theorem Cperm_sq (n : ℕ) :
    Cperm n * Cperm n =
      ∑ p : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) × Equiv.Perm (Fin n), ci (Equiv.Perm.sumCongr p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Cperm, Finset.sum_mul_sum, ← ci_sumCongr]
  symm
  exact Fintype.sum_prod_type
    (f := fun p : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) × Equiv.Perm (Fin n) => ci (Equiv.Perm.sumCongr p.1 p.2))

name: CongruenceTheory.Cperm_sq_eq_sum_HSet
statement:
theorem Cperm_sq_eq_sum_HSet (n : ℕ) :
    Cperm n * Cperm n = ∑ g ∈ HSet n, ci g
proof:
:= by
  rw [Cperm_sq]
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun p _ => Equiv.Perm.sumCongrHom (Fin n) (Fin n) p)
  · intro p _
    simp only [HSet, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, MonoidHom.mem_range]
    exact ⟨p, rfl⟩
  · intro p₁ _ p₂ _ h
    exact Equiv.Perm.sumCongrHom_injective h
  · intro g hg
    simp only [HSet, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, MonoidHom.mem_range] at hg
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hg
    exact ⟨p, Finset.mem_univ p, rfl⟩
  · intro p _
    rw [Equiv.Perm.sumCongrHom_apply]

name: CongruenceTheory.sum_univ_eq_sum_HSet_add_sum_compl
statement:
theorem sum_univ_eq_sum_HSet_add_sum_compl (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ g : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n), ci g = (∑ g ∈ HSet n, ci g) + ∑ g ∈ (HSet n)ᶜ, ci g
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj : Disjoint (HSet n) (HSet n)ᶜ := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro g hg
    simp [Finset.mem_compl, hg]
  rw [← Finset.sum_union hdisj, Finset.union_compl]

name: CongruenceTheory.CpermSum_sub_Cperm_sq
statement:
theorem CpermSum_sub_Cperm_sq (n : ℕ) :
    CpermSum n - Cperm n * Cperm n = ∑ g ∈ (HSet n)ᶜ, ci g
proof:
:= by
  rw [Cperm_sq_eq_sum_HSet, CpermSum, sum_univ_eq_sum_HSet_add_sum_compl]
  ring

name: CongruenceTheory.ciExp_apply
statement:
lemma ciExp_apply (a : ℕ) (m : Multiset ℕ) (j : ℕ) :
    ciExp a m j = (if j = 1 then a else 0) + m.count j
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Multiset.induction with
  | empty =>
    have key0 : ciExp a (0 : Multiset ℕ) j = (if j = 1 then a else 0) := by
      simp only [ciExp, Multiset.map_zero, Multiset.sum_zero, add_zero, Finsupp.single_apply]
      by_cases hj1 : j = 1 <;> simp [hj1, eq_comm]
    rw [key0]; simp
  | cons x s ih =>
    have key : ciExp a (x ::ₘ s) j = ciExp a s j + (if j = x then 1 else 0) := by
      simp only [ciExp, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons, Finsupp.add_apply,
        Finsupp.single_apply]
      by_cases hjx : j = x <;> simp [hjx, eq_comm] <;> ring
    rw [key, ih, Multiset.count_cons]
    by_cases hj1 : j = 1 <;> by_cases hjx : j = x <;> simp [hj1, hjx] <;> omega

name: CongruenceTheory.pow_mul_multisetProd_eq_monomial
statement:
lemma pow_mul_multisetProd_eq_monomial (a : ℕ) (m : Multiset ℕ) :
    (MvPolynomial.X 1 : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) ^ a * (m.map MvPolynomial.X).prod =
      MvPolynomial.monomial (ciExp a m) (1 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Multiset.induction with
  | empty => simp [ciExp, MvPolynomial.X_pow_eq_monomial]
  | cons j s ih =>
    rw [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, ← mul_assoc,
      mul_comm ((MvPolynomial.X 1 : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) ^ a) (MvPolynomial.X j), mul_assoc, ih]
    rw [show (MvPolynomial.X j : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) = MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.single j 1) 1
      from by rw [← pow_one (MvPolynomial.X j : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ), MvPolynomial.X_pow_eq_monomial]]
    rw [MvPolynomial.monomial_mul, one_mul]
    congr 1
    simp only [ciExp, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons]
    abel

name: CongruenceTheory.ci_eq_monomial
statement:
lemma ci_eq_monomial {N : ℕ} (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin N)) :
    ci g = MvPolynomial.monomial (ciExp (N - g.cycleType.sum) g.cycleType) (1 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ci
  rw [pow_mul_multisetProd_eq_monomial]
  simp

name: CongruenceTheory.ciExp_eq_iff
statement:
lemma ciExp_eq_iff {a a' : ℕ} {m m' : Multiset ℕ} (hm : ∀ x ∈ m, x ≠ 1)
    (hm' : ∀ x ∈ m', x ≠ 1) : ciExp a m = ciExp a' m' ↔ a = a' ∧ m = m'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hj : ∀ j, ciExp a m j = ciExp a' m' j := fun j => DFunLike.congr_fun h j
    have hm_eq : m = m' := by
      apply Multiset.ext.mpr
      intro j
      have hje := hj j
      rw [ciExp_apply, ciExp_apply] at hje
      rcases eq_or_ne j 1 with hj1 | hj1
      · subst hj1
        have hcm : m.count 1 = 0 := Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr (fun hc => hm 1 hc rfl)
        have hcm' : m'.count 1 = 0 := Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr (fun hc => hm' 1 hc rfl)
        omega
      · simpa [hj1] using hje
    refine ⟨?_, hm_eq⟩
    have hje := hj 1
    rw [ciExp_apply, ciExp_apply] at hje
    have hcm : m.count 1 = 0 := Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr (fun hc => hm 1 hc rfl)
    have hcm' : m'.count 1 = 0 := Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr (fun hc => hm' 1 hc rfl)
    simp only [hcm, hcm', reduceIte, add_zero] at hje
    exact hje
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩; rfl

name: CongruenceTheory.coeff_Cperm_eq_card_cycleType
statement:
theorem coeff_Cperm_eq_card_cycleType (N : ℕ) (m : Multiset ℕ) (hm2 : ∀ x ∈ m, 2 ≤ x) :
    MvPolynomial.coeff (ciExp (N - m.sum) m) (Cperm N) =
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Equiv.Perm (Fin N) => g.cycleType = m)).card : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  show MvPolynomial.coeff (ciExp (N - m.sum) m) (∑ g : Equiv.Perm (Fin N), ci g) = _
  rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_sum]
  have hcast : ((Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Equiv.Perm (Fin N) => g.cycleType = m)).card : ℤ) =
      ∑ g : Equiv.Perm (Fin N), (if g.cycleType = m then (1 : ℤ) else 0) := by
    rw [Finset.card_filter]
    push_cast
    rfl
  rw [hcast]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro g _
  rw [ci_eq_monomial, MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial]
  have hgne : ∀ x ∈ g.cycleType, x ≠ 1 := fun x hx => by
    have := Equiv.Perm.two_le_of_mem_cycleType hx; omega
  have hmne : ∀ x ∈ m, x ≠ 1 := fun x hx => by have := hm2 x hx; omega
  by_cases hgm : g.cycleType = m
  · simp [hgm]
  · have hne : ciExp (N - g.cycleType.sum) g.cycleType ≠ ciExp (N - m.sum) m := by
      intro hcontra
      exact hgm ((ciExp_eq_iff hgne hmne).mp hcontra).2
    simp [hne, Ne.symm hne, hgm]

name: CongruenceTheory.card_singleCycle_eq_choose_mul
statement:
theorem card_singleCycle_eq_choose_mul {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (ℓ : ℕ)
    (hℓ : 2 ≤ ℓ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Equiv.Perm α => g.cycleType = ({ℓ} : Multiset ℕ))).card =
      (Fintype.card α).choose ℓ * (ℓ - 1)!
proof:
:= by
  have hcard := Equiv.Perm.card_of_cycleType α ({ℓ} : Multiset ℕ)
  rw [show (Finset.univ.filter (fun σ : Equiv.Perm α => σ.cycleType = {ℓ})) =
      ({g : Equiv.Perm α | g.cycleType = {ℓ}} : Finset (Equiv.Perm α)) from rfl, hcard]
  by_cases hN : ℓ ≤ Fintype.card α
  · rw [if_pos ⟨by simpa using hN, by intro a ha; simp at ha; omega⟩]
    simp only [Multiset.sum_singleton, Multiset.prod_singleton, Multiset.toFinset_singleton,
      Finset.prod_singleton, Multiset.count_singleton_self, Nat.factorial_one, mul_one]
    have key : (Fintype.card α)! =
        ((Fintype.card α - ℓ)! * ℓ) * ((Fintype.card α).choose ℓ * (ℓ - 1)!) := by
      have h1 := Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial hN
      have h2 : ℓ ! = ℓ * (ℓ - 1)! := by
        conv_lhs => rw [show ℓ = (ℓ - 1) + 1 from by omega]
        rw [Nat.factorial_succ]
        congr 1
        omega
      rw [← h1, h2]; ring
    rw [key, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (by positivity)]
  · rw [if_neg (by simp [hN]), Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega)]
    simp

name: CongruenceTheory.coeff_ci_sumCongr_target_singleCycle
statement:
lemma coeff_ci_sumCongr_target_singleCycle {n k ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ : 2 ≤ ℓ)
    (p : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) × Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) :
    MvPolynomial.coeff (ciExp (n + k - ℓ) {ℓ}) (ci (Equiv.Perm.sumCongr p.1 p.2)) =
      (if p.1.cycleType = ({ℓ} : Multiset ℕ) ∧ p.2.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ)
        else 0) +
      (if p.1.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) ∧ p.2.cycleType = ({ℓ} : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ)
        else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ci_sumCongr, ci_eq_monomial, ci_eq_monomial, MvPolynomial.monomial_mul, one_mul,
    MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial]
  have hn : p.1.cycleType.sum ≤ n := by have := Equiv.Perm.sum_cycleType_le p.1; simpa using this
  have hk : p.2.cycleType.sum ≤ k := by have := Equiv.Perm.sum_cycleType_le p.2; simpa using this
  have hgne : ∀ x ∈ p.1.cycleType, x ≠ 1 := fun x hx => by
    have := Equiv.Perm.two_le_of_mem_cycleType hx; omega
  have hgne' : ∀ x ∈ p.2.cycleType, x ≠ 1 := fun x hx => by
    have := Equiv.Perm.two_le_of_mem_cycleType hx; omega
  have hgnesum : ∀ x ∈ p.1.cycleType + p.2.cycleType, x ≠ 1 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Multiset.mem_add] at hx
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · exact hgne x hx
    · exact hgne' x hx
  have hℓne : ∀ x ∈ ({ℓ} : Multiset ℕ), x ≠ 1 := by intro x hx; simp at hx; omega
  have key : (ciExp (n - p.1.cycleType.sum) p.1.cycleType +
      ciExp (k - p.2.cycleType.sum) p.2.cycleType = ciExp (n + k - ℓ) ({ℓ} : Multiset ℕ)) ↔
      (p.1.cycleType = {ℓ} ∧ p.2.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ)) ∨
        (p.1.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) ∧ p.2.cycleType = {ℓ}) := by
    rw [ciExp_add, ciExp_eq_iff hgnesum hℓne, ← multiset_add_eq_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · exact fun h => h.2
    · intro h
      refine ⟨?_, h⟩
      have hsuml : p.1.cycleType.sum + p.2.cycleType.sum = ℓ := by
        have := congrArg Multiset.sum h; simpa using this
      omega
  simp only [key]
  by_cases h1 : p.1.cycleType = ({ℓ} : Multiset ℕ) ∧ p.2.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ)
  · have h2 : ¬ (p.1.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) ∧ p.2.cycleType = {ℓ}) := by
      rintro ⟨h2a, -⟩
      rw [h1.1] at h2a
      have : ({ℓ} : Multiset ℕ) ≠ (0 : Multiset ℕ) := by
        intro hc; have := congrArg Multiset.card hc; simp at this
      exact this h2a
    rw [if_pos (Or.inl h1), if_pos h1, if_neg h2]; ring
  · by_cases h2 : p.1.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) ∧ p.2.cycleType = {ℓ}
    · rw [if_pos (Or.inr h2), if_neg h1, if_pos h2]; ring
    · rw [if_neg (not_or.mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩), if_neg h1, if_neg h2]; ring

name: CongruenceTheory.coeff_Cperm_mul_singleCycle
statement:
theorem coeff_Cperm_mul_singleCycle (n k ℓ : ℕ) (hℓ : 2 ≤ ℓ) :
    MvPolynomial.coeff (ciExp (n + k - ℓ) {ℓ}) (Cperm n * Cperm k) =
      singleCycleCount n ℓ + singleCycleCount k ℓ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Cperm_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_sum]
  have hpt : ∀ p : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) × Equiv.Perm (Fin k),
      MvPolynomial.coeff (ciExp (n + k - ℓ) {ℓ}) (ci (Equiv.Perm.sumCongr p.1 p.2)) =
      (if p.1.cycleType = ({ℓ} : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ) else 0) *
        (if p.2.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ) else 0) +
      (if p.1.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ) else 0) *
        (if p.2.cycleType = ({ℓ} : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ) else 0) := by
    intro p
    rw [coeff_ci_sumCongr_target_singleCycle hℓ]
    by_cases h1 : p.1.cycleType = ({ℓ} : Multiset ℕ) <;>
      by_cases h2 : p.2.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) <;>
      by_cases h3 : p.1.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) <;>
      by_cases h4 : p.2.cycleType = ({ℓ} : Multiset ℕ) <;>
      simp_all
  simp_rw [hpt]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  dsimp only
  have e1 : (∑ x : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), (if x.cycleType = ({ℓ} : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)) *
      (∑ y : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), (if y.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)) =
      ∑ x : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), ∑ y : Equiv.Perm (Fin k),
        (if x.cycleType = {ℓ} then (1 : ℤ) else 0) * (if y.cycleType = 0 then (1 : ℤ) else 0) :=
    Finset.sum_mul_sum Finset.univ Finset.univ _ _
  have e2 : (∑ x : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), (if x.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)) *
      (∑ y : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), (if y.cycleType = ({ℓ} : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)) =
      ∑ x : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), ∑ y : Equiv.Perm (Fin k),
        (if x.cycleType = 0 then (1 : ℤ) else 0) * (if y.cycleType = {ℓ} then (1 : ℤ) else 0) :=
    Finset.sum_mul_sum Finset.univ Finset.univ _ _
  rw [← e1, ← e2]
  have hz1 : (∑ x : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), (if x.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ) else 0))
      = 1 := by
    have heq : (∑ x : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), (if x.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ) else 0))
        = ((Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) => x.cycleType = 0)).card : ℤ) := by
      rw [Finset.card_filter]; push_cast; rfl
    rw [heq, card_cycleType_zero]; norm_num
  have hz2 : (∑ y : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), (if y.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ) else 0))
      = 1 := by
    have heq : (∑ y : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), (if y.cycleType = (0 : Multiset ℕ) then (1 : ℤ) else 0))
        = ((Finset.univ.filter (fun y : Equiv.Perm (Fin k) => y.cycleType = 0)).card : ℤ) := by
      rw [Finset.card_filter]; push_cast; rfl
    rw [heq, card_cycleType_zero]; norm_num
  rw [hz1, hz2, mul_one, one_mul]
  simp only [singleCycleCount, Finset.card_filter]
  push_cast
  ring

name: CongruenceTheory.coeff_CpermPair_singleCycle
statement:
theorem coeff_CpermPair_singleCycle (n k ℓ : ℕ) (hℓ : 2 ≤ ℓ) :
    MvPolynomial.coeff (ciExp (n + k - ℓ) {ℓ}) (CpermPair n k) =
      ((n + k).choose ℓ * (ℓ - 1)! : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin n ⊕ Fin k) = n + k := by simp
  have hcnt := coeff_sum_ci_eq_card_cycleType (α := Fin n ⊕ Fin k) ({ℓ} : Multiset ℕ) (by
    intro x hx; simp at hx; omega)
  simp only [Multiset.sum_singleton] at hcnt
  rw [hcard] at hcnt
  show MvPolynomial.coeff (ciExp (n + k - ℓ) {ℓ}) (∑ g : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k), ci g) = _
  rw [hcnt, card_singleCycle_eq_choose_mul (α := Fin n ⊕ Fin k) ℓ hℓ, hcard]
  push_cast
  ring

name: CongruenceTheory.coeff_defect_singleCycle
statement:
theorem coeff_defect_singleCycle (n k ℓ : ℕ) (hℓ : 2 ≤ ℓ) :
    MvPolynomial.coeff (ciExp (n + k - ℓ) {ℓ}) (CpermPair n k - Cperm n * Cperm k) =
      ((ℓ - 1)! : ℤ) * (((n + k).choose ℓ : ℤ) - (n.choose ℓ : ℤ) - (k.choose ℓ : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_sub, coeff_CpermPair_singleCycle n k ℓ hℓ,
    coeff_Cperm_mul_singleCycle n k ℓ hℓ]
  have hsn : singleCycleCount n ℓ = (n.choose ℓ * (ℓ - 1)! : ℤ) := by
    rw [singleCycleCount, card_singleCycle_eq_choose_mul ℓ hℓ, Fintype.card_fin]; push_cast; ring
  have hsk : singleCycleCount k ℓ = (k.choose ℓ * (ℓ - 1)! : ℤ) := by
    rw [singleCycleCount, card_singleCycle_eq_choose_mul ℓ hℓ, Fintype.card_fin]; push_cast; ring
  rw [hsn, hsk]
  ring

name: CongruenceTheory.padicValNat_sum_eq_of_unique_min
statement:
theorem padicValNat_sum_eq_of_unique_min (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (f : ι → ℕ) (i0 : ι) (hi0 : i0 ∈ s) (V : ℕ) (hV : padicValNat p (f i0) = V)
    (hne0 : f i0 ≠ 0) (hother : ∀ i ∈ s, i ≠ i0 → p ^ (V + 1) ∣ f i) :
    padicValNat p (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = V
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Fact.mk hp
  have hsplit : f i0 + ∑ i ∈ s.erase i0, f i = ∑ i ∈ s, f i := Finset.add_sum_erase s f hi0
  have hRdvd : p ^ (V + 1) ∣ ∑ i ∈ s.erase i0, f i :=
    Finset.dvd_sum (fun i hi => hother i (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hi)
      (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hi))
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hRdvd
  have hudvd : p ^ V ∣ f i0 := hV ▸ pow_padicValNat_dvd
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hudvd
  have hune0 : u ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hu; exact hne0 hu
  have hpu : ¬ p ∣ u := by
    intro hdvd
    obtain ⟨u', hu'⟩ := hdvd
    have heq : f i0 = p ^ (V + 1) * u' := by rw [hu, hu']; ring
    have hge : V + 1 ≤ padicValNat p (f i0) := (padicValNat_dvd_iff_le hne0).mp ⟨u', heq⟩
    omega
  rw [← hsplit, hw, hu, show p ^ V * u + p ^ (V + 1) * w = p ^ V * (u + p * w) from by ring]
  have hne : u + p * w ≠ 0 := by omega
  rw [padicValNat.mul (pow_ne_zero V hp.pos.ne') hne, padicValNat.prime_pow]
  have hz : padicValNat p (u + p * w) = 0 := by
    apply padicValNat.eq_zero_of_not_dvd
    intro hdvd
    apply hpu
    have hpw : p ∣ p * w := dvd_mul_right p w
    rw [add_comm] at hdvd
    exact (Nat.dvd_add_right hpw).mp hdvd
  omega

name: CongruenceTheory.coeff_defect_twoP
statement:
theorem coeff_defect_twoP (n k p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    MvPolynomial.coeff (ciExp (n + k - 2 * p) {2 * p}) (CpermPair n k - Cperm n * Cperm k) =
      ((2 * p - 1)! : ℤ) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (2 * p), (n.choose i * k.choose (2 * p - i) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hppos : 0 < p := hp.pos
  rw [coeff_defect_singleCycle n k (2 * p) (by have := hp.two_le; omega)]
  congr 1
  have hvdm := Nat.add_choose_eq n k (2 * p)
  rw [Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk] at hvdm
  dsimp only at hvdm
  have hexpand : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (2 * p + 1), n.choose i * k.choose (2 * p - i) =
      n.choose 0 * k.choose (2 * p) + n.choose (2 * p) * k.choose 0 +
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (2 * p), n.choose i * k.choose (2 * p - i) := by
    rw [show Finset.range (2 * p + 1) = insert 0 (insert (2 * p) (Finset.Ico 1 (2 * p))) from by
      ext i; simp only [Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_Ico]; omega]
    rw [Finset.sum_insert (by simp; omega), Finset.sum_insert (by simp)]
    simp only [Nat.sub_zero, Nat.sub_self]
    ring
  rw [hexpand] at hvdm
  simp only [Nat.choose_zero_right, one_mul, mul_one] at hvdm
  have hcast := congrArg (Nat.cast : ℕ → ℤ) hvdm
  push_cast at hcast
  linarith [hcast]

name: CongruenceTheory.padicValNat_factorial_twoP_sub_one
statement:
theorem padicValNat_factorial_twoP_sub_one (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    padicValNat p ((2 * p - 1)!) = 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Fact.mk hp
  have hp2 := hp.two_le
  have hb : Nat.log p (2 * p - 1) < 2 := by
    have h1' : 2 * p < p ^ 2 + 1 := by nlinarith
    have h1 : 2 * p - 1 < p ^ 2 := by omega
    exact Nat.log_lt_of_lt_pow (by omega) h1
  rw [padicValNat_factorial hb]
  have hrange : Finset.Ico 1 2 = ({1} : Finset ℕ) := rfl
  rw [hrange, Finset.sum_singleton, pow_one]
  have hlo : 1 ≤ (2 * p - 1) / p := Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hp.pos |>.mpr (by omega)
  have hhi : (2 * p - 1) / p < 2 := Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hp.pos |>.mpr (by omega)
  omega

name: CongruenceTheory.padicValNat_choose_prime_self_add_one
statement:
theorem padicValNat_choose_prime_self_add_one (p n : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hpn : p ∣ n)
    (hn0 : n ≠ 0) : padicValNat p (n.choose p) + 1 = padicValNat p n
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Fact.mk hp
  have hpn_le : p ≤ n := Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn0) hpn
  have hdesc : n.descFactorial p = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range p, (n - i) :=
    Nat.descFactorial_eq_prod_range n p
  have hne : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range p, n - i ≠ 0 := by
    intro i hi; simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hi; omega
  have hfact := Nat.factorization_prod (S := Finset.range p) (g := fun i => n - i) hne
  have hfactp := congrArg (fun f => f p) hfact
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply'] at hfactp
  have hzero : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range p, i ≠ 0 → (n - i).factorization p = 0 := by
    intro i hi hine
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hi
    rw [Nat.factorization_def _ hp]
    apply padicValNat.eq_zero_of_not_dvd
    intro hdvd
    have hpi : p ∣ (n - (n - i)) := Nat.dvd_sub hpn hdvd
    have heq : n - (n - i) = i := by omega
    rw [heq] at hpi
    have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hpi
    omega
  have hsum : (Finset.range p).sum (fun i => (n - i).factorization p) =
      (n - 0).factorization p := by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
    · exact fun i hi hine => hzero i hi hine
    · exact fun h0 => absurd (Finset.mem_range.mpr hp.pos) h0
  rw [hsum, ← hdesc] at hfactp
  simp only [Nat.sub_zero, Nat.factorization_def _ hp] at hfactp
  have hdc : n.descFactorial p = p ! * n.choose p :=
    Nat.descFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose n p
  rw [hdc] at hfactp
  have hchoosepos : n.choose p ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]; exact Nat.choose_pos hpn_le
  rw [padicValNat.mul (Nat.factorial_ne_zero p) hchoosepos] at hfactp
  have hpfact : padicValNat p (p !) = 1 := by
    have := padicValNat_factorial_mul (p := p) 1
    simpa using this
  rw [hpfact] at hfactp
  omega

name: CongruenceTheory.padicValNat_two_p_defect
statement:
theorem padicValNat_two_p_defect (n k p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hpn : p ∣ n) (hpk : p ∣ k)
    (hn0 : n ≠ 0) (hk0 : k ≠ 0) :
    padicValNat p (n.choose p * k.choose p) + 2 = padicValNat p n + padicValNat p k
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Fact.mk hp
  have h1 := padicValNat_choose_prime_self_add_one p n hp hpn hn0
  have h2 := padicValNat_choose_prime_self_add_one p k hp hpk hk0
  have hne1 : n.choose p ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
    exact Nat.choose_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn0) hpn)
  have hne2 : k.choose p ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
    exact Nat.choose_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk0) hpk)
  rw [padicValNat.mul hne1 hne2]
  omega

name: CongruenceTheory.padicValNat_sum_eq
statement:
theorem padicValNat_sum_eq (n k p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hpn : p ∣ n) (hpk : p ∣ k) (hn0 : n ≠ 0)
    (hk0 : k ≠ 0) :
    padicValNat p (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (2 * p), n.choose i * k.choose (2 * p - i)) + 2 =
      padicValNat p n + padicValNat p k
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Fact.mk hp
  have hVeq := padicValNat_two_p_defect n k p hp hpn hpk hn0 hk0
  have hi0mem : p ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (2 * p) := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_Ico]; have := hp.two_le; omega
  have hterm : ∀ i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (2 * p), i ≠ p →
      p ^ (padicValNat p (n.choose p * k.choose p) + 1) ∣
        n.choose i * k.choose (2 * p - i) := by
    intro i hi hine
    simp only [Finset.mem_Ico] at hi
    rcases le_or_gt i n with hile | higt
    · rcases le_or_gt (2 * p - i) k with hjle | hjgt
      · have hip : ¬ p ∣ i := by
          intro hdvd
          rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hine with hlt | hgt
          · have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdvd; omega
          · have hps : p ∣ (i - p) := Nat.dvd_sub hdvd (dvd_refl p)
            have hpos : 0 < i - p := by omega
            have := Nat.le_of_dvd hpos hps
            omega
        have hbi : padicValNat p n ≤ padicValNat p (n.choose i) := by
          have hchoose := Nat.factorization_le_factorization_choose_add (p := p) hile (by omega)
          rw [Nat.factorization_def n hp, Nat.factorization_def (n.choose i) hp,
            Nat.factorization_def i hp] at hchoose
          have hvi : padicValNat p i = 0 := padicValNat.eq_zero_of_not_dvd hip
          omega
        have hjne0 : 2 * p - i ≠ 0 := by omega
        have hjp : ¬ p ∣ (2 * p - i) := by
          intro hdvd
          apply hip
          have hps : p ∣ (2 * p - (2 * p - i)) := Nat.dvd_sub (dvd_mul_left p 2) hdvd
          have heq : 2 * p - (2 * p - i) = i := by omega
          rwa [heq] at hps
        have hbj : padicValNat p k ≤ padicValNat p (k.choose (2 * p - i)) := by
          have hchoose := Nat.factorization_le_factorization_choose_add (p := p) hjle hjne0
          rw [Nat.factorization_def k hp, Nat.factorization_def (k.choose (2 * p - i)) hp,
            Nat.factorization_def (2 * p - i) hp] at hchoose
          have hvj : padicValNat p (2 * p - i) = 0 := padicValNat.eq_zero_of_not_dvd hjp
          omega
        have hipos : n.choose i ≠ 0 := by rw [← Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]; exact Nat.choose_pos hile
        have hjpos : k.choose (2 * p - i) ≠ 0 := by
          rw [← Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]; exact Nat.choose_pos hjle
        have hne : n.choose i * k.choose (2 * p - i) ≠ 0 := Nat.mul_ne_zero hipos hjpos
        have hVp1 : padicValNat p (n.choose p * k.choose p) + 1 ≤
            padicValNat p (n.choose i * k.choose (2 * p - i)) := by
          rw [padicValNat.mul hipos hjpos]
          omega
        exact (padicValNat_dvd_iff_le hne).mpr hVp1
      · have hz : k.choose (2 * p - i) = 0 := Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega)
        simp [hz]
    · have hz : n.choose i = 0 := Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt higt
      simp [hz]
  have h2pp : 2 * p - p = p := by omega
  have hne0term : n.choose p * k.choose (2 * p - p) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [h2pp]
    apply Nat.mul_ne_zero
    · rw [← Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
      exact Nat.choose_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn0) hpn)
    · rw [← Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
      exact Nat.choose_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk0) hpk)
  have hVeq2 : padicValNat p (n.choose p * k.choose (2 * p - p)) =
      padicValNat p (n.choose p * k.choose p) := by rw [h2pp]
  have hsum := padicValNat_sum_eq_of_unique_min p hp (Finset.Ico 1 (2 * p))
    (fun i => n.choose i * k.choose (2 * p - i)) p hi0mem
    (padicValNat p (n.choose p * k.choose p)) hVeq2 hne0term hterm
  omega

name: CongruenceTheory.prime_witness
statement:
theorem prime_witness (n k p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hpn : p ∣ n) (hpk : p ∣ k) (hn0 : n ≠ 0)
    (hk0 : k ≠ 0) :
    padicValNat p
        (MvPolynomial.coeff (ciExp (n + k - 2 * p) {2 * p})
          (CpermPair n k - Cperm n * Cperm k)).natAbs + 1 =
      padicValNat p n + padicValNat p k
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Fact.mk hp
  rw [coeff_defect_twoP n k p hp]
  rw [show ((2 * p - 1)! : ℤ) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (2 * p), (n.choose i * k.choose (2 * p - i) : ℤ)
      = (((2 * p - 1)! * ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (2 * p), n.choose i * k.choose (2 * p - i) : ℕ) : ℤ)
      from by push_cast; ring]
  rw [Int.natAbs_natCast]
  rw [padicValNat.mul (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _) (by
    have hne0term : n.choose p * k.choose p ≠ 0 :=
      Nat.mul_ne_zero
        (by rw [← Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
            exact Nat.choose_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn0) hpn))
        (by rw [← Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
            exact Nat.choose_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk0) hpk))
    intro hz
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff] at hz
    have hi0mem : p ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (2 * p) := by
      simp only [Finset.mem_Ico]; have := hp.two_le; omega
    have hzp := hz p hi0mem
    rw [show 2 * p - p = p from by omega] at hzp
    exact hne0term hzp)]
  rw [padicValNat_factorial_twoP_sub_one p hp]
  have := padicValNat_sum_eq n k p hp hpn hpk hn0 hk0
  omega

name: CongruenceTheory.Cperm_mul_eq_sum_HSetPair
statement:
theorem Cperm_mul_eq_sum_HSetPair (n k : ℕ) :
    Cperm n * Cperm k = ∑ g ∈ HSetPair n k, ci g
proof:
:= by
  rw [Cperm_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun p _ => Equiv.Perm.sumCongrHom (Fin n) (Fin k) p)
  · intro p _
    simp only [HSetPair, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, MonoidHom.mem_range]
    exact ⟨p, rfl⟩
  · intro p₁ _ p₂ _ h
    exact Equiv.Perm.sumCongrHom_injective h
  · intro g hg
    simp only [HSetPair, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, MonoidHom.mem_range] at hg
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hg
    exact ⟨p, Finset.mem_univ p, rfl⟩
  · intro p _
    rw [Equiv.Perm.sumCongrHom_apply]

name: CongruenceTheory.CpermPair_sub_Cperm_mul
statement:
theorem CpermPair_sub_Cperm_mul (n k : ℕ) :
    CpermPair n k - Cperm n * Cperm k = ∑ g ∈ (HSetPair n k)ᶜ, ci g
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj : Disjoint (HSetPair n k) (HSetPair n k)ᶜ := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]; intro g hg; simp [Finset.mem_compl, hg]
  have hsplit : CpermPair n k = (∑ g ∈ HSetPair n k, ci g) + ∑ g ∈ (HSetPair n k)ᶜ, ci g := by
    rw [CpermPair, ← Finset.sum_union hdisj, Finset.union_compl]
  rw [hsplit, Cperm_mul_eq_sum_HSetPair]
  ring

name: CongruenceTheory.mem_compl_of_orbRelPair
statement:
lemma mem_compl_of_orbRelPair {n k : ℕ} {g g' : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)}
    (hg : g ∈ (HSetPair n k)ᶜ) (hr : (orbRelPair n k).r g' g) : g' ∈ (HSetPair n k)ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := hr
  exact compl_HSetPair_invariant n k h g hg

name: CongruenceTheory.filter_compl_eq_filter_univ_pair
proof:
:= by
  ext g'
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, and_iff_right_iff_imp]
  exact fun hr => mem_compl_of_orbRelPair hg ((orbRelPair n k).iseqv.symm hr)

name: CongruenceTheory.descFactorial_mul_factorial_sub
statement:
lemma descFactorial_mul_factorial_sub (n a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ n) :
    n.descFactorial a * (n - a)! = n !
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.descFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose]
  rw [show a ! * n.choose a * (n - a)! = n.choose a * a ! * (n - a)! by ring]
  exact Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial ha

name: CongruenceTheory.class_card_dvd_pair
statement:
theorem class_card_dvd_pair (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (n k : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)) (hg : g ∈ (HSetPair n k)ᶜ) :
    p ^ (padicValNat p n + padicValNat p k - 1) ∣
      (Finset.univ.filter ((orbRelPair n k).r g)).card
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Fact.mk hp
  have hgH : g ∉ HgrpPair n k := by rw [mem_HgrpPair_iff]; simpa using hg
  have ha1 : 1 ≤ aCardPair g := one_le_aCardPair g hgH
  have hb1 : 1 ≤ bCardPair g := one_le_bCardPair g hgH
  have han : aCardPair g ≤ n := aCardPair_le g
  have hbn : bCardPair g ≤ k := bCardPair_le g
  have hpa : p ^ (padicValNat p n) ∣ n := pow_padicValNat_dvd
  have hpb : p ^ (padicValNat p k) ∣ k := pow_padicValNat_dvd
  have hmsf := mixed_support_factorial p hp hpa hpb ha1 han hb1 hbn
  
  have hkeyA : padicValNat p (n.descFactorial (aCardPair g)) + padicValNat p ((n - aCardPair g)!) =
      padicValNat p (n !) := by
    have hne1 : n.descFactorial (aCardPair g) ≠ 0 := (Nat.descFactorial_pos.mpr han).ne'
    have hne2 : (n - aCardPair g)! ≠ 0 := Nat.factorial_ne_zero _
    rw [← padicValNat.mul hne1 hne2, descFactorial_mul_factorial_sub n (aCardPair g) han]
  have hkeyB : padicValNat p (k.descFactorial (bCardPair g)) + padicValNat p ((k - bCardPair g)!) =
      padicValNat p (k !) := by
    have hne1 : k.descFactorial (bCardPair g) ≠ 0 := (Nat.descFactorial_pos.mpr hbn).ne'
    have hne2 : (k - bCardPair g)! ≠ 0 := Nat.factorial_ne_zero _
    rw [← padicValNat.mul hne1 hne2, descFactorial_mul_factorial_sub k (bCardPair g) hbn]
  have hcent := vp_stabilizer_le_pair g p hp
  have hprod := class_card_mul_stabilizer_card_pair n k g
  have hstabne : Fintype.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(HgrpPair n k) g) ≠ 0 := by
    have : Nonempty ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(HgrpPair n k) g) := ⟨1, Subgroup.one_mem _⟩
    exact Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hstab_eq : Nat.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(HgrpPair n k) g) =
      Fintype.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(HgrpPair n k) g) := Nat.card_eq_fintype_card
  rw [hstab_eq] at hcent
  have hclassne : (Finset.univ.filter ((orbRelPair n k).r g)).card ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    rw [hz, zero_mul] at hprod
    exact Nat.factorial_ne_zero n (by nlinarith [Nat.factorial_pos k])
  have hfa := congrArg (fun x => x.factorization p) hprod
  simp only [Nat.factorization_mul hclassne hstabne,
    Nat.factorization_mul (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n) (Nat.factorial_ne_zero k),
    Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply] at hfa
  rw [Nat.factorization_def _ hp, Nat.factorization_def _ hp, Nat.factorization_def _ hp,
    Nat.factorization_def _ hp] at hfa
  have hfinal : padicValNat p n + padicValNat p k - 1 ≤
      padicValNat p (Finset.univ.filter ((orbRelPair n k).r g)).card := by
    omega
  exact (Nat.Prime.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hp hclassne).mpr
    (by rw [Nat.factorization_def _ hp]; exact hfinal)

name: CongruenceTheory.optimal_divisor_lower_bound
statement:
theorem optimal_divisor_lower_bound (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (n k : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    ∃ Q : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ,
      CpermPair n k - Cperm n * Cperm k =
        ((p ^ (padicValNat p n + padicValNat p k - 1) : ℕ) : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) * Q
proof:
:= by
  have hmain := dvd_sum_of_const_on_classes (orbRelPair n k).r
    (fun x => (orbRelPair n k).iseqv.refl x)
    (fun x y h => (orbRelPair n k).iseqv.symm h)
    (fun x y z h1 h2 => (orbRelPair n k).iseqv.trans h1 h2)
    ci (fun x y h => ci_const_on_orbit_pair n k x y h)
    (p ^ (padicValNat p n + padicValNat p k - 1)) (HSetPair n k)ᶜ
    (fun x hx => by
      rw [filter_compl_eq_filter_univ_pair hx]
      exact_mod_cast class_card_dvd_pair p hp n k hn hk x hx)
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hmain
  refine ⟨Q, ?_⟩
  rw [CpermPair_sub_Cperm_mul, hQ]

name: CongruenceTheory.w_eq_sum_div_mul_b
statement:
theorem w_eq_sum_div_mul_b (w : ℕ → ℤ) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    (w m : ℚ) = ∑ d ∈ m.divisors, (d : ℚ) * b w d
proof:
:= by
  have h := moebius_inversion w m hm
  have h2 : (w m : ℚ) = ∑ d ∈ m.divisors, (MTrans w d : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast h
  rw [h2]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d hd
  have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := by
    intro hcontra
    rw [hcontra] at hd
    simp [Nat.mem_divisors] at hd
  unfold b
  field_simp

name: CongruenceTheory.constantCoeff_Gseries
statement: theorem constantCoeff_Gseries (w : ℕ → ℤ) : constantCoeff (Gseries w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff]
  simp [Gseries]

name: CongruenceTheory.logOf_AwSeries
statement: theorem logOf_AwSeries (w : ℕ → ℤ) : logOf (AwSeries w) = Gseries w
proof:
:=
  logOf_exp (Gseries w) (constantCoeff_Gseries w)

name: CongruenceTheory.constantCoeff_AwSeries
statement: theorem constantCoeff_AwSeries (w : ℕ → ℤ) : constantCoeff (AwSeries w) = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold AwSeries
  rw [constantCoeff_subst_of_const_zero (exp ℚ) (Gseries w) (constantCoeff_Gseries w)
    (HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' (constantCoeff_Gseries w))]
  exact constantCoeff_exp

name: CongruenceTheory.horder_eulerFactors
statement:
theorem horder_eulerFactors (w : ℕ → ℤ) :
    ∀ e : ℕ, ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, (e : ℕ∞) < (rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1))) - 1).order
proof:
:= by
  intro e
  refine ⟨e + 1, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have h1 : (e : ℕ∞) < ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : e < n + 1)
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (le_order_eulerFactor_sub_one n (b w (n + 1)))

name: CongruenceTheory.hg1_eulerFactors
statement:
theorem hg1_eulerFactors (w : ℕ → ℤ) :
    ∀ n, constantCoeff (1 + (rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1))) - 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) = 1
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  have : (1 + (rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1))) - 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) =
      rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1))) := by ring
  rw [this]
  exact constantCoeff_rpow _ (by simp) _

name: CongruenceTheory.logOf_tprod_eulerFactors
statement:
theorem logOf_tprod_eulerFactors (w : ℕ → ℤ) :
    logOf (∏' n, rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1)))) =
      ∑' n, PowerSeries.C (-(b w (n + 1))) * logOf (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun n : ℕ => rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1)))) =
      (fun n : ℕ => 1 + (rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1))) - 1)) := by funext n; ring
  have hM : Multipliable (fun n : ℕ => 1 + (rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1))) - 1)) := by
    rw [← heq]; exact multipliable_eulerFactors (b w)
  rw [heq, logOf_tprod _ (hg1_eulerFactors w) hM (horder_eulerFactors w)]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro n
  rw [show (1 + (rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1))) - 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) =
    rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1))) from by ring]
  exact logOf_rpow _ (by simp) _

name: CongruenceTheory.coeff_sum_eulerFactors
statement:
theorem coeff_sum_eulerFactors (w : ℕ → ℤ) (e : ℕ) (he : e ≠ 0) :
    coeff e (∑' n, PowerSeries.C (-(b w (n + 1))) * logOf (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧)) =
      (w e : ℚ) / e
proof:
:= by
  have hSummable :
      Summable (fun n => PowerSeries.C (-(b w (n + 1))) * logOf (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) :
        ℕ → ℚ⟦X⟧) := by
    apply PowerSeries.WithPiTopology.summable_of_tendsto_order_atTop_nhds_top
    rw [ENat.tendsto_nhds_top_iff_natCast_lt]
    intro k
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop k] with n hn
    have h1 : (k : ℕ∞) < ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : k < n + 1)
    apply lt_of_lt_of_le h1
    calc ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ (logOf (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧)).order :=
          le_order_logOf_one_sub_X_pow n
      _ ≤ (PowerSeries.C (-(b w (n + 1))) * logOf (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧)).order := by
          calc (logOf (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧)).order =
                0 + (logOf (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧)).order := by rw [zero_add]
            _ ≤ (PowerSeries.C (-(b w (n + 1))) : ℚ⟦X⟧).order +
                  (logOf (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧)).order := by gcongr; exact zero_le
            _ ≤ _ := PowerSeries.le_order_mul _ _
  have hHasSum :
      HasSum (fun n => coeff e (PowerSeries.C (-(b w (n + 1))) * logOf (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧)))
        (coeff e (∑' n, PowerSeries.C (-(b w (n + 1))) * logOf (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧))) :=
    (PowerSeries.WithPiTopology.hasSum_iff_hasSum_coeff (R := ℚ) |>.mp hSummable.hasSum) e
  have hterm : ∀ n : ℕ,
      coeff e (PowerSeries.C (-(b w (n + 1))) * logOf (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧)) =
        if (n + 1) ∣ e then b w (n + 1) * (n + 1) / e else 0 := by
    intro n
    rw [coeff_C_mul, coeff_logOf_one_sub_X_pow (n + 1) (Nat.succ_ne_zero n) e]
    by_cases hdvd : (n + 1) ∣ e
    · rw [dif_pos ⟨hdvd, he⟩, if_pos hdvd]
      have hn1 : ((n : ℚ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have he' : (e : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast he
      have hne1 : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by push_cast; exact hn1
      field_simp
      push_cast
      ring
    · rw [dif_neg (fun h => hdvd h.1), if_neg hdvd, mul_zero]
  simp_rw [hterm] at hHasSum
  have hs : ∀ n ∉ (Finset.range e), (if (n + 1) ∣ e then b w (n + 1) * (n + 1) / e else 0 : ℚ) = 0 := by
    intro n hn
    rw [if_neg]
    intro hdvd
    have := Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero he) hdvd
    simp at hn
    omega
  have hval : HasSum (fun n => if (n + 1) ∣ e then b w (n + 1) * (n + 1) / e else 0 : ℕ → ℚ)
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.range e, if (n + 1) ∣ e then b w (n + 1) * (n + 1) / e else 0) :=
    hasSum_sum_of_ne_finset_zero hs
  have hHasSum' := hHasSum.unique hval
  rw [hHasSum']
  have hreindex : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range e, (if (n + 1) ∣ e then b w (n + 1) * (n + 1) / e else 0 : ℚ) =
      ∑ d ∈ e.divisors, (b w d * d / e : ℚ) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
    apply Finset.sum_nbij' (fun n => n + 1) (fun d => d - 1)
    case hi =>
      intro n hn
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hn
      simp only [Nat.mem_divisors]
      exact ⟨hn.2, he⟩
    case hj =>
      intro d hd
      simp only [Nat.mem_divisors] at hd
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
      have hd1 : 1 ≤ d := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hd.1 (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero he)
      have hdle : d ≤ e := Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero he) hd.1
      constructor
      · omega
      · rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hd1]; exact hd.1
    case left_neg =>
      intro n hn
      simp
    case right_neg =>
      intro d hd
      simp only [Nat.mem_divisors] at hd
      have hd1 : 1 ≤ d := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hd.1 (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero he)
      omega
    case h =>
      intro n hn
      push_cast
      ring
  rw [hreindex]
  have hwe := w_eq_sum_div_mul_b w e (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero he)
  rw [hwe, Finset.sum_div]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d _
  ring

name: CongruenceTheory.coeff_zero_sum_eulerFactors
statement:
theorem coeff_zero_sum_eulerFactors (w : ℕ → ℤ) :
    coeff 0 (∑' n, PowerSeries.C (-(b w (n + 1))) * logOf (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hSummable :
      Summable (fun n => PowerSeries.C (-(b w (n + 1))) * logOf (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) :
        ℕ → ℚ⟦X⟧) := by
    apply PowerSeries.WithPiTopology.summable_of_tendsto_order_atTop_nhds_top
    rw [ENat.tendsto_nhds_top_iff_natCast_lt]
    intro k
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop k] with n hn
    have h1 : (k : ℕ∞) < ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : k < n + 1)
    apply lt_of_lt_of_le h1
    calc ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ (logOf (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧)).order :=
          le_order_logOf_one_sub_X_pow n
      _ ≤ (PowerSeries.C (-(b w (n + 1))) * logOf (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧)).order := by
          calc (logOf (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧)).order =
                0 + (logOf (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧)).order := by rw [zero_add]
            _ ≤ (PowerSeries.C (-(b w (n + 1))) : ℚ⟦X⟧).order +
                  (logOf (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧)).order := by gcongr; exact zero_le
            _ ≤ _ := PowerSeries.le_order_mul _ _
  have hHasSum :
      HasSum (fun n => coeff 0 (PowerSeries.C (-(b w (n + 1))) * logOf (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧)))
        (coeff 0 (∑' n, PowerSeries.C (-(b w (n + 1))) * logOf (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧))) :=
    (PowerSeries.WithPiTopology.hasSum_iff_hasSum_coeff (R := ℚ) |>.mp hSummable.hasSum) 0
  have hzero :
      (fun n => coeff 0 (PowerSeries.C (-(b w (n + 1))) * logOf (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧))) =
        (fun _ => (0 : ℚ)) := by
    funext n
    rw [coeff_C_mul, coeff_logOf_one_sub_X_pow (n + 1) (Nat.succ_ne_zero n) 0]
    rw [dif_neg (fun h => h.2 rfl), mul_zero]
  rw [hzero] at hHasSum
  exact (hasSum_zero.unique hHasSum).symm

name: CongruenceTheory.logOf_AwSeries_eq_sum_eulerFactors
statement:
theorem logOf_AwSeries_eq_sum_eulerFactors (w : ℕ → ℤ) :
    Gseries w = ∑' n, PowerSeries.C (-(b w (n + 1))) * logOf (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧)
proof:
:= by
  apply PowerSeries.ext
  intro e
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos e with he0 | he0
  · subst he0
    rw [coeff_zero_sum_eulerFactors]
    simp [Gseries]
  · rw [coeff_sum_eulerFactors w e he0.ne']
    simp [Gseries, he0.ne']

name: CongruenceTheory.euler_product
statement:
theorem euler_product (w : ℕ → ℤ) :
    AwSeries w = ∏' n, rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  have hlog1 : logOf (AwSeries w) =
      logOf (∏' n, rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1)))) := by
    rw [logOf_AwSeries, logOf_tprod_eulerFactors, ← logOf_AwSeries_eq_sum_eulerFactors]
  have hc1 : constantCoeff (AwSeries w) = 1 := constantCoeff_AwSeries w
  have hc2 :
      constantCoeff (∏' n, rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1))) : ℚ⟦X⟧) = 1 := by
    have heq : (fun n : ℕ => rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1)))) =
        (fun n : ℕ => 1 + (rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1))) - 1)) := by funext n; ring
    have hM : Multipliable (fun n : ℕ => 1 + (rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1))) - 1)) := by
      rw [← heq]; exact multipliable_eulerFactors (b w)
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := (horder_eulerFactors w) 0
    have hcoeffs : coeff 0 (∏' n, (1 + (rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1))) - 1))) =
        coeff 0 (∏ n ∈ Finset.range N,
          (1 + (rpow (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : ℚ⟦X⟧) (-(b w (n + 1))) - 1))) := by
      apply coeff_tprod_eq_coeff_prod_range _ hM 0 N hN
    rw [← heq] at hcoeffs
    rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff]
    rw [hcoeffs, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff]
    rw [heq]
    exact constantCoeff_prod_range _ (hg1_eulerFactors w) N
  have := exp_logOf (AwSeries w) hc1
  rw [hlog1] at this
  rw [← this, exp_logOf _ hc2]

name: CongruenceTheory.fixed_modulus_classification
statement:
theorem fixed_modulus_classification (a : ℕ → ℤ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    (∀ n, (k : ℤ) ∣ (a (n + k) - a n * a k)) ↔
      (∀ r q, r < k → (k : ℤ) ∣ (a (r + q * k) - a r * a k ^ q))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hi r q _
    induction q with
    | zero => simp
    | succ q ih =>
      have hstep := hi (r + q * k)
      have heq : r + (q + 1) * k = (r + q * k) + k := by ring
      rw [heq]
      have hsplit : a ((r + q * k) + k) - a r * a k ^ (q + 1) =
          (a ((r + q * k) + k) - a (r + q * k) * a k) +
            (a (r + q * k) - a r * a k ^ q) * a k := by ring
      rw [hsplit]
      exact dvd_add hstep (Dvd.dvd.mul_right ih (a k))
  · intro hii n
    set r := n % k with hr
    set q := n / k with hq
    have hrk : r < k := Nat.mod_lt n hk
    have hn : n = r + q * k := by
      rw [hr, hq, mul_comm]
      exact (Nat.mod_add_div n k).symm
    have h1 := hii r q hrk
    rw [← hn] at h1
    have h2 := hii r (q + 1) hrk
    have heq2 : r + (q + 1) * k = n + k := by rw [hn]; ring
    rw [heq2] at h2
    have hcomb : a (n + k) - a n * a k =
        (a (n + k) - a r * a k ^ (q + 1)) - (a n - a r * a k ^ q) * a k := by ring
    rw [hcomb]
    exact dvd_sub h2 (Dvd.dvd.mul_right h1 (a k))

name: CongruenceTheory.fall_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma fall_zero (n : ℕ) : fall n 0 = 1
proof: := by simp [fall]

name: CongruenceTheory.fall_succ
statement:
lemma fall_succ (n r : ℕ) :
    fall n (r + 1) = fall n r * ((n : ℤ) - r)
proof:
:= by
  simp [fall, Finset.prod_range_succ]

name: CongruenceTheory.C_zero
statement: lemma C_zero : C 0 = 1
proof: := by simp [C]

name: CongruenceTheory.C_succ
statement:
lemma C_succ (n : ℕ) :
    C (n + 1) =
      ∑ r ∈ range (n + 1),
        (fall n r : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) * (MvPolynomial.X (r + 1) * C (n - r))
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [C]

name: CongruenceTheory.eval_ciExp_monomial
statement:
lemma eval_ciExp_monomial (w : ℕ → ℤ) (a : ℕ) (m : Multiset ℕ) :
    MvPolynomial.eval w (MvPolynomial.monomial (ciExp a m) (1 : ℤ)) =
      w 1 ^ a * (m.map w).prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_mul_multisetProd_eq_monomial]
  simp only [map_mul, map_pow, MvPolynomial.eval_X]
  congr 1
  induction m using Multiset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons x s ih => simp [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, ih]

name: CongruenceTheory.eval_ci
statement:
lemma eval_ci (w : ℕ → ℤ) {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (g : Equiv.Perm α) :
    MvPolynomial.eval w (ci g) =
      w 1 ^ (Fintype.card α - g.cycleType.sum) * (g.cycleType.map w).prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [ci_eq_monomial', eval_ciExp_monomial]

name: CongruenceTheory.AwPerm_eq_zero_of_not_mem_Gamma
statement:
theorem AwPerm_eq_zero_of_not_mem_Gamma (w : ℕ → ℤ) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ∉ Gamma w) :
    AwPerm w n = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [AwPerm, Cperm, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro g _
  rw [eval_ci, Fintype.card_fin]
  by_contra hne
  apply hn
  have hfix1 : w 1 ^ (n - g.cycleType.sum) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0; apply hne; rw [h0]; ring
  have hprodne : (g.cycleType.map w).prod ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0; apply hne; rw [h0]; ring
  have hfixw1 : n - g.cycleType.sum = 0 ∨ w 1 ≠ 0 := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (n - g.cycleType.sum) with h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (fun h1 => hfix1 (by rw [h1]; exact zero_pow h.ne'))
  have hallw : ∀ ℓ ∈ g.cycleType, w ℓ ≠ 0 := by
    intro ℓ hℓ h0
    apply hprodne
    apply Multiset.prod_eq_zero
    exact Multiset.mem_map.mpr ⟨ℓ, hℓ, h0⟩
  refine ⟨Multiset.replicate (n - g.cycleType.sum) 1 + g.cycleType, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    rw [Multiset.mem_add] at hx
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · rw [Multiset.eq_of_mem_replicate hx]
      refine ⟨le_refl 1, ?_⟩
      rcases hfixw1 with h0 | h1
      · rw [h0] at hx; simp at hx
      · exact h1
    · have h2 := Equiv.Perm.two_le_of_mem_cycleType hx
      exact ⟨by omega, hallw x hx⟩
  · rw [Multiset.sum_add, Multiset.sum_replicate, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    have hle : g.cycleType.sum ≤ n := by
      have := Equiv.Perm.sum_cycleType_le g
      simpa using this
    omega

name: CongruenceTheory.AwPerm_eq_zero_below_min_support
statement:
theorem AwPerm_eq_zero_below_min_support (w : ℕ → ℤ) (d : ℕ) (hmin : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j < d → w j = 0)
    (n : ℕ) (hn1 : 1 ≤ n) (hnd : n < d) : AwPerm w n = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply AwPerm_eq_zero_of_not_mem_Gamma
  rintro ⟨m, hm, hsum⟩
  have hall : ∀ x ∈ m, d ≤ x := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hx1, hxw⟩ := hm x hx
    by_contra hlt
    push Not at hlt
    exact hxw (hmin x hx1 hlt)
  rcases Multiset.empty_or_exists_mem m with hm0 | ⟨x0, hx0⟩
  · rw [hm0] at hsum; simp at hsum; omega
  · have hdle := hall x0 hx0
    have hxsum : m.sum = x0 + (m.erase x0).sum := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← Multiset.cons_erase hx0]
      rw [Multiset.sum_cons]
    omega

name: CongruenceTheory.mem_Hgrp_iff
statement: lemma mem_Hgrp_iff (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) : g ∈ Hgrp n ↔ g ∈ HSet n
proof:
:= by
  simp [Hgrp, HSet]

name: CongruenceTheory.smul_def
statement:
lemma smul_def (h : ↥(Hgrp n)) (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) :
    h • g = h.1 * g * h.1⁻¹
proof: := rfl

name: CongruenceTheory.compl_HSet_invariant
statement:
lemma compl_HSet_invariant (h : ↥(Hgrp n)) (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n))
    (hg : g ∈ (HSet n)ᶜ) : h • g ∈ (HSet n)ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.mem_compl] at hg ⊢
  rw [smul_def]
  intro hmem
  apply hg
  rw [← mem_Hgrp_iff] at hmem ⊢
  have : g = h.1⁻¹ * (h.1 * g * h.1⁻¹) * h.1 := by group
  rw [this]
  exact (Hgrp n).mul_mem ((Hgrp n).mul_mem (Subgroup.inv_mem _ h.2) hmem) h.2

name: CongruenceTheory.ci_const_on_orbit
statement:
lemma ci_const_on_orbit (g g' : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) (h : (orbRel n).r g g') :
    ci g = ci g'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hh, rfl⟩ := h
  change ci (hh • g') = ci g'
  rw [smul_def]
  exact ci_conj hh.1 g'

name: CongruenceTheory.card_Hgrp
statement: theorem card_Hgrp : Fintype.card ↥(Hgrp n) = (n !) * (n !)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Fintype.card ↥(Hgrp n) = Fintype.card (Equiv.Perm (Fin n) × Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :=
    Equiv.Perm.sumCongrHom.card_range
  rw [h1]
  simp [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_perm, Fintype.card_fin]

name: CongruenceTheory.filter_orbRel_eq_orbit_toFinset
statement:
theorem filter_orbRel_eq_orbit_toFinset (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) :
    Finset.univ.filter ((orbRel n).r g) = (MulAction.orbit ↥(Hgrp n) g).toFinset
proof:
:= by
  ext g'
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_toFinset]
  exact MulAction.mem_orbit_symm

name: CongruenceTheory.class_card_mul_stabilizer_card
statement:
theorem class_card_mul_stabilizer_card (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) :
    (Finset.univ.filter ((orbRel n).r g)).card *
      Fintype.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(Hgrp n) g) = (n !) * (n !)
proof:
:= by
  rw [filter_orbRel_eq_orbit_toFinset, Set.toFinset_card]
  rw [MulAction.card_orbit_mul_card_stabilizer_eq_card_group ↥(Hgrp n) g, card_Hgrp]

name: CongruenceTheory.v2_two_prime
statement: lemma v2_two_prime : Nat.Prime 2
proof: := by norm_num

name: CongruenceTheory.v2_le_v2_pred_factorial_add_one
statement:
lemma v2_le_v2_pred_factorial_add_one (t : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) :
    v2 t ≤ v2 ((t - 1)!) + 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (v2 t) with hc0 | hcpos
  · omega
  · set c := v2 t with hcdef
    have htne : t ≠ 0 := by omega
    have hpow : (2:ℕ) ^ c ∣ t :=
      (Nat.Prime.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization v2_two_prime htne).mpr le_rfl
    have ht2c : (2:ℕ) ^ c ≤ t := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hpow
    have heq : (2:ℕ) ^ (c - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ c := by
      rw [← pow_succ]
      congr 1
      omega
    have hxpos : 1 ≤ (2:ℕ) ^ (c - 1) := Nat.one_le_two_pow
    have hle : (2:ℕ) ^ (c - 1) ≤ t - 1 := by omega
    have hdvd2 : (2:ℕ) ^ (c - 1) ∣ (t - 1)! :=
      Nat.dvd_factorial (by positivity) hle
    have hval : c - 1 ≤ v2 ((t - 1)!) :=
      (Nat.Prime.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization v2_two_prime
        (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)).mp hdvd2
    omega

name: CongruenceTheory.v2_factorial_mono
statement: lemma v2_factorial_mono {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) : v2 (m !) ≤ v2 (n !)
proof:
:=
  Nat.factorization_le_factorization_of_dvd_right
    (Nat.factorial_dvd_factorial h) (Nat.factorial_ne_zero m) (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)

name: CongruenceTheory.max_v2_factorial_add_one_ge
statement:
lemma max_v2_factorial_add_one_ge (a b : ℕ) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) :
    v2 a + v2 b ≤ max (v2 (a !)) (v2 (b !)) + 1
proof:
:= by
  wlog hab : a ≤ b generalizing a b
  · have := this b a hb ha (by omega)
    rw [max_comm]
    omega
  have h1 : v2 a ≤ v2 ((a - 1)!) + 1 := v2_le_v2_pred_factorial_add_one a ha
  have h2 : v2 ((a - 1)!) ≤ v2 ((b - 1)!) := v2_factorial_mono (by omega)
  have h3 : v2 (b !) = v2 b + v2 ((b - 1)!) := by
    have heqb : b * (b - 1)! = b ! := Nat.mul_factorial_pred (by omega)
    simp only [v2, ← heqb,
      Nat.factorization_mul (show b ≠ 0 by omega) (Nat.factorial_ne_zero (b - 1)),
      Finsupp.add_apply]
  have h4 : v2 a + v2 b ≤ v2 (b !) + 1 := by omega
  have h5 : v2 (b !) ≤ max (v2 (a !)) (v2 (b !)) := le_max_right _ _
  omega

name: CongruenceTheory.val_identity
statement:
lemma val_identity (s t : ℕ) (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (htn : t ≤ 2 ^ s) :
    v2 ((2 ^ s)!) + v2 t = s + v2 (t !) + v2 ((2 ^ s - t)!)
proof:
:= by
  have hchoose : v2 (Nat.choose (2 ^ s) t) + v2 t = s :=
    Nat.factorization_choose_prime_pow_add_factorization v2_two_prime htn ht0
  have hprod : Nat.choose (2 ^ s) t * t ! * (2 ^ s - t)! = (2 ^ s)! :=
    Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial htn
  have hne1 : Nat.choose (2 ^ s) t ≠ 0 := Nat.choose_ne_zero_iff.mpr htn
  have hval : v2 ((2 ^ s)!) =
      v2 (Nat.choose (2 ^ s) t) + v2 (t !) + v2 ((2 ^ s - t)!) := by
    simp only [v2, ← hprod,
      Nat.factorization_mul (Nat.mul_ne_zero hne1 (Nat.factorial_ne_zero t))
