        (Nat.factorial_ne_zero (2 ^ s - t)),
      Nat.factorization_mul hne1 (Nat.factorial_ne_zero t),
      Finsupp.add_apply]
  rw [hval]
  omega

name: CongruenceTheory.orbit_bound
statement:
theorem orbit_bound (s a b : ℕ) (_hs : 1 ≤ s) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (han : a ≤ 2 ^ s)
    (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hbn : b ≤ 2 ^ s) :
    v2 ((2 ^ s - a)!) + v2 ((2 ^ s - b)!) + min (v2 (a !)) (v2 (b !)) + 2 * s ≤
      2 * v2 ((2 ^ s)!) + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hA := val_identity s a (by omega) han
  have hB := val_identity s b (by omega) hbn
  have hmax := max_v2_factorial_add_one_ge a b ha hb
  have hminmax : min (v2 (a !)) (v2 (b !)) + max (v2 (a !)) (v2 (b !)) =
      v2 (a !) + v2 (b !) := min_add_max _ _
  omega

name: CongruenceTheory.AwPerm_two_adic_dynamics
statement:
theorem AwPerm_two_adic_dynamics (s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (w : ℕ → ℤ) :
    (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 * s - 1) ∣ (AwPermSum w (2 ^ s) - AwPerm w (2 ^ s) * AwPerm w (2 ^ s))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := strong_two_adic s hs
  refine ⟨MvPolynomial.eval w Q, ?_⟩
  have := congrArg (MvPolynomial.eval w) hQ
  simp only [map_sub, map_mul, map_natCast] at this
  rw [AwPermSum, AwPerm]
  push_cast at this ⊢
  linarith [this]

name: CongruenceTheory.AwPerm_two_adic_dynamics_uvar
statement:
theorem AwPerm_two_adic_dynamics_uvar (s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (v : ℕ → ℤ) :
    ∃ R : Polynomial ℤ,
      letI φ : ℕ → Polynomial ℤ := fun j => Polynomial.X * (Polynomial.C (v j))
      MvPolynomial.eval₂ (Int.castRingHom (Polynomial ℤ)) φ (CpermSum (2 ^ s)) -
        (MvPolynomial.eval₂ (Int.castRingHom (Polynomial ℤ)) φ (Cperm (2 ^ s))) ^ 2 =
        ((2 : Polynomial ℤ) ^ (2 * s - 1)) * R
proof:
:= by
  set φ : ℕ → Polynomial ℤ := fun j => Polynomial.X * (Polynomial.C (v j)) with hφ
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := strong_two_adic s hs
  refine ⟨MvPolynomial.eval₂ (Int.castRingHom (Polynomial ℤ)) φ Q, ?_⟩
  have h := congrArg (MvPolynomial.eval₂ (Int.castRingHom (Polynomial ℤ)) φ) hQ
  simpa [sq, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow] using h

name: CongruenceTheory.cast_Aw_eq_eval_Cmod
statement:
lemma cast_Aw_eq_eval_Cmod (k : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℤ) (m : ℕ) :
    ((Aw w m : ℤ) : ZMod k) = MvPolynomial.eval (fun j => ((w j : ℤ) : ZMod k)) (Cmod k m)
proof:
:= by
  show (Int.castRingHom (ZMod k)) (Aw w m) = _
  rw [Aw, Cmod, MvPolynomial.eval₂_comp (Int.castRingHom (ZMod k)) w (C m),
    ← MvPolynomial.eval_map]
  rfl

name: CongruenceTheory.Aw_shift_mod
statement:
theorem Aw_shift_mod (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (w : ℕ → ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    (k : ℤ) ∣ (Aw w (n + k) - Aw w n * Aw w k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
  push_cast
  rw [cast_Aw_eq_eval_Cmod, cast_Aw_eq_eval_Cmod, cast_Aw_eq_eval_Cmod,
    universal_shift_mod k hk n, map_mul]
  ring

name: CongruenceTheory.Aw_iterated
statement:
theorem Aw_iterated (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (w : ℕ → ℤ) (n q : ℕ) :
    (k : ℤ) ∣ (Aw w (n + q * k) - Aw w n * Aw w k ^ q)
proof:
:= by
  induction q with
  | zero => simp
  | succ q ih =>
    have hstep := Aw_shift_mod k hk w (n + q * k)
    have heq : n + (q + 1) * k = (n + q * k) + k := by ring
    rw [heq]
    have hcomb : (k : ℤ) ∣
        (Aw w (n + q * k) - Aw w n * Aw w k ^ q) * Aw w k := Dvd.dvd.mul_right ih (Aw w k)
    have : Aw w ((n + q * k) + k) - Aw w n * Aw w k ^ (q + 1) =
        (Aw w ((n + q * k) + k) - Aw w (n + q * k) * Aw w k) +
        (Aw w (n + q * k) - Aw w n * Aw w k ^ q) * Aw w k := by ring
    rw [this]
    exact dvd_add hstep hcomb

name: CongruenceTheory.Aw_translation_eigenvector
statement:
theorem Aw_translation_eigenvector (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (w : ℕ → ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    (k : ℤ) ∣ (Aw w (n + k) - Aw w k * Aw w n)
proof:
:= by
  have := Aw_shift_mod k hk w n
  have heq : Aw w (n + k) - Aw w k * Aw w n = Aw w (n + k) - Aw w n * Aw w k := by ring
  rwa [heq]

name: CongruenceTheory.Aw_dynamics
statement:
theorem Aw_dynamics (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (w : ℕ → ℤ) (c : ℤ) (hc : (k : ℤ) ∣ (Aw w k - c))
    (r q : ℕ) : (k : ℤ) ∣ (Aw w (r + q * k) - Aw w r * c ^ q)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Aw_iterated k hk w r q
  have h2 : (k : ℤ) ∣ (Aw w r * Aw w k ^ q - Aw w r * c ^ q) := by
    have hpow : (k : ℤ) ∣ (Aw w k ^ q - c ^ q) := by
      have := sub_dvd_pow_sub_pow (Aw w k) c q
      exact hc.trans this
    rw [← mul_sub]
    exact Dvd.dvd.mul_left hpow (Aw w r)
  have : Aw w (r + q * k) - Aw w r * c ^ q =
      (Aw w (r + q * k) - Aw w r * Aw w k ^ q) + (Aw w r * Aw w k ^ q - Aw w r * c ^ q) := by ring
  rw [this]
  exact dvd_add h1 h2

name: CongruenceTheory.mem_HgrpPair_iff
statement: lemma mem_HgrpPair_iff (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)) : g ∈ HgrpPair n k ↔ g ∈ HSetPair n k
proof:
:= by
  simp [HgrpPair, HSetPair]

name: CongruenceTheory.smul_def_pair
statement:
lemma smul_def_pair (h : ↥(HgrpPair n k)) (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)) :
    h • g = h.1 * g * h.1⁻¹
proof: := rfl

name: CongruenceTheory.compl_HSetPair_invariant
statement:
lemma compl_HSetPair_invariant (h : ↥(HgrpPair n k)) (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k))
    (hg : g ∈ (HSetPair n k)ᶜ) : h • g ∈ (HSetPair n k)ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.mem_compl] at hg ⊢
  rw [smul_def_pair]
  intro hmem
  apply hg
  rw [← mem_HgrpPair_iff] at hmem ⊢
  have : g = h.1⁻¹ * (h.1 * g * h.1⁻¹) * h.1 := by group
  rw [this]
  exact (HgrpPair n k).mul_mem ((HgrpPair n k).mul_mem (Subgroup.inv_mem _ h.2) hmem) h.2

name: CongruenceTheory.ci_const_on_orbit_pair
statement:
lemma ci_const_on_orbit_pair (g g' : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)) (h : (orbRelPair n k).r g g') :
    ci g = ci g'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hh, rfl⟩ := h
  change ci (hh • g') = ci g'
  rw [smul_def_pair]
  exact ci_conj hh.1 g'

name: CongruenceTheory.card_HgrpPair
statement: theorem card_HgrpPair : Fintype.card ↥(HgrpPair n k) = (n !) * (k !)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Fintype.card ↥(HgrpPair n k) = Fintype.card (Equiv.Perm (Fin n) × Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) :=
    Equiv.Perm.sumCongrHom.card_range
  rw [h1]
  simp [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_perm, Fintype.card_fin]

name: CongruenceTheory.filter_orbRelPair_eq_orbit_toFinset
statement:
theorem filter_orbRelPair_eq_orbit_toFinset (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)) :
    Finset.univ.filter ((orbRelPair n k).r g) = (MulAction.orbit ↥(HgrpPair n k) g).toFinset
proof:
:= by
  ext g'
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_toFinset]
  exact MulAction.mem_orbit_symm

name: CongruenceTheory.class_card_mul_stabilizer_card_pair
statement:
theorem class_card_mul_stabilizer_card_pair (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)) :
    (Finset.univ.filter ((orbRelPair n k).r g)).card *
      Fintype.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(HgrpPair n k) g) = (n !) * (k !)
proof:
:= by
  rw [filter_orbRelPair_eq_orbit_toFinset, Set.toFinset_card]
  rw [MulAction.card_orbit_mul_card_stabilizer_eq_card_group ↥(HgrpPair n k) g, card_HgrpPair]

name: CongruenceTheory.totalDegree_ci_le
statement:
theorem totalDegree_ci_le {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (g : Equiv.Perm α) :
    (ci g).totalDegree ≤ Fintype.card α
proof:
:= by
  unfold ci
  have h1 : (X 1 ^ (Fintype.card α - g.cycleType.sum) : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ).totalDegree =
      Fintype.card α - g.cycleType.sum := MvPolynomial.totalDegree_X_pow 1 _
  have h2 : ((g.cycleType.map X).prod : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ).totalDegree ≤ g.cycleType.card := by
    have hle :=
      MvPolynomial.totalDegree_multiset_prod (g.cycleType.map (X : ℕ → MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ))
    rw [Multiset.map_map] at hle
    have heq : (g.cycleType.map (MvPolynomial.totalDegree ∘ (X : ℕ → MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ))) =
        g.cycleType.map (fun _ => 1) := by
      apply Multiset.map_congr rfl
      intro ℓ _
      exact MvPolynomial.totalDegree_X ℓ
    rw [heq] at hle
    simpa using hle
  calc (X 1 ^ (Fintype.card α - g.cycleType.sum) * (g.cycleType.map X).prod :
        MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ).totalDegree
      ≤ (X 1 ^ (Fintype.card α - g.cycleType.sum) : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ).totalDegree +
          ((g.cycleType.map X).prod : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ).totalDegree :=
        MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul _ _
    _ ≤ (Fintype.card α - g.cycleType.sum) + g.cycleType.card := by rw [h1]; gcongr
    _ ≤ Fintype.card α := by
        have hsum := Equiv.Perm.sum_cycleType_le g
        have hcard : g.cycleType.card ≤ g.cycleType.sum := by
          have h3 := Multiset.card_nsmul_le_sum
            (s := g.cycleType) (a := 2)
            (fun x hx => Equiv.Perm.two_le_of_mem_cycleType hx)
          simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h3
          omega
        omega

name: CongruenceTheory.totalDegree_Cperm_le
statement: theorem totalDegree_Cperm_le (n : ℕ) : (Cperm n).totalDegree ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  unfold Cperm
  apply le_trans (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_finsetSum _ _)
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro g _
  simpa using totalDegree_ci_le g

name: CongruenceTheory.totalDegree_CpermSum_le
statement: theorem totalDegree_CpermSum_le (n : ℕ) : (CpermSum n).totalDegree ≤ 2 * n
proof:
:= by
  unfold CpermSum
  apply le_trans (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_finsetSum _ _)
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro g _
  have h := totalDegree_ci_le g
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) = 2 * n := by
    rw [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin]; omega
  rwa [hcard] at h

name: CongruenceTheory.totalDegree_strong_two_adic_diff_le
statement:
theorem totalDegree_strong_two_adic_diff_le (n : ℕ) :
    (CpermSum n - Cperm n * Cperm n).totalDegree ≤ 2 * n
proof:
:= by
  calc (CpermSum n - Cperm n * Cperm n).totalDegree
      ≤ max (CpermSum n).totalDegree (Cperm n * Cperm n).totalDegree :=
        MvPolynomial.totalDegree_sub _ _
    _ ≤ max (2 * n) (2 * n) := by
        apply max_le_max
        · exact totalDegree_CpermSum_le n
        · exact le_trans (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul _ _) (by
            have := totalDegree_Cperm_le n; omega)
    _ = 2 * n := by omega

name: CongruenceTheory.totalDegree_strong_two_adic_Q_le
statement:
theorem totalDegree_strong_two_adic_Q_le (s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (Q : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ)
    (hQ : CpermSum (2 ^ s) - Cperm (2 ^ s) * Cperm (2 ^ s) =
      ((2 ^ (2 * s - 1) : ℕ) : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) * Q) :
    Q.totalDegree ≤ 2 * 2 ^ s
proof:
:= by
  have hkne : ((2 ^ (2 * s - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hcast :
      ((2 ^ (2 * s - 1) : ℕ) : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) =
        MvPolynomial.C ((2 ^ (2 * s - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) := by simp
  have heq : (MvPolynomial.C ((2 ^ (2 * s - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) * Q).totalDegree = Q.totalDegree :=
    totalDegree_C_mul_eq hkne Q
  rw [← heq, ← hcast, ← hQ]
  exact totalDegree_strong_two_adic_diff_le (2 ^ s)

name: CongruenceTheory.general_twoadic_defect_denom_clear
statement:
theorem general_twoadic_defect_denom_clear (s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (D : ℕ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (z : ℕ → ℤ) :
    ∃ w : ℤ, (D : ℚ) ^ (2 * 2 ^ s) *
        evalAt (fun j => (z j : ℚ) / (D : ℚ))
          (CpermSum (2 ^ s) - Cperm (2 ^ s) * Cperm (2 ^ s)) =
      ((2 ^ (2 * s - 1) : ℕ) : ℚ) * (w : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := strong_two_adic s hs
  have hQdeg := totalDegree_strong_two_adic_Q_le s hs Q hQ
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := evalAt_totalDegree_denom_clear Q (2 * 2 ^ s) hQdeg z D hD
  refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
  rw [hQ]
  show (D : ℚ) ^ (2 * 2 ^ s) *
      evalAt _ (((2 ^ (2 * s - 1) : ℕ) : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) * Q) = _
  rw [map_mul]
  have hcast :
      evalAt (fun j => (z j : ℚ) / (D : ℚ)) ((2 ^ (2 * s - 1) : ℕ) : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) =
        ((2 ^ (2 * s - 1) : ℕ) : ℚ) := by simp [evalAt]
  rw [hcast]
  rw [show (D : ℚ) ^ (2 * 2 ^ s) *
        (((2 ^ (2 * s - 1) : ℕ) : ℚ) * evalAt (fun j => (z j : ℚ) / (D : ℚ)) Q)
      = ((2 ^ (2 * s - 1) : ℕ) : ℚ) *
        ((D : ℚ) ^ (2 * 2 ^ s) * evalAt (fun j => (z j : ℚ) / (D : ℚ)) Q) by ring,
    hw]

name: CongruenceTheory.isMixed_of_sameCycle
statement:
lemma isMixed_of_sameCycle {x y : Fin n ⊕ Fin n} (h : g.SameCycle x y) :
    IsMixed g x ↔ IsMixed g y
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsMixed
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩⟩
    exact ⟨⟨a, h.symm.trans ha⟩, ⟨b, h.symm.trans hb⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩⟩
    exact ⟨⟨a, h.trans ha⟩, ⟨b, h.trans hb⟩⟩

name: CongruenceTheory.fixed_of_commute_of_fixed
statement:
lemma fixed_of_commute_of_fixed {h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)} (hcomm : Commute h g)
    {x y : Fin n ⊕ Fin n} (hxy : g.SameCycle x y) (hx : h x = x) : h y = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hxy
  have hc : Commute h (g ^ i) := hcomm.zpow_right i
  calc h y = h ((g ^ i) x) := by rw [hi]
    _ = ((g ^ i) * h) x := by rw [← Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, ← hc]
    _ = (g ^ i) (h x) := rfl
    _ = (g ^ i) x := by rw [hx]
    _ = y := hi

name: CongruenceTheory.sameCycle_apply_of_commute
statement:
lemma sameCycle_apply_of_commute {h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)} (hcomm : Commute h g)
    {x y : Fin n ⊕ Fin n} (hxy : g.SameCycle x y) : g.SameCycle (h x) (h y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hxy
  refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
  have hc : h * g ^ i = g ^ i * h := hcomm.zpow_right i
  calc (g ^ i) (h x) = (g ^ i * h) x := rfl
    _ = (h * g ^ i) x := by rw [hc]
    _ = h ((g ^ i) x) := rfl
    _ = h y := by rw [hi]

name: CongruenceTheory.isMixed_apply_of_mem
statement:
lemma isMixed_apply_of_mem {h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)} (hH : h ∈ Hgrp n)
    (hcomm : Commute h g) {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin n} (hx : IsMixed g x) : IsMixed g (h x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hH
  refine ⟨⟨p.1 a, ?_⟩, ⟨p.2 b, ?_⟩⟩
  · have hs := sameCycle_apply_of_commute g hcomm ha
    rwa [show h (Sum.inl a) = Sum.inl (p.1 a) by
      rw [← hp, Equiv.Perm.sumCongrHom_apply]; rfl] at hs
  · have hs := sameCycle_apply_of_commute g hcomm hb
    rwa [show h (Sum.inr b) = Sum.inr (p.2 b) by
      rw [← hp, Equiv.Perm.sumCongrHom_apply]; rfl] at hs

name: CongruenceTheory.isMixed_apply_iff
statement:
lemma isMixed_apply_iff {h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)} (hH : h ∈ Hgrp n)
    (hcomm : Commute h g) (x : Fin n ⊕ Fin n) : IsMixed g (h x) ↔ IsMixed g x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hm => ?_, isMixed_apply_of_mem g hH hcomm⟩
  have hH' : h⁻¹ ∈ Hgrp n := Subgroup.inv_mem _ hH
  have hcomm' : Commute h⁻¹ g := hcomm.inv_left
  have := isMixed_apply_of_mem g hH' hcomm' hm
  simpa using this

name: CongruenceTheory.isLeft_apply_of_mem
statement:
lemma isLeft_apply_of_mem {h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)} (hH : h ∈ Hgrp n)
    {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin n} (hx : x.isLeft) : (h x).isLeft
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hH
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Sum.isLeft_iff.mp hx
  rw [show h (Sum.inl a) = Sum.inl (p.1 a) by
    rw [← hp, Equiv.Perm.sumCongrHom_apply]; rfl]
  exact rfl

name: CongruenceTheory.isRight_apply_of_mem
statement:
lemma isRight_apply_of_mem {h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)} (hH : h ∈ Hgrp n)
    {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin n} (hx : x.isRight) : (h x).isRight
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hH
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Sum.isRight_iff.mp hx
  rw [show h (Sum.inr b) = Sum.inr (p.2 b) by
    rw [← hp, Equiv.Perm.sumCongrHom_apply]; rfl]
  exact rfl

name: CongruenceTheory.mapsTo_MixedA
statement:
lemma mapsTo_MixedA {h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)} (hH : h ∈ Hgrp n) (hcomm : Commute h g)
    {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin n} (hx : MixedA g x) : MixedA g (h x)
proof:
:=
  ⟨isLeft_apply_of_mem hH hx.1, isMixed_apply_of_mem g hH hcomm hx.2⟩

name: CongruenceTheory.mapsTo_MixedB
statement:
lemma mapsTo_MixedB {h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)} (hH : h ∈ Hgrp n) (hcomm : Commute h g)
    {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin n} (hx : MixedB g x) : MixedB g (h x)
proof:
:=
  ⟨isRight_apply_of_mem hH hx.1, isMixed_apply_of_mem g hH hcomm hx.2⟩

name: CongruenceTheory.mapsTo_NonMixedA
statement:
lemma mapsTo_NonMixedA {h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)} (hH : h ∈ Hgrp n) (hcomm : Commute h g)
    {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin n} (hx : x.isLeft ∧ ¬ IsMixed g x) :
    (h x).isLeft ∧ ¬ IsMixed g (h x)
proof:
:=
  ⟨isLeft_apply_of_mem hH hx.1, fun hm => hx.2 ((isMixed_apply_iff g hH hcomm x).mp hm)⟩

name: CongruenceTheory.mapsTo_NonMixedB
statement:
lemma mapsTo_NonMixedB {h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)} (hH : h ∈ Hgrp n) (hcomm : Commute h g)
    {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin n} (hx : x.isRight ∧ ¬ IsMixed g x) :
    (h x).isRight ∧ ¬ IsMixed g (h x)
proof:
:=
  ⟨isRight_apply_of_mem hH hx.1, fun hm => hx.2 ((isMixed_apply_iff g hH hcomm x).mp hm)⟩

name: CongruenceTheory.eq_of_agree
statement:
theorem eq_of_agree {h1 h2 : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)} (hH1 : h1 ∈ Hgrp n)
    (hH2 : h2 ∈ Hgrp n) (hcomm1 : Commute h1 g) (hcomm2 : Commute h2 g)
    (hA : ∀ x, x.isLeft → ¬ IsMixed g x → h1 x = h2 x)
    (hB : ∀ x, x.isRight → ¬ IsMixed g x → h1 x = h2 x)
    (hMa : ∀ x, MixedA g x → h1 x = h2 x) :
    h1 = h2
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm : Commute (h1⁻¹ * h2) g := Commute.mul_left hcomm1.inv_left hcomm2
  ext x
  by_cases hx : IsMixed g x
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hx.1
    have hMaa : MixedA g (Sum.inl a) := ⟨rfl, (isMixed_of_sameCycle g ha).mp hx⟩
    have hfix : (h1⁻¹ * h2) (Sum.inl a) = Sum.inl a := by
      have heq := hMa (Sum.inl a) hMaa
      show h1⁻¹ (h2 (Sum.inl a)) = Sum.inl a
      rw [← heq]
      simp
    have hfixx := fixed_of_commute_of_fixed g hcomm ha.symm hfix
    show h1 x = h2 x
    have h2x' : h1⁻¹ (h2 x) = x := hfixx
    have := congrArg h1 h2x'
    simpa using this.symm
  · cases x with
    | inl a => exact hA (Sum.inl a) rfl hx
    | inr b => exact hB (Sum.inr b) rfl hx

name: CongruenceTheory.stab_iff_commute
statement:
lemma stab_iff_commute (h : ↥(Hgrp n)) :
    h ∈ MulAction.stabilizer ↥(Hgrp n) g ↔ Commute (h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) g
proof:
:= by
  rw [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff, smul_def]
  constructor
  · intro he
    have h2 : (h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) * g * (h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n))⁻¹ *
        (h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) = g * (h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) := by rw [he]
    have h3 : (h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) * g = g * (h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) := by
      simpa [mul_assoc] using h2
    exact h3
  · intro hc
    show (h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) * g * (h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n))⁻¹ = g
    rw [hc]
    simp [mul_assoc]

name: CongruenceTheory.subtypePermOfFintype_mul
statement:
lemma subtypePermOfFintype_mul {p : Fin n ⊕ Fin n → Prop} [Finite {x // p x}]
    {f1 f2 : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)} (h1 : ∀ x, p x → p (f1 x)) (h2 : ∀ x, p x → p (f2 x)) :
    Equiv.Perm.subtypePermOfFintype (f1 * f2) (fun x hx => h1 (f2 x) (h2 x hx)) =
      Equiv.Perm.subtypePermOfFintype f1 h1 * Equiv.Perm.subtypePermOfFintype f2 h2
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨x, hx⟩
  simp [Equiv.Perm.subtypePermOfFintype_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]

name: CongruenceTheory.restrictTriple_mul
statement:
lemma restrictTriple_mul (h1 h2 : ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(Hgrp n) g)) :
    restrictTriple g (h1 * h2) = restrictTriple g h1 * restrictTriple g h2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [restrictTriple, Prod.mk_mul_mk, Prod.mk.injEq]
  exact ⟨subtypePermOfFintype_mul _ _, subtypePermOfFintype_mul _ _, subtypePermOfFintype_mul _ _⟩

name: CongruenceTheory.restrictHom_injective
statement: theorem restrictHom_injective : Function.Injective (restrictHom (n := n) g)
proof:
:= by
  intro h1 h2 heq
  simp only [restrictHom, MonoidHom.mk'_apply] at heq
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply eq_of_agree g h1.1.2 h2.1.2 ((stab_iff_commute g h1.1).mp h1.2)
    ((stab_iff_commute g h2.1).mp h2.2)
  · intro x hxl hxm
    have h0 := congrArg Prod.fst heq
    have hx := Equiv.ext_iff.mp h0 ⟨x, hxl, hxm⟩
    simpa [restrictTriple, Equiv.Perm.subtypePermOfFintype_apply] using hx
  · intro x hxr hxm
    have h0 := congrArg (Prod.fst ∘ Prod.snd) heq
    have hx := Equiv.ext_iff.mp h0 ⟨x, hxr, hxm⟩
    simpa [restrictTriple, Equiv.Perm.subtypePermOfFintype_apply] using hx
  · intro x hxm
    have h0 := congrArg (Prod.snd ∘ Prod.snd) heq
    have hx := Equiv.ext_iff.mp h0 ⟨x, hxm⟩
    simpa [restrictTriple, Equiv.Perm.subtypePermOfFintype_apply] using hx

name: CongruenceTheory.eq_of_agree'
statement:
theorem eq_of_agree' {h1 h2 : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)} (hcomm1 : Commute h1 g)
    (hcomm2 : Commute h2 g)
    (hA : ∀ x, x.isLeft → ¬ IsMixed g x → h1 x = h2 x)
    (hB : ∀ x, x.isRight → ¬ IsMixed g x → h1 x = h2 x)
    (hMb : ∀ x, MixedB g x → h1 x = h2 x) :
    h1 = h2
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm : Commute (h1⁻¹ * h2) g := Commute.mul_left hcomm1.inv_left hcomm2
  ext x
  by_cases hx : IsMixed g x
  · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hx.2
    have hMbb : MixedB g (Sum.inr b) := ⟨rfl, (isMixed_of_sameCycle g hb).mp hx⟩
    have hfix : (h1⁻¹ * h2) (Sum.inr b) = Sum.inr b := by
      have heq := hMb (Sum.inr b) hMbb
      show h1⁻¹ (h2 (Sum.inr b)) = Sum.inr b
      rw [← heq]
      simp
    have hfixx := fixed_of_commute_of_fixed g hcomm hb.symm hfix
    show h1 x = h2 x
    have h2x' : h1⁻¹ (h2 x) = x := hfixx
    have := congrArg h1 h2x'
    simpa using this.symm
  · cases x with
    | inl a => exact hA (Sum.inl a) rfl hx
    | inr b => exact hB (Sum.inr b) rfl hx

name: CongruenceTheory.restrictTriple'_mul
statement:
lemma restrictTriple'_mul (h1 h2 : ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(Hgrp n) g)) :
    restrictTriple' g (h1 * h2) = restrictTriple' g h1 * restrictTriple' g h2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [restrictTriple', Prod.mk_mul_mk, Prod.mk.injEq]
  exact ⟨subtypePermOfFintype_mul _ _, subtypePermOfFintype_mul _ _, subtypePermOfFintype_mul _ _⟩

name: CongruenceTheory.restrictHom'_injective
statement: theorem restrictHom'_injective : Function.Injective (restrictHom' (n := n) g)
proof:
:= by
  intro h1 h2 heq
  simp only [restrictHom', MonoidHom.mk'_apply] at heq
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply eq_of_agree' g ((stab_iff_commute g h1.1).mp h1.2) ((stab_iff_commute g h2.1).mp h2.2)
  · intro x hxl hxm
    have h0 := congrArg Prod.fst heq
    have hx := Equiv.ext_iff.mp h0 ⟨x, hxl, hxm⟩
    simpa [restrictTriple', Equiv.Perm.subtypePermOfFintype_apply] using hx
  · intro x hxr hxm
    have h0 := congrArg (Prod.fst ∘ Prod.snd) heq
    have hx := Equiv.ext_iff.mp h0 ⟨x, hxr, hxm⟩
    simpa [restrictTriple', Equiv.Perm.subtypePermOfFintype_apply] using hx
  · intro x hxm
    have h0 := congrArg (Prod.snd ∘ Prod.snd) heq
    have hx := Equiv.ext_iff.mp h0 ⟨x, hxm⟩
    simpa [restrictTriple', Equiv.Perm.subtypePermOfFintype_apply] using hx

name: CongruenceTheory.card_NonMixedA
statement:
lemma card_NonMixedA :
    Nat.card {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin n // x.isLeft ∧ ¬ IsMixed g x} = n - aCard g
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_congr (sumLeftSubtypeEquiv (fun x => ¬ IsMixed g x))]
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype_compl]
  simp [aCard, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin]

name: CongruenceTheory.card_NonMixedB
statement:
lemma card_NonMixedB :
    Nat.card {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin n // x.isRight ∧ ¬ IsMixed g x} = n - bCard g
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_congr (sumRightSubtypeEquiv (fun x => ¬ IsMixed g x))]
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype_compl]
  simp [bCard, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin]

name: CongruenceTheory.card_MixedA
statement:
lemma card_MixedA :
    Nat.card {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin n // MixedA g x} = aCard g
proof:
:= by
  show Nat.card {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin n // x.isLeft ∧ IsMixed g x} = aCard g
  rw [Nat.card_congr (sumLeftSubtypeEquiv (IsMixed g))]
  rfl

name: CongruenceTheory.card_MixedB
statement:
lemma card_MixedB :
    Nat.card {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin n // MixedB g x} = bCard g
proof:
:= by
  show Nat.card {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin n // x.isRight ∧ IsMixed g x} = bCard g
  rw [Nat.card_congr (sumRightSubtypeEquiv (IsMixed g))]
  rfl

name: CongruenceTheory.card_stabilizer_dvd_A
statement:
theorem card_stabilizer_dvd_A :
    Nat.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(Hgrp n) g) ∣
      (n - aCard g)! * (n - bCard g)! * (aCard g)!
proof:
:= by
  have hdvd := Subgroup.card_dvd_of_injective (restrictHom (n := n) g) (restrictHom_injective g)
  rw [Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_perm, Nat.card_perm, Nat.card_perm,
    card_NonMixedA, card_NonMixedB, card_MixedA, ← mul_assoc] at hdvd
  exact hdvd

name: CongruenceTheory.card_stabilizer_dvd_B
statement:
theorem card_stabilizer_dvd_B :
    Nat.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(Hgrp n) g) ∣
      (n - aCard g)! * (n - bCard g)! * (bCard g)!
proof:
:= by
  have hdvd := Subgroup.card_dvd_of_injective (restrictHom' (n := n) g) (restrictHom'_injective g)
  rw [Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_perm, Nat.card_perm, Nat.card_perm,
    card_NonMixedA, card_NonMixedB, card_MixedB, ← mul_assoc] at hdvd
  exact hdvd

name: CongruenceTheory.card_stabilizer_dvd_min
statement:
theorem card_stabilizer_dvd_min :
    Nat.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(Hgrp n) g) ∣
      (n - aCard g)! * (n - bCard g)! * min (aCard g)! (bCard g)!
proof:
:= by
  have hA := card_stabilizer_dvd_A g
  have hB := card_stabilizer_dvd_B g
  rcases le_total (aCard g)! (bCard g)! with hle | hle
  · rwa [min_eq_left hle]
  · rwa [min_eq_right hle]

name: CongruenceTheory.v2_stabilizer_le
statement:
theorem v2_stabilizer_le :
    v2 (Nat.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(Hgrp n) g)) ≤
      v2 ((n - aCard g)!) + v2 ((n - bCard g)!) + min (v2 ((aCard g)!)) (v2 ((bCard g)!))
proof:
:= by
  have hdvd := card_stabilizer_dvd_min g
  have hstabpos : Nat.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(Hgrp n) g) ≠ 0 := Nat.card_ne_zero.mpr
    ⟨⟨1, MulAction.stabilizer ↥(Hgrp n) g |>.one_mem⟩, inferInstance⟩
  have hprodpos : (n - aCard g)! * (n - bCard g)! * min (aCard g)! (bCard g)! ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hle : (Nat.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(Hgrp n) g)).factorization 2 ≤
      ((n - aCard g)! * (n - bCard g)! * min (aCard g)! (bCard g)!).factorization 2 :=
    Nat.factorization_le_factorization_of_dvd_right hdvd hstabpos hprodpos
  have hval : ((n - aCard g)! * (n - bCard g)! * min (aCard g)! (bCard g)!).factorization 2 =
      v2 ((n - aCard g)!) + v2 ((n - bCard g)!) + v2 (min (aCard g)! (bCard g)!) := by
    rw [Nat.factorization_mul (by positivity) (by positivity),
      Nat.factorization_mul (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _) (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)]
    simp [v2]
  have hminv2 : v2 (min (aCard g)! (bCard g)!) = min (v2 ((aCard g)!)) (v2 ((bCard g)!)) := by
    rcases le_total (aCard g) (bCard g) with hle' | hle'
    · rw [min_eq_left (Nat.factorial_le hle')]
      exact (min_eq_left (v2_factorial_mono hle')).symm
    · rw [min_eq_right (Nat.factorial_le hle')]
      exact (min_eq_right (v2_factorial_mono hle')).symm
  rw [hval, hminv2] at hle
  simpa [v2] using hle

name: CongruenceTheory.exists_mixed_pair
statement: lemma exists_mixed_pair (hg : g ∉ Hgrp n) : ∃ a b, g (Sum.inl a) = Sum.inr b
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hc
  push_neg at hc
  apply hg
  apply Equiv.Perm.mem_sumCongrHom_range_of_perm_mapsTo_inl
  rintro x ⟨a, rfl⟩
  rcases hgx : g (Sum.inl a) with a' | b'
  · exact ⟨a', rfl⟩
  · exact absurd hgx (hc a b')

name: CongruenceTheory.one_le_aCard
statement: theorem one_le_aCard (hg : g ∉ Hgrp n) : 1 ≤ aCard g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := exists_mixed_pair g hg
  have hmixed : IsMixed g (Sum.inl a) := ⟨⟨a, SameCycle.refl g _⟩, ⟨b, ⟨1, by simpa using hab⟩⟩⟩
  haveI : Nonempty {a : Fin n // IsMixed g (Sum.inl a)} := ⟨⟨a, hmixed⟩⟩
  exact Nat.card_pos

name: CongruenceTheory.one_le_bCard
statement: theorem one_le_bCard (hg : g ∉ Hgrp n) : 1 ≤ bCard g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := exists_mixed_pair g hg
  have hmixed : IsMixed g (Sum.inl a) := ⟨⟨a, SameCycle.refl g _⟩, ⟨b, ⟨1, by simpa using hab⟩⟩⟩
  have hsc : g.SameCycle (Sum.inl a) (Sum.inr b) := ⟨1, by simpa using hab⟩
  have hmixed' : IsMixed g (Sum.inr b) := (isMixed_of_sameCycle g hsc).mp hmixed
  haveI : Nonempty {b : Fin n // IsMixed g (Sum.inr b)} := ⟨⟨b, hmixed'⟩⟩
  exact Nat.card_pos

name: CongruenceTheory.aCard_le
statement: theorem aCard_le (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) : aCard g ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [aCard]
  have : Nat.card {a : Fin n // IsMixed g (Sum.inl a)} ≤ Nat.card (Fin n) :=
    Nat.card_le_card_of_injective Subtype.val Subtype.val_injective
  simpa using this

name: CongruenceTheory.bCard_le
statement: theorem bCard_le (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) : bCard g ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [bCard]
  have : Nat.card {b : Fin n // IsMixed g (Sum.inr b)} ≤ Nat.card (Fin n) :=
    Nat.card_le_card_of_injective Subtype.val Subtype.val_injective
  simpa using this

name: CongruenceTheory.dvdCoeffs_iff_forall_specialization
statement:
theorem dvdCoeffs_iff_forall_specialization (m : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) :
    DvdCoeffs m P ↔
      ∀ (R : Type) [CommRing R] (φ : ℕ → R),
        (m : R) ∣ MvPolynomial.eval₂ (Int.castRingHom R) φ P
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hP R _ φ
    rw [MvPolynomial.eval₂_eq]
    apply Finset.dvd_sum
    intro d _
    have hcd : (m : ℤ) ∣ MvPolynomial.coeff d P := hP d
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hcd
    refine ⟨(c : R) * d.prod fun i k => φ i ^ k, ?_⟩
    rw [hc, map_mul, mul_assoc]
    simp [map_natCast, map_intCast, Finsupp.prod]
  · intro hall
    have h := hall (MvPolynomial ℕ (ZMod m)) (fun j => MvPolynomial.X j)
    have hcast : (Int.castRingHom (MvPolynomial ℕ (ZMod m))) =
        (MvPolynomial.C).comp (Int.castRingHom (ZMod m)) := by
      apply Subsingleton.elim
    have heval : MvPolynomial.eval₂ (Int.castRingHom (MvPolynomial ℕ (ZMod m)))
        (fun j => MvPolynomial.X j) P = MvPolynomial.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod m)) P := by
      rw [hcast]
      exact DFunLike.congr_fun
        (MvPolynomial.map_eq_eval₂Hom_C_comp (Int.castRingHom (ZMod m))).symm P
    rw [heval] at h
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := h
    apply dvdCoeffs_of_map_eq_zero
    have hm0 : ((m : ℕ) : MvPolynomial ℕ (ZMod m)) = 0 := by
      have := ZMod.natCast_self m
      calc ((m : ℕ) : MvPolynomial ℕ (ZMod m)) = MvPolynomial.C ((m : ℕ) : ZMod m) := by
            push_cast; rfl
        _ = MvPolynomial.C 0 := by rw [this]
        _ = 0 := map_zero _
    rw [hQ, hm0, zero_mul]

name: CongruenceTheory.class_card_dvd
statement:
theorem class_card_dvd (s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin (2 ^ s) ⊕ Fin (2 ^ s)))
    (hg : g ∈ (HSet (2 ^ s))ᶜ) :
    (2 : ℕ) ^ (2 * s - 1) ∣ (Finset.univ.filter ((orbRel (2 ^ s)).r g)).card
proof:
:= by
  have hgH : g ∉ Hgrp (2 ^ s) := by
    rw [mem_Hgrp_iff]; simpa using hg
  have ha1 : 1 ≤ aCard g := one_le_aCard g hgH
  have hb1 : 1 ≤ bCard g := one_le_bCard g hgH
  have han : aCard g ≤ 2 ^ s := aCard_le g
  have hbn : bCard g ≤ 2 ^ s := bCard_le g
  have hcent := v2_stabilizer_le g
  have horbit := orbit_bound s (aCard g) (bCard g) hs ha1 han hb1 hbn
  have hprod := class_card_mul_stabilizer_card (2 ^ s) g
  have hstabne : Fintype.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(Hgrp (2 ^ s)) g) ≠ 0 := by
    have : Nonempty ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(Hgrp (2 ^ s)) g) := ⟨1, Subgroup.one_mem _⟩
    exact Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hstab_eq : Nat.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(Hgrp (2 ^ s)) g) =
      Fintype.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(Hgrp (2 ^ s)) g) := Nat.card_eq_fintype_card
  rw [hstab_eq] at hcent
  have hclassne : (Finset.univ.filter ((orbRel (2 ^ s)).r g)).card ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    rw [hz, zero_mul] at hprod
    exact Nat.factorial_ne_zero _ (by
      have := hprod
      nlinarith [Nat.factorial_pos (2 ^ s)])
  have hval : v2 (Fintype.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(Hgrp (2 ^ s)) g)) +
      v2 (Finset.univ.filter ((orbRel (2 ^ s)).r g)).card = 2 * v2 ((2 ^ s)!) := by
    have hfa := congrArg (fun x => x.factorization 2) hprod
    simp only [v2] at hcent ⊢
    rw [Nat.factorization_mul hclassne hstabne] at hfa
    rw [Nat.factorization_mul (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _) (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)] at hfa
    simp only [Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply] at hfa
    omega
  have h2s1 : 2 * s - 1 ≤ v2 (Finset.univ.filter ((orbRel (2 ^ s)).r g)).card := by omega
  have := (Nat.Prime.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization (by norm_num) hclassne).mpr h2s1
  simpa [v2] using this

name: CongruenceTheory.mem_compl_of_orbRel
statement:
lemma mem_compl_of_orbRel {n : ℕ} {g g' : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)}
    (hg : g ∈ (HSet n)ᶜ) (hr : (orbRel n).r g' g) : g' ∈ (HSet n)ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := hr
  exact compl_HSet_invariant n h g hg

name: CongruenceTheory.filter_compl_eq_filter_univ
proof:
:= by
  ext g'
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, and_iff_right_iff_imp]
  exact fun hr => mem_compl_of_orbRel hg ((orbRel n).iseqv.symm hr)

name: CongruenceTheory.strong_two_adic
statement:
theorem strong_two_adic (s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) :
    ∃ Q : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ,
      CpermSum (2 ^ s) - Cperm (2 ^ s) * Cperm (2 ^ s) =
        ((2 ^ (2 * s - 1) : ℕ) : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) * Q
proof:
:= by
  have hmain := dvd_sum_of_const_on_classes (orbRel (2 ^ s)).r
    (fun x => (orbRel (2 ^ s)).iseqv.refl x)
    (fun x y h => (orbRel (2 ^ s)).iseqv.symm h)
    (fun x y z h1 h2 => (orbRel (2 ^ s)).iseqv.trans h1 h2)
    ci (fun x y h => ci_const_on_orbit (2 ^ s) x y h) (2 ^ (2 * s - 1)) (HSet (2 ^ s))ᶜ
    (fun x hx => by
      rw [filter_compl_eq_filter_univ hx]
      exact_mod_cast class_card_dvd s hs x hx)
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hmain
  refine ⟨Q, ?_⟩
  rw [CpermSum_sub_Cperm_sq, hQ]

name: CongruenceTheory.evalAt_C
statement:
@[simp] lemma evalAt_C {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (r : ℕ → R) (a : ℤ) :
    evalAt r (MvPolynomial.C a) = (a : R)
proof:
:= by
  simp [evalAt]

name: CongruenceTheory.dvdCoeffs_shift_mod
statement: lemma dvdCoeffs_shift_mod (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : DvdCoeffs k (C (n + k) - C n * C k)
proof:
:= by
  have hmodk : DvdCoeffs k (C (n + k) - C k * C n) :=
    dvdCoeffs_of_map_eq_zero (by
      rw [map_sub, map_mul]; exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (universal_shift_mod k hk n))
  have e1 : C (n + k) - C k * C n = C (n + k) - C n * C k := by ring
  rwa [e1] at hmodk

name: CongruenceTheory.Qpoly_spec
statement:
theorem Qpoly_spec (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    C (n + k) - C n * C k = MvPolynomial.C (k : ℤ) * Qpoly n k hk
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec ((MvPolynomial.C_dvd_iff_dvd_coeff (k : ℤ) (C (n + k) - C n * C k)).mpr
    (dvdCoeffs_shift_mod n k hk))

name: CongruenceTheory.Hpoly_spec
statement:
theorem Hpoly_spec (n k : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    C (n + k) - C n * C k = MvPolynomial.C ((Nat.lcm n k : ℕ) : ℤ) * Hpoly n k hn hk
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec ((MvPolynomial.C_dvd_iff_dvd_coeff ((Nat.lcm n k : ℕ) : ℤ)
    (C (n + k) - C n * C k)).mpr (universal_shift_lcm n k hn hk))

name: CongruenceTheory.base_change_mod
statement:
theorem base_change_mod {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (r : ℕ → R) (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    cVal r (n + k) - cVal r n * cVal r k = (k : R) * evalAt r (Qpoly n k hk)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (evalAt r) (Qpoly_spec n k hk)
  simpa [cVal, map_sub, map_mul] using h

name: CongruenceTheory.base_change_lcm
statement:
theorem base_change_lcm {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (r : ℕ → R) (n k : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    cVal r (n + k) - cVal r n * cVal r k = (Nat.lcm n k : R) * evalAt r (Hpoly n k hn hk)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (evalAt r) (Hpoly_spec n k hn hk)
  simpa [cVal, map_sub, map_mul] using h

name: CongruenceTheory.base_change_two_adic
statement:
theorem base_change_two_adic {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (r : ℕ → R) (s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) :
    ∃ Qr : R, cpermSumVal r (2 ^ s) - cpermVal r (2 ^ s) * cpermVal r (2 ^ s) =
      (2 ^ (2 * s - 1) : R) * Qr
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := strong_two_adic s hs
  refine ⟨evalAt r Q, ?_⟩
  have h := congrArg (evalAt r) hQ
  simp only [map_sub, map_mul, map_natCast] at h
  rw [cpermVal, cpermSumVal]
  convert h using 2
  push_cast
  ring

name: CongruenceTheory.isMixedPair_of_sameCycle
statement:
lemma isMixedPair_of_sameCycle {x y : Fin n ⊕ Fin k} (h : g.SameCycle x y) :
    IsMixedPair g x ↔ IsMixedPair g y
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsMixedPair
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩⟩
    exact ⟨⟨a, h.symm.trans ha⟩, ⟨b, h.symm.trans hb⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩⟩
    exact ⟨⟨a, h.trans ha⟩, ⟨b, h.trans hb⟩⟩

name: CongruenceTheory.fixed_of_commute_of_fixed_pair
statement:
lemma fixed_of_commute_of_fixed_pair {h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)} (hcomm : Commute h g)
    {x y : Fin n ⊕ Fin k} (hxy : g.SameCycle x y) (hx : h x = x) : h y = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hxy
  have hc : Commute h (g ^ i) := hcomm.zpow_right i
  calc h y = h ((g ^ i) x) := by rw [hi]
    _ = ((g ^ i) * h) x := by rw [← Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, ← hc]
    _ = (g ^ i) (h x) := rfl
    _ = (g ^ i) x := by rw [hx]
    _ = y := hi

name: CongruenceTheory.sameCycle_apply_of_commute_pair
statement:
lemma sameCycle_apply_of_commute_pair {h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)} (hcomm : Commute h g)
    {x y : Fin n ⊕ Fin k} (hxy : g.SameCycle x y) : g.SameCycle (h x) (h y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hxy
  refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
  have hc : h * g ^ i = g ^ i * h := hcomm.zpow_right i
  calc (g ^ i) (h x) = (g ^ i * h) x := rfl
    _ = (h * g ^ i) x := by rw [hc]
    _ = h ((g ^ i) x) := rfl
    _ = h y := by rw [hi]

name: CongruenceTheory.isMixedPair_apply_of_mem
statement:
lemma isMixedPair_apply_of_mem {h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)} (hH : h ∈ HgrpPair n k)
    (hcomm : Commute h g) {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin k} (hx : IsMixedPair g x) : IsMixedPair g (h x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hH
  refine ⟨⟨p.1 a, ?_⟩, ⟨p.2 b, ?_⟩⟩
  · have hs := sameCycle_apply_of_commute_pair g hcomm ha
    rwa [show h (Sum.inl a) = Sum.inl (p.1 a) by
      rw [← hp, Equiv.Perm.sumCongrHom_apply]; rfl] at hs
  · have hs := sameCycle_apply_of_commute_pair g hcomm hb
    rwa [show h (Sum.inr b) = Sum.inr (p.2 b) by
      rw [← hp, Equiv.Perm.sumCongrHom_apply]; rfl] at hs

name: CongruenceTheory.isMixedPair_apply_iff
statement:
lemma isMixedPair_apply_iff {h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)} (hH : h ∈ HgrpPair n k)
    (hcomm : Commute h g) (x : Fin n ⊕ Fin k) : IsMixedPair g (h x) ↔ IsMixedPair g x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hm => ?_, isMixedPair_apply_of_mem g hH hcomm⟩
  have hH' : h⁻¹ ∈ HgrpPair n k := Subgroup.inv_mem _ hH
  have hcomm' : Commute h⁻¹ g := hcomm.inv_left
  have := isMixedPair_apply_of_mem g hH' hcomm' hm
  simpa using this

name: CongruenceTheory.isLeft_apply_of_mem_pair
statement:
lemma isLeft_apply_of_mem_pair {h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)} (hH : h ∈ HgrpPair n k)
    {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin k} (hx : x.isLeft) : (h x).isLeft
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hH
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Sum.isLeft_iff.mp hx
  rw [show h (Sum.inl a) = Sum.inl (p.1 a) by
    rw [← hp, Equiv.Perm.sumCongrHom_apply]; rfl]
  exact rfl

name: CongruenceTheory.isRight_apply_of_mem_pair
statement:
lemma isRight_apply_of_mem_pair {h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)} (hH : h ∈ HgrpPair n k)
    {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin k} (hx : x.isRight) : (h x).isRight
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hH
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Sum.isRight_iff.mp hx
  rw [show h (Sum.inr b) = Sum.inr (p.2 b) by
    rw [← hp, Equiv.Perm.sumCongrHom_apply]; rfl]
  exact rfl

name: CongruenceTheory.mapsTo_MixedAPair
statement:
lemma mapsTo_MixedAPair {h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)} (hH : h ∈ HgrpPair n k)
    (hcomm : Commute h g) {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin k} (hx : MixedAPair g x) : MixedAPair g (h x)
proof:
:=
  ⟨isLeft_apply_of_mem_pair hH hx.1, isMixedPair_apply_of_mem g hH hcomm hx.2⟩

name: CongruenceTheory.mapsTo_MixedBPair
statement:
lemma mapsTo_MixedBPair {h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)} (hH : h ∈ HgrpPair n k)
    (hcomm : Commute h g) {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin k} (hx : MixedBPair g x) : MixedBPair g (h x)
proof:
:=
  ⟨isRight_apply_of_mem_pair hH hx.1, isMixedPair_apply_of_mem g hH hcomm hx.2⟩

name: CongruenceTheory.mapsTo_NonMixedAPair
statement:
lemma mapsTo_NonMixedAPair {h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)} (hH : h ∈ HgrpPair n k)
    (hcomm : Commute h g) {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin k} (hx : x.isLeft ∧ ¬ IsMixedPair g x) :
    (h x).isLeft ∧ ¬ IsMixedPair g (h x)
proof:
:=
  ⟨isLeft_apply_of_mem_pair hH hx.1, fun hm => hx.2 ((isMixedPair_apply_iff g hH hcomm x).mp hm)⟩

name: CongruenceTheory.mapsTo_NonMixedBPair
statement:
lemma mapsTo_NonMixedBPair {h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)} (hH : h ∈ HgrpPair n k)
    (hcomm : Commute h g) {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin k} (hx : x.isRight ∧ ¬ IsMixedPair g x) :
    (h x).isRight ∧ ¬ IsMixedPair g (h x)
proof:
:=
  ⟨isRight_apply_of_mem_pair hH hx.1, fun hm => hx.2 ((isMixedPair_apply_iff g hH hcomm x).mp hm)⟩

name: CongruenceTheory.eq_of_agree_pair
statement:
theorem eq_of_agree_pair {h1 h2 : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)} (hH1 : h1 ∈ HgrpPair n k)
    (hH2 : h2 ∈ HgrpPair n k) (hcomm1 : Commute h1 g) (hcomm2 : Commute h2 g)
    (hA : ∀ x, x.isLeft → ¬ IsMixedPair g x → h1 x = h2 x)
    (hB : ∀ x, x.isRight → ¬ IsMixedPair g x → h1 x = h2 x)
    (hMa : ∀ x, MixedAPair g x → h1 x = h2 x) :
    h1 = h2
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm : Commute (h1⁻¹ * h2) g := Commute.mul_left hcomm1.inv_left hcomm2
  ext x
  by_cases hx : IsMixedPair g x
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hx.1
    have hMaa : MixedAPair g (Sum.inl a) := ⟨rfl, (isMixedPair_of_sameCycle g ha).mp hx⟩
    have hfix : (h1⁻¹ * h2) (Sum.inl a) = Sum.inl a := by
      have heq := hMa (Sum.inl a) hMaa
      show h1⁻¹ (h2 (Sum.inl a)) = Sum.inl a
      rw [← heq]
      simp
    have hfixx := fixed_of_commute_of_fixed_pair g hcomm ha.symm hfix
    show h1 x = h2 x
    have h2x' : h1⁻¹ (h2 x) = x := hfixx
    have := congrArg h1 h2x'
    simpa using this.symm
  · cases x with
    | inl a => exact hA (Sum.inl a) rfl hx
    | inr b => exact hB (Sum.inr b) rfl hx

name: CongruenceTheory.stab_iff_commute_pair
statement:
lemma stab_iff_commute_pair (h : ↥(HgrpPair n k)) :
    h ∈ MulAction.stabilizer ↥(HgrpPair n k) g ↔ Commute (h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)) g
proof:
:= by
  rw [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff, smul_def_pair]
  constructor
  · intro he
    have h2 : (h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)) * g * (h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k))⁻¹ *
        (h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)) = g * (h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)) := by rw [he]
    have h3 : (h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)) * g = g * (h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)) := by
      simpa [mul_assoc] using h2
    exact h3
  · intro hc
    show (h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)) * g * (h : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k))⁻¹ = g
    rw [hc]
    simp [mul_assoc]

name: CongruenceTheory.subtypePermOfFintype_mul_pair
statement:
lemma subtypePermOfFintype_mul_pair {p : Fin n ⊕ Fin k → Prop} [Finite {x // p x}]
    {f1 f2 : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)} (h1 : ∀ x, p x → p (f1 x)) (h2 : ∀ x, p x → p (f2 x)) :
    Equiv.Perm.subtypePermOfFintype (f1 * f2) (fun x hx => h1 (f2 x) (h2 x hx)) =
      Equiv.Perm.subtypePermOfFintype f1 h1 * Equiv.Perm.subtypePermOfFintype f2 h2
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨x, hx⟩
  simp [Equiv.Perm.subtypePermOfFintype_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]

name: CongruenceTheory.restrictTriplePair_mul
statement:
lemma restrictTriplePair_mul (h1 h2 : ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(HgrpPair n k) g)) :
    restrictTriplePair g (h1 * h2) = restrictTriplePair g h1 * restrictTriplePair g h2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [restrictTriplePair, Prod.mk_mul_mk, Prod.mk.injEq]
  exact ⟨subtypePermOfFintype_mul_pair _ _, subtypePermOfFintype_mul_pair _ _,
    subtypePermOfFintype_mul_pair _ _⟩

name: CongruenceTheory.restrictHomPair_injective
statement: theorem restrictHomPair_injective : Function.Injective (restrictHomPair (n := n) (k := k) g)
proof:
:= by
  intro h1 h2 heq
  simp only [restrictHomPair, MonoidHom.mk'_apply] at heq
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply eq_of_agree_pair g h1.1.2 h2.1.2 ((stab_iff_commute_pair g h1.1).mp h1.2)
    ((stab_iff_commute_pair g h2.1).mp h2.2)
  · intro x hxl hxm
    have h0 := congrArg Prod.fst heq
    have hx := Equiv.ext_iff.mp h0 ⟨x, hxl, hxm⟩
    simpa [restrictTriplePair, Equiv.Perm.subtypePermOfFintype_apply] using hx
  · intro x hxr hxm
    have h0 := congrArg (Prod.fst ∘ Prod.snd) heq
    have hx := Equiv.ext_iff.mp h0 ⟨x, hxr, hxm⟩
    simpa [restrictTriplePair, Equiv.Perm.subtypePermOfFintype_apply] using hx
  · intro x hxm
    have h0 := congrArg (Prod.snd ∘ Prod.snd) heq
    have hx := Equiv.ext_iff.mp h0 ⟨x, hxm⟩
    simpa [restrictTriplePair, Equiv.Perm.subtypePermOfFintype_apply] using hx

name: CongruenceTheory.eq_of_agree_pair'
statement:
theorem eq_of_agree_pair' {h1 h2 : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)} (hcomm1 : Commute h1 g)
    (hcomm2 : Commute h2 g)
    (hA : ∀ x, x.isLeft → ¬ IsMixedPair g x → h1 x = h2 x)
    (hB : ∀ x, x.isRight → ¬ IsMixedPair g x → h1 x = h2 x)
    (hMb : ∀ x, MixedBPair g x → h1 x = h2 x) :
    h1 = h2
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm : Commute (h1⁻¹ * h2) g := Commute.mul_left hcomm1.inv_left hcomm2
  ext x
  by_cases hx : IsMixedPair g x
  · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hx.2
    have hMbb : MixedBPair g (Sum.inr b) := ⟨rfl, (isMixedPair_of_sameCycle g hb).mp hx⟩
    have hfix : (h1⁻¹ * h2) (Sum.inr b) = Sum.inr b := by
      have heq := hMb (Sum.inr b) hMbb
      show h1⁻¹ (h2 (Sum.inr b)) = Sum.inr b
      rw [← heq]
      simp
    have hfixx := fixed_of_commute_of_fixed_pair g hcomm hb.symm hfix
    show h1 x = h2 x
    have h2x' : h1⁻¹ (h2 x) = x := hfixx
    have := congrArg h1 h2x'
    simpa using this.symm
  · cases x with
    | inl a => exact hA (Sum.inl a) rfl hx
    | inr b => exact hB (Sum.inr b) rfl hx

name: CongruenceTheory.restrictTriplePair'_mul
statement:
lemma restrictTriplePair'_mul (h1 h2 : ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(HgrpPair n k) g)) :
    restrictTriplePair' g (h1 * h2) = restrictTriplePair' g h1 * restrictTriplePair' g h2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [restrictTriplePair', Prod.mk_mul_mk, Prod.mk.injEq]
  exact ⟨subtypePermOfFintype_mul_pair _ _, subtypePermOfFintype_mul_pair _ _,
    subtypePermOfFintype_mul_pair _ _⟩

name: CongruenceTheory.restrictHomPair'_injective
statement: theorem restrictHomPair'_injective : Function.Injective (restrictHomPair' (n := n) (k := k) g)
proof:
:= by
  intro h1 h2 heq
  simp only [restrictHomPair', MonoidHom.mk'_apply] at heq
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply eq_of_agree_pair' g ((stab_iff_commute_pair g h1.1).mp h1.2)
    ((stab_iff_commute_pair g h2.1).mp h2.2)
  · intro x hxl hxm
    have h0 := congrArg Prod.fst heq
    have hx := Equiv.ext_iff.mp h0 ⟨x, hxl, hxm⟩
    simpa [restrictTriplePair', Equiv.Perm.subtypePermOfFintype_apply] using hx
  · intro x hxr hxm
    have h0 := congrArg (Prod.fst ∘ Prod.snd) heq
    have hx := Equiv.ext_iff.mp h0 ⟨x, hxr, hxm⟩
    simpa [restrictTriplePair', Equiv.Perm.subtypePermOfFintype_apply] using hx
  · intro x hxm
    have h0 := congrArg (Prod.snd ∘ Prod.snd) heq
    have hx := Equiv.ext_iff.mp h0 ⟨x, hxm⟩
    simpa [restrictTriplePair', Equiv.Perm.subtypePermOfFintype_apply] using hx

name: CongruenceTheory.card_NonMixedAPair
statement:
lemma card_NonMixedAPair :
    Nat.card {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin k // x.isLeft ∧ ¬ IsMixedPair g x} = n - aCardPair g
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_congr (sumLeftSubtypeEquiv (fun x => ¬ IsMixedPair g x))]
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype_compl]
  simp [aCardPair, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin]

name: CongruenceTheory.card_NonMixedBPair
statement:
lemma card_NonMixedBPair :
    Nat.card {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin k // x.isRight ∧ ¬ IsMixedPair g x} = k - bCardPair g
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_congr (sumRightSubtypeEquiv (fun x => ¬ IsMixedPair g x))]
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype_compl]
  simp [bCardPair, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin]

name: CongruenceTheory.card_MixedAPair
statement:
lemma card_MixedAPair :
    Nat.card {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin k // MixedAPair g x} = aCardPair g
proof:
:= by
  show Nat.card {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin k // x.isLeft ∧ IsMixedPair g x} = aCardPair g
  rw [Nat.card_congr (sumLeftSubtypeEquiv (IsMixedPair g))]
  rfl

name: CongruenceTheory.card_MixedBPair
statement:
lemma card_MixedBPair :
    Nat.card {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin k // MixedBPair g x} = bCardPair g
proof:
:= by
  show Nat.card {x : Fin n ⊕ Fin k // x.isRight ∧ IsMixedPair g x} = bCardPair g
  rw [Nat.card_congr (sumRightSubtypeEquiv (IsMixedPair g))]
  rfl

name: CongruenceTheory.card_stabilizer_dvd_A_pair
statement:
theorem card_stabilizer_dvd_A_pair :
    Nat.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(HgrpPair n k) g) ∣
      (n - aCardPair g)! * (k - bCardPair g)! * (aCardPair g)!
proof:
:= by
  have hdvd := Subgroup.card_dvd_of_injective (restrictHomPair (n := n) (k := k) g)
    (restrictHomPair_injective g)
  rw [Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_perm, Nat.card_perm, Nat.card_perm,
    card_NonMixedAPair, card_NonMixedBPair, card_MixedAPair, ← mul_assoc] at hdvd
  exact hdvd

name: CongruenceTheory.card_stabilizer_dvd_B_pair
statement:
theorem card_stabilizer_dvd_B_pair :
    Nat.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(HgrpPair n k) g) ∣
      (n - aCardPair g)! * (k - bCardPair g)! * (bCardPair g)!
proof:
:= by
  have hdvd := Subgroup.card_dvd_of_injective (restrictHomPair' (n := n) (k := k) g)
    (restrictHomPair'_injective g)
  rw [Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_perm, Nat.card_perm, Nat.card_perm,
    card_NonMixedAPair, card_NonMixedBPair, card_MixedBPair, ← mul_assoc] at hdvd
  exact hdvd

name: CongruenceTheory.card_stabilizer_dvd_min_pair
statement:
theorem card_stabilizer_dvd_min_pair :
    Nat.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(HgrpPair n k) g) ∣
      (n - aCardPair g)! * (k - bCardPair g)! * min (aCardPair g)! (bCardPair g)!
proof:
:= by
  have hA := card_stabilizer_dvd_A_pair g
  have hB := card_stabilizer_dvd_B_pair g
  rcases le_total (aCardPair g)! (bCardPair g)! with hle | hle
  · rwa [min_eq_left hle]
  · rwa [min_eq_right hle]

name: CongruenceTheory.vp_stabilizer_le_pair
statement:
theorem vp_stabilizer_le_pair (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    padicValNat p (Nat.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(HgrpPair n k) g)) ≤
      padicValNat p ((n - aCardPair g)!) + padicValNat p ((k - bCardPair g)!) +
        min (padicValNat p ((aCardPair g)!)) (padicValNat p ((bCardPair g)!))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Fact.mk hp
  have hdvd := card_stabilizer_dvd_min_pair g
  have hstabpos : Nat.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(HgrpPair n k) g) ≠ 0 := Nat.card_ne_zero.mpr
    ⟨⟨1, MulAction.stabilizer ↥(HgrpPair n k) g |>.one_mem⟩, inferInstance⟩
  have hprodpos :
      (n - aCardPair g)! * (k - bCardPair g)! * min (aCardPair g)! (bCardPair g)! ≠ 0 := by
    positivity
  have hle : (Nat.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer ↥(HgrpPair n k) g)).factorization p ≤
      ((n - aCardPair g)! * (k - bCardPair g)! * min (aCardPair g)! (bCardPair g)!).factorization
        p :=
    Nat.factorization_le_factorization_of_dvd_right hdvd hstabpos hprodpos
  have hval : ((n - aCardPair g)! * (k - bCardPair g)! *
      min (aCardPair g)! (bCardPair g)!).factorization p =
      padicValNat p ((n - aCardPair g)!) + padicValNat p ((k - bCardPair g)!) +
        padicValNat p (min (aCardPair g)! (bCardPair g)!) := by
    rw [Nat.factorization_mul (by positivity) (by positivity),
      Nat.factorization_mul (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _) (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)]
    simp [Nat.factorization_def _ hp]
  have hminv : padicValNat p (min (aCardPair g)! (bCardPair g)!) =
      min (padicValNat p ((aCardPair g)!)) (padicValNat p ((bCardPair g)!)) := by
    rcases le_total (aCardPair g) (bCardPair g) with hle' | hle'
    · rw [min_eq_left (Nat.factorial_le hle')]
      exact (min_eq_left (padicValNat_factorial_mono p hp hle')).symm
    · rw [min_eq_right (Nat.factorial_le hle')]
      exact (min_eq_right (padicValNat_factorial_mono p hp hle')).symm
  rw [hval, hminv] at hle
  simpa [Nat.factorization_def _ hp] using hle

name: CongruenceTheory.exists_mixed_pair_pair
statement: lemma exists_mixed_pair_pair (hg : g ∉ HgrpPair n k) : ∃ a b, g (Sum.inl a) = Sum.inr b
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hc
  push Not at hc
  apply hg
  apply Equiv.Perm.mem_sumCongrHom_range_of_perm_mapsTo_inl
  rintro x ⟨a, rfl⟩
  rcases hgx : g (Sum.inl a) with a' | b'
  · exact ⟨a', rfl⟩
  · exact absurd hgx (hc a b')

name: CongruenceTheory.one_le_aCardPair
statement: theorem one_le_aCardPair (hg : g ∉ HgrpPair n k) : 1 ≤ aCardPair g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := exists_mixed_pair_pair g hg
  have hmixed : IsMixedPair g (Sum.inl a) := ⟨⟨a, SameCycle.refl g _⟩, ⟨b, ⟨1, by simpa using hab⟩⟩⟩
  haveI : Nonempty {a : Fin n // IsMixedPair g (Sum.inl a)} := ⟨⟨a, hmixed⟩⟩
  exact Nat.card_pos

name: CongruenceTheory.one_le_bCardPair
statement: theorem one_le_bCardPair (hg : g ∉ HgrpPair n k) : 1 ≤ bCardPair g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := exists_mixed_pair_pair g hg
  have hmixed : IsMixedPair g (Sum.inl a) := ⟨⟨a, SameCycle.refl g _⟩, ⟨b, ⟨1, by simpa using hab⟩⟩⟩
  have hsc : g.SameCycle (Sum.inl a) (Sum.inr b) := ⟨1, by simpa using hab⟩
  have hmixed' : IsMixedPair g (Sum.inr b) := (isMixedPair_of_sameCycle g hsc).mp hmixed
  haveI : Nonempty {b : Fin k // IsMixedPair g (Sum.inr b)} := ⟨⟨b, hmixed'⟩⟩
  exact Nat.card_pos

name: CongruenceTheory.aCardPair_le
statement: theorem aCardPair_le (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)) : aCardPair g ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [aCardPair]
  have : Nat.card {a : Fin n // IsMixedPair g (Sum.inl a)} ≤ Nat.card (Fin n) :=
    Nat.card_le_card_of_injective Subtype.val Subtype.val_injective
  simpa using this

name: CongruenceTheory.bCardPair_le
statement: theorem bCardPair_le (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)) : bCardPair g ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [bCardPair]
  have : Nat.card {b : Fin k // IsMixedPair g (Sum.inr b)} ≤ Nat.card (Fin k) :=
    Nat.card_le_card_of_injective Subtype.val Subtype.val_injective
  simpa using this

name: CongruenceTheory.fall_pos
statement: lemma fall_pos (n r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ n) : 0 < fall n r
proof:
:= by
  rw [fall]
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro i hi
  have : i < r := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
  omega

name: CongruenceTheory.vars_C_le
statement: theorem vars_C_le : ∀ n : ℕ, (C n).vars ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    match n with
    | 0 => rw [C_zero]; simp
    | m + 1 =>
      rw [C_succ]
      apply Finset.Subset.trans (MvPolynomial.vars_sum_subset _ _)
      apply Finset.biUnion_subset.mpr
      intro r hr
      have hrm : r ≤ m := by
        have := Finset.mem_range.mp hr; omega
      have hcast : ((fall m r : ℤ) : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) = MvPolynomial.C (fall m r) := by simp
      intro i hi
      have hi' : i ∈ (((fall m r : ℤ) : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) *
          (MvPolynomial.X (r + 1) * C (m - r))).vars := hi
      rw [hcast] at hi'
      have hfpos : fall m r ≠ 0 := (fall_pos m r hrm).ne'
      have hveq :=
        MvPolynomial.vars_C_mul (fall m r) hfpos (MvPolynomial.X (r + 1) * C (m - r))
      rw [hveq] at hi'
      have hsub2 :
          (MvPolynomial.X (r + 1) * C (m - r) : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ).vars ⊆
            (MvPolynomial.X (r + 1) : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ).vars ∪ (C (m - r)).vars :=
        MvPolynomial.vars_mul _ _
      have hunion := hsub2 hi'
      simp only [Finset.mem_union, MvPolynomial.vars_X, Finset.mem_singleton] at hunion
      rcases hunion with h | h
      · simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]; omega
      · have hmr := ih (m - r) (by omega) h
        simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hmr
        simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]; omega

name: CongruenceTheory.vars_Qpoly_le
statement: theorem vars_Qpoly_le (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : (Qpoly n k hk).vars ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 (n + k)
proof:
:= by
  have hspec := Qpoly_spec n k hk
  have hkne : (k : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : k ≠ 0)
  have heq : (MvPolynomial.C (k : ℤ) * Qpoly n k hk).vars = (Qpoly n k hk).vars :=
    MvPolynomial.vars_C_mul (k : ℤ) hkne (Qpoly n k hk)
  rw [← heq, ← hspec]
  intro x hx
  have hx1 : x ∈ (C (n + k)).vars ∪ (C n * C k).vars :=
    Finset.mem_of_subset (MvPolynomial.vars_sub_subset (p := C (n + k))) hx
  simp only [Finset.mem_union] at hx1
  rcases hx1 with h | h
  · exact vars_C_le (n + k) h
  · have h2 : x ∈ (C n).vars ∪ (C k).vars := MvPolynomial.vars_mul _ _ h
    simp only [Finset.mem_union] at h2
    rcases h2 with h3 | h3
    · have := vars_C_le n h3; simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at this ⊢; omega
    · have := vars_C_le k h3; simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at this ⊢; omega

name: CongruenceTheory.evalAt_congr_of_vars
statement:
theorem evalAt_congr_of_vars {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (Q : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ)
    (z z' : ℕ → R) (h : ∀ i ∈ Q.vars, z i = z' i) :
    evalAt z Q = evalAt z' Q
proof:
:= by
  show MvPolynomial.eval₂ (Int.castRingHom R) z Q = MvPolynomial.eval₂ (Int.castRingHom R) z' Q
  apply MvPolynomial.eval₂_congr
  intro i c hi hcoeff
  apply h
  rw [MvPolynomial.mem_vars_iff_mem_support]
  exact ⟨c, MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr hcoeff, hi⟩

name: CongruenceTheory.general_defect_denom_clear'
statement:
theorem general_defect_denom_clear' (F : ℚ⟦X⟧) (hF1 : constantCoeff F = 1)
    (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (D : ℕ) (hD : 0 < D) (z : ℕ → ℤ)
    (hz : ∀ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n + k), canonicalCoord m F = (z m : ℚ) / (D : ℚ)) :
    ∃ w : ℤ, (D : ℚ) ^ (n + k) * (egfCoeff F (n + k) - egfCoeff F n * egfCoeff F k) =
      (k : ℚ) * (w : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ :=
    evalAt_totalDegree_denom_clear (Qpoly n k hk) (n + k) (totalDegree_Qpoly_le n k hk) z D hD
  refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
  rw [general_defect_main F hF1 n k hk]
  have hcongr : evalAt (fun j => canonicalCoord j F) (Qpoly n k hk) =
      evalAt (fun j => (z j : ℚ) / (D : ℚ)) (Qpoly n k hk) := by
    apply evalAt_congr_of_vars
    intro i hi
    exact hz i (Finset.mem_of_subset (vars_Qpoly_le n k hk) hi)
  rw [hcongr]
  linear_combination -(k : ℚ) * hw

name: CongruenceTheory.common_denom_of_local
statement:
theorem common_denom_of_local (m n k : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℚ)
    (hu : ∀ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n + k), IsKLocal m (u j)) :
    ∃ (z : ℕ → ℤ) (D : ℕ), 0 < D ∧ Nat.Coprime D m ∧
      ∀ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n + k), u j = (z j : ℚ) / (D : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set a : ℕ → ℤ := fun j => if h : j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n + k) then (hu j h).choose else 0 with ha
  set b : ℕ → ℕ :=
    fun j => if h : j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n + k) then (hu j h).choose_spec.choose else 1 with hb
  have hspec : ∀ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n + k), 0 < b j ∧ Nat.Coprime (b j) m ∧
      u j = (a j : ℚ) / (b j : ℚ) := by
    intro j hj
    simp only [ha, hb, dif_pos hj]
    exact (hu j hj).choose_spec.choose_spec
  set D : ℕ := ∏ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n + k), b j with hDdef
  have hDpos : 0 < D := by
    apply Finset.prod_pos
    intro j hj
    exact (hspec j hj).1
  have hDcop : Nat.Coprime D m := by
    rw [hDdef]
    apply Nat.Coprime.prod_left
    intro j hj
    exact (hspec j hj).2.1
  refine ⟨fun j => a j * ((∏ i ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 (n + k)).erase j, b i : ℕ) : ℤ), D, hDpos,
    hDcop, ?_⟩
  intro j hj
  obtain ⟨hbpos, hbcop, hueq⟩ := hspec j hj
  have hDeq : D = b j * ∏ i ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 (n + k)).erase j, b i := by
    rw [hDdef, ← Finset.prod_erase_mul _ _ hj]; ring
  have hbne : (b j : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hbpos.ne'
  have hDne : (D : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hDpos.ne'
  have hprodne : (∏ i ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 (n + k)).erase j, (b i : ℚ)) ≠ 0 := by
    apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
    intro i hi
    exact_mod_cast (hspec i (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hi)).1.ne'
  rw [hueq]
  push_cast [hDeq]
  field_simp

name: CongruenceTheory.isKLocal_of_int_div_coprime_pow
statement:
theorem isKLocal_of_int_div_coprime_pow {m N : ℕ} (hN : Nat.Coprime N m) (w : ℤ) :
    IsKLocal m ((w : ℚ) / (N : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hN0 : N = 0
  · exact ⟨0, 1, one_pos, Nat.coprime_one_left m, by simp [hN0]⟩
  · exact ⟨w, N, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hN0, hN, rfl⟩

name: CongruenceTheory.local_locus
statement:
theorem local_locus (F : ℚ⟦X⟧) (hF1 : constantCoeff F = 1) (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (m : ℕ)
    (hu : ∀ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n + k), IsKLocal m (canonicalCoord j F)) :
    ∃ y : ℚ, egfCoeff F (n + k) - egfCoeff F n * egfCoeff F k = (k : ℚ) * y ∧ IsKLocal m y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, D, hDpos, hDcop, hDeq⟩ :=
    common_denom_of_local m n k (fun j => canonicalCoord j F) hu
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := general_defect_denom_clear' F hF1 n k hk D hDpos z hDeq
  refine ⟨(w : ℚ) / ((D : ℤ) ^ (n + k) : ℚ), ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hDne : ((D : ℚ)) ^ (n + k) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by exact_mod_cast hDpos.ne')
    field_simp
    push_cast at hw ⊢
    linear_combination hw
  · have hDpow : Nat.Coprime (D ^ (n + k)) m := Nat.Coprime.pow_left _ hDcop
    have := isKLocal_of_int_div_coprime_pow (m := m) (N := D ^ (n + k)) hDpow w
    convert this using 2
    push_cast
    ring

name: CongruenceTheory.card_NZ
statement: theorem card_NZ (m : ℕ) : Fintype.card (NZ m) = m
proof:
:= by
  unfold NZ; rw [Fintype.card_subtype_compl]; simp

name: CongruenceTheory.card_CycleTuple
statement: theorem card_CycleTuple : Fintype.card (CycleTuple m r) = m.descFactorial r
proof:
:= by
  unfold CycleTuple
  rw [Fintype.card_embedding_eq, card_NZ, Fintype.card_fin]

name: CongruenceTheory.card_CycleCompl
statement:
theorem card_CycleCompl (t : CycleTuple m r) (hr : r ≤ m) :
    Fintype.card {x : Fin (m + 1) // CycleCompl m r t x} = m - r
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.card_subtype]
  have hsub : (Finset.univ.filter (CycleCompl m r t)) =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin (m + 1) => x ≠ 0)) \
        (Finset.univ.image (fun i : Fin r => (t i : Fin (m + 1)))) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_image]
    unfold CycleCompl
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hx0, hxt⟩
      refine ⟨hx0, ?_⟩
      rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
      exact hxt i hi
    · rintro ⟨hx0, hxt⟩
      refine ⟨hx0, ?_⟩
      intro i hi
      exact hxt ⟨i, hi⟩
  have himg_subset : (Finset.univ.image (fun i : Fin r => (t i : Fin (m + 1)))) ⊆
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin (m + 1) => x ≠ 0)) := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_image] at hx
    obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    rw [← hi]
    exact (t i).2
  rw [hsub, Finset.card_sdiff, Finset.inter_eq_left.mpr himg_subset]
  rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (fun i j hij => t.injective (Subtype.ext hij))]
  rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hcard0 : (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin (m + 1) => x ≠ 0)).card = m := by
    rw [Finset.filter_ne', Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ 0)]
    simp
  rw [hcard0]

name: CongruenceTheory.cycleList_length
statement: theorem cycleList_length (t : CycleTuple m r) : (cycleList m r t).length = r + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [cycleList]

name: CongruenceTheory.cycleList_nodup
statement: theorem cycleList_nodup (t : CycleTuple m r) : (cycleList m r t).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cycleList, List.nodup_cons, List.mem_ofFn]
  refine ⟨?_, List.nodup_ofFn.mpr (fun i j hij => t.injective (Subtype.ext hij))⟩
  rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
  exact (t i).2 hi

name: CongruenceTheory.cyc_support_subset
statement:
theorem cyc_support_subset (t : CycleTuple m r) :
    (cyc m r t).support ⊆ (cycleList m r t).toFinset
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [Equiv.Perm.mem_support] at hx
  by_contra hxnot
  rw [List.mem_toFinset] at hxnot
  exact hx (List.formPerm_apply_of_notMem hxnot)

name: CongruenceTheory.cyc_disjoint_ofSubtype
statement:
theorem cyc_disjoint_ofSubtype (t : CycleTuple m r) (h : Equiv.Perm {x // CycleCompl m r t x}) :
    Disjoint (cyc m r t) (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Equiv.Perm.disjoint_iff_disjoint_support]
  apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro x hxc hxo
  have hxc' : x ∈ (cycleList m r t).toFinset := cyc_support_subset m r t hxc
  rw [List.mem_toFinset] at hxc'
  obtain ⟨hp, _⟩ := (Equiv.Perm.mem_support_ofSubtype x h).mp hxo
  simp only [cycleList, List.mem_cons, List.mem_ofFn] at hxc'
  rcases hxc' with h0 | ⟨i, hi⟩
  · exact hp.1 h0
  · exact hp.2 i hi

name: CongruenceTheory.cyc_isCycle_of_pos
statement: theorem cyc_isCycle_of_pos (t : CycleTuple m r) (hr : 1 ≤ r) : IsCycle (cyc m r t)
proof:
:=
  List.isCycle_formPerm (cycleList_nodup m r t) (by rw [cycleList_length]; omega)

name: CongruenceTheory.cyc_support_eq
statement:
theorem cyc_support_eq (t : CycleTuple m r) (hr : 1 ≤ r) :
    (cyc m r t).support = (cycleList m r t).toFinset
proof:
:= by
  apply List.support_formPerm_of_nodup _ (cycleList_nodup m r t)
  intro x hx
  have hlen := cycleList_length m r t
  rw [hx] at hlen
  simp at hlen
  omega

name: CongruenceTheory.cyc_apply_zero_ne_zero
statement: theorem cyc_apply_zero_ne_zero (t : CycleTuple m r) (hr : 1 ≤ r) : cyc m r t 0 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsupp : (0 : Fin (m + 1)) ∈ (cyc m r t).support := by
    rw [cyc_support_eq m r t hr]; simp [cycleList]
  exact (Equiv.Perm.mem_support.mp hsupp)

name: CongruenceTheory.cyc_eq_one_of_zero
statement: theorem cyc_eq_one_of_zero (t : CycleTuple m 0) : cyc m 0 t = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold cyc cycleList; simp

name: CongruenceTheory.not_CycleCompl_iff
statement:
theorem not_CycleCompl_iff (t : CycleTuple m r) (x : Fin (m + 1)) :
    ¬ CycleCompl m r t x ↔ (x = 0 ∨ ∃ i, (t i : Fin (m + 1)) = x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold CycleCompl
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases hx0 : x = 0
    · exact Or.inl hx0
    · right
      by_contra hcontra
      push_neg at hcontra
      exact h ⟨hx0, hcontra⟩
  · rintro (rfl | ⟨i, hi⟩) ⟨hx0, hall⟩
    · exact hx0 rfl
    · exact hall i hi

name: CongruenceTheory.mem_support_cyc_iff
statement:
theorem mem_support_cyc_iff (t : CycleTuple m r) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (x : Fin (m + 1)) :
    x ∈ (cyc m r t).support ↔ ¬ CycleCompl m r t x
proof:
:= by
  rw [cyc_support_eq m r t hr, List.mem_toFinset]
  simp only [cycleList, List.mem_cons, List.mem_ofFn]
  rw [not_CycleCompl_iff]

name: CongruenceTheory.gAssemble_cycleType_zero
statement:
theorem gAssemble_cycleType_zero (t : CycleTuple m 0) (h : Equiv.Perm {x // CycleCompl m 0 t x}) :
    (gAssemble m 0 t h).cycleType = h.cycleType
proof:
:= by
  unfold gAssemble
  rw [cyc_eq_one_of_zero m t, one_mul, Equiv.Perm.cycleType_ofSubtype]

name: CongruenceTheory.gAssemble_cycleType_pos
statement:
theorem gAssemble_cycleType_pos (t : CycleTuple m r) (h : Equiv.Perm {x // CycleCompl m r t x})
    (hpos : 1 ≤ r) :
    (gAssemble m r t h).cycleType = {r + 1} + h.cycleType
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj := cyc_disjoint_ofSubtype m r t h
  have hcyc : (cyc m r t).cycleType = {r + 1} := by
    have hic : IsCycle (cyc m r t) := cyc_isCycle_of_pos m r t hpos
    rw [Equiv.Perm.IsCycle.cycleType hic, cyc_support_eq m r t hpos,
      List.toFinset_card_of_nodup (cycleList_nodup m r t), cycleList_length]
  unfold gAssemble
  rw [hdisj.cycleType_mul, hcyc, Equiv.Perm.cycleType_ofSubtype]

name: CongruenceTheory.ci_gAssemble
statement:
theorem ci_gAssemble (hr : r ≤ m) (t : CycleTuple m r) (h : Equiv.Perm {x // CycleCompl m r t x}) :
    ci (gAssemble m r t h) = X (r + 1) * ci h
proof:
:= by
  unfold ci
  rw [show (Fintype.card (Fin (m + 1)) : ℕ) = m + 1 by simp]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos r with h0 | hpos
  · subst h0
    rw [gAssemble_cycleType_zero m t h]
    have hcardcompl : Fintype.card {x : Fin (m + 1) // CycleCompl m 0 t x} = m :=
      card_CycleCompl m 0 t hr
    rw [hcardcompl]
    rw [show m + 1 - h.cycleType.sum = 1 + (m - h.cycleType.sum) by
      have hle : h.cycleType.sum ≤ m := by
        rw [Equiv.Perm.sum_cycleType]
        have := Finset.card_le_univ h.support
        rwa [hcardcompl] at this
      omega]
    rw [pow_add, pow_one]
    ring
  · rw [gAssemble_cycleType_pos m r t h hpos]
    have hcardcompl : Fintype.card {x : Fin (m + 1) // CycleCompl m r t x} = m - r :=
      card_CycleCompl m r t hr
    rw [hcardcompl]
    have hle : h.cycleType.sum ≤ m - r := by
      rw [Equiv.Perm.sum_cycleType]
      have := Finset.card_le_univ h.support
      rwa [hcardcompl] at this
    rw [Multiset.sum_add, Multiset.sum_singleton]
    rw [show m + 1 - (r + 1 + h.cycleType.sum) = (m - r) - h.cycleType.sum by omega]
    rw [Multiset.map_add, Multiset.prod_add, Multiset.map_singleton, Multiset.prod_singleton]
    ring

name: CongruenceTheory.cycleOf_gAssemble
statement:
theorem cycleOf_gAssemble (t : CycleTuple m r) (h : Equiv.Perm {x // CycleCompl m r t x})
    (hr1 : 1 ≤ r) :
    (gAssemble m r t h).cycleOf 0 = cyc m r t
proof:
:= by
  unfold gAssemble
  have hdisj := cyc_disjoint_ofSubtype m r t h
  have hcomm : Commute (cyc m r t) (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype h) := hdisj.commute
  have h0fix : (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype h) 0 = 0 := by
    apply Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem
    simp [CycleCompl]
  rw [Equiv.Perm.cycleOf_mul_of_apply_right_eq_self hcomm 0 h0fix]
  exact Equiv.Perm.IsCycle.cycleOf_eq (cyc_isCycle_of_pos m r t hr1) (cyc_apply_zero_ne_zero m r t hr1)

name: CongruenceTheory.cyc_injective
statement:
theorem cyc_injective (hr1 : 1 ≤ r) (t1 t2 : CycleTuple m r) (heq : cyc m r t1 = cyc m r t2) :
    t1 = t2
proof:
:= by
  have hl1 : 2 ≤ (cycleList m r t1).length := by rw [cycleList_length]; omega
  have hl2 : 2 ≤ (cycleList m r t2).length := by rw [cycleList_length]; omega
  have hget1 : (cycleList m r t1).get ⟨0, by omega⟩ = 0 := by simp [cycleList]
  have hget2 : (cycleList m r t2).get ⟨0, by omega⟩ = 0 := by simp [cycleList]
  have h1 := Equiv.Perm.toList_formPerm_nontrivial (cycleList m r t1) hl1 (cycleList_nodup m r t1)
  have h2 := Equiv.Perm.toList_formPerm_nontrivial (cycleList m r t2) hl2 (cycleList_nodup m r t2)
  rw [hget1] at h1
  rw [hget2] at h2
  have hcl : cycleList m r t1 = cycleList m r t2 := by
    rw [← h1, ← h2]; unfold cyc at heq; rw [heq]
  have hofFn : (fun i => (t1 i : Fin (m + 1))) = (fun i => (t2 i : Fin (m + 1))) := by
    have hc : List.ofFn (fun i => (t1 i : Fin (m + 1))) =
        List.ofFn (fun i => (t2 i : Fin (m + 1))) := by
      simpa [cycleList] using hcl
    exact List.ofFn_inj.mp hc
  apply Function.Embedding.ext
  intro i
  exact Subtype.ext (congrFun hofFn i)

name: CongruenceTheory.gAssemble_injective_pos
statement:
theorem gAssemble_injective_pos (hr1 : 1 ≤ r) (t1 t2 : CycleTuple m r)
    (h1 : Equiv.Perm {x // CycleCompl m r t1 x}) (h2 : Equiv.Perm {x // CycleCompl m r t2 x})
    (heq : gAssemble m r t1 h1 = gAssemble m r t2 h2) :
    ∃ ht : t1 = t2, ht ▸ h1 = h2
proof:
:= by
  have hcyceq : cyc m r t1 = cyc m r t2 := by
    rw [← cycleOf_gAssemble m r t1 h1 hr1, ← cycleOf_gAssemble m r t2 h2 hr1, heq]
  have ht : t1 = t2 := cyc_injective m r hr1 t1 t2 hcyceq
  subst ht
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  simp only [eq_mpr_eq_cast, cast_eq]
  have hofsub : Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype h1 = Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype h2 := by
    have := heq
    unfold gAssemble at this
    exact mul_left_cancel this
  exact Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_injective hofsub

name: CongruenceTheory.invariant_of_fixes_compl
statement:
theorem invariant_of_fixes_compl {α : Type*} {f : Equiv.Perm α} {p : α → Prop}
    (hfix : ∀ x, ¬ p x → f x = x) : ∀ x, p (f x) ↔ p x
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  by_cases hpx : p x
  · constructor
    · intro _; exact hpx
    · intro _
      by_contra hpfx
      have h1 : f (f x) = f x := hfix (f x) hpfx
      have h3 : x = f x := f.injective h1.symm
      rw [← h3] at hpfx
      exact hpfx hpx
  · rw [hfix x hpx]

name: CongruenceTheory.ofSubtype_subtypePerm_eq_self
statement:
theorem ofSubtype_subtypePerm_eq_self {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {p : α → Prop} [DecidablePred p]
    (f : Equiv.Perm α) (hf : ∀ x, p (f x) ↔ p x) (hsupp : ∀ x, ¬ p x → f x = x) :
    Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (f.subtypePerm hf) = f
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  by_cases hx : p x
  · rw [Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_mem _ hx, Equiv.Perm.subtypePerm_apply]
  · rw [Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem _ hx, hsupp x hx]

name: CongruenceTheory.exists_decomp_zero
statement:
theorem exists_decomp_zero (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin (m + 1))) (hg0 : g 0 = 0) :
    ∃ (t : CycleTuple m 0) (h : Equiv.Perm {x // CycleCompl m 0 t x}), gAssemble m 0 t h = g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set t : CycleTuple m 0 := ⟨Fin.elim0, fun {a} _ _ => a.elim0⟩ with ht_def
  have htriv : ∀ x, CycleCompl m 0 t x ↔ x ≠ 0 := by
    intro x
    unfold CycleCompl
    simp
  have hfix : ∀ x, ¬ CycleCompl m 0 t x → g x = x := by
    intro x hx
    rw [htriv] at hx
    simp only [ne_eq, not_not] at hx
    rw [hx, hg0]
  have hinv : ∀ x, CycleCompl m 0 t (g x) ↔ CycleCompl m 0 t x := by
    intro x
    rw [htriv, htriv]
    constructor
    · intro h hcontra
      rw [hcontra, hg0] at h
      exact h rfl
    · intro h hcontra
      apply h
      have heq : g x = g 0 := by rw [hcontra, hg0]
      exact g.injective heq
  refine ⟨t, g.subtypePerm hinv, ?_⟩
  unfold gAssemble
  rw [cyc_eq_one_of_zero m t, one_mul]
  exact ofSubtype_subtypePerm_eq_self g hinv hfix

name: CongruenceTheory.gAssemble_injective_zero
statement:
theorem gAssemble_injective_zero (t1 t2 : CycleTuple m 0)
    (h1 : Equiv.Perm {x // CycleCompl m 0 t1 x}) (h2 : Equiv.Perm {x // CycleCompl m 0 t2 x})
    (heq : gAssemble m 0 t1 h1 = gAssemble m 0 t2 h2) :
    ∃ ht : t1 = t2, ht ▸ h1 = h2
proof:
:= by
  have ht : t1 = t2 := Subsingleton.elim t1 t2
  subst ht
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  simp only [eq_mpr_eq_cast, cast_eq]
  have hofsub : Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype h1 = Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype h2 := by
    unfold gAssemble at heq
    exact mul_left_cancel heq
  exact Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_injective hofsub

name: CongruenceTheory.exists_decomp_pos
statement:
theorem exists_decomp_pos (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin (m + 1))) (hr1 : 1 ≤ r)
    (hcard : (g.cycleOf 0).support.card = r + 1) :
    ∃ (t : CycleTuple m r) (h : Equiv.Perm {x // CycleCompl m r t x}), gAssemble m r t h = g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set l := g.toList 0 with hl_def
  have hlen : l.length = r + 1 := by rw [hl_def, Equiv.Perm.length_toList, hcard]
  have hnodup : l.Nodup := Equiv.Perm.nodup_toList g 0
  have hg0 : (0 : Fin (m + 1)) ∈ g.support := by
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mem_support]
    intro hz
    rw [(Equiv.Perm.cycleOf_eq_one_iff g).mpr hz] at hcard
    simp at hcard
  have hhead : l[0]'(by omega) = 0 := Equiv.Perm.toList_getElem_zero g 0 hg0
  have htne : ∀ i : Fin r, l[i.1 + 1]'(by omega) ≠ 0 := by
    intro i hcontra
    have heq := hnodup.getElem_inj_iff (i := 0) (hi := by omega) (j := i.1 + 1) (hj := by omega)
    rw [hhead, hcontra] at heq
    have := heq.mp rfl
    omega
  set t : CycleTuple m r :=
    ⟨fun i => ⟨l[i.1 + 1]'(by omega), htne i⟩, by
      intro i j hij
      have hval : l[i.1 + 1]'(by omega) = l[j.1 + 1]'(by omega) := congrArg Subtype.val hij
      have heq := (hnodup.getElem_inj_iff (i := i.1 + 1) (hi := by omega)
        (j := j.1 + 1) (hj := by omega)).mp hval
      exact Fin.ext (by omega)⟩ with ht_def
  have hlist_eq : cycleList m r t = l := by
    apply List.ext_getElem
    · rw [cycleList_length, hlen]
    · intro i h1 h2
      match i with
      | 0 => simpa [cycleList] using hhead.symm
      | (i + 1) =>
        simp only [cycleList] at h1 h2 ⊢
        rw [List.getElem_cons_succ, List.getElem_ofFn]
        rfl
  have hcyc_eq : cyc m r t = g.cycleOf 0 := by
    unfold cyc; rw [hlist_eq, hl_def, Equiv.Perm.formPerm_toList]
  set f := g * (g.cycleOf 0)⁻¹ with hf_def
  have hdisj0 : Disjoint (g * (g.cycleOf 0)⁻¹) (g.cycleOf 0) := by
    apply Equiv.Perm.disjoint_mul_inv_of_mem_cycleFactorsFinset
    rw [Equiv.Perm.cycleOf_mem_cycleFactorsFinset_iff]
    exact hg0
  have hdisj : Disjoint f (cyc m r t) := by rw [hf_def, hcyc_eq]; exact hdisj0
  have hfix : ∀ x, ¬ CycleCompl m r t x → f x = x := by
    intro x hx
    have hxsupp : (cyc m r t) x ≠ x :=
      Equiv.Perm.mem_support.mp ((mem_support_cyc_iff m r t hr1 x).mpr hx)
    rcases hdisj x with h1 | h2
    · exact h1
    · exact absurd h2 hxsupp
  have hinv := invariant_of_fixes_compl hfix
  refine ⟨t, f.subtypePerm hinv, ?_⟩
  have hofsub : Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (f.subtypePerm hinv) = f :=
    ofSubtype_subtypePerm_eq_self f hinv hfix
  unfold gAssemble
  rw [hofsub, hcyc_eq, hf_def]
  have hcomm0 : Commute (g.cycleOf 0) (g * (g.cycleOf 0)⁻¹) := hdisj0.symm.commute
  calc g.cycleOf 0 * (g * (g.cycleOf 0)⁻¹)
      = (g * (g.cycleOf 0)⁻¹) * g.cycleOf 0 := hcomm0
    _ = g * ((g.cycleOf 0)⁻¹ * g.cycleOf 0) := by rw [mul_assoc]
    _ = g := by simp

name: CongruenceTheory.rCard_gAssemble
statement:
theorem rCard_gAssemble (t : CycleTuple m r) (h : Equiv.Perm {x // CycleCompl m r t x}) :
    ((gAssemble m r t h).cycleOf 0).support.card = if r = 0 then 0 else r + 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos r with h0 | hpos
  · subst h0
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    have hg0 : (gAssemble m 0 t h) 0 = 0 := by
      unfold gAssemble
      rw [cyc_eq_one_of_zero m t, one_mul]
      apply Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem
      simp [CycleCompl]
    rw [(Equiv.Perm.cycleOf_eq_one_iff _).mpr hg0]
    simp
  · rw [if_neg (by omega), cycleOf_gAssemble m r t h hpos, cyc_support_eq m r t hpos,
      List.toFinset_card_of_nodup (cycleList_nodup m r t), cycleList_length]

name: CongruenceTheory.r_eq_of_gAssemble_eq
statement:
theorem r_eq_of_gAssemble_eq (t1 : CycleTuple m r) (t2 : CycleTuple m r')
    (h1 : Equiv.Perm {x // CycleCompl m r t1 x}) (h2 : Equiv.Perm {x // CycleCompl m r' t2 x})
    (heq : gAssemble m r t1 h1 = gAssemble m r' t2 h2) : r = r'
proof:
:= by
  have e1 := rCard_gAssemble m r t1 h1
  have e2 := rCard_gAssemble m r' t2 h2
  rw [heq] at e1
  rw [e1] at e2
  by_cases hr : r = 0 <;> by_cases hr' : r' = 0 <;> simp [hr, hr'] at e2 <;> omega

name: CongruenceTheory.cycleType_permCongr
statement:
theorem cycleType_permCongr {β γ : Type*} [Fintype β] [Fintype γ] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (e : β ≃ γ) (g : Equiv.Perm β) : (e.permCongr g).cycleType = g.cycleType
proof:
:= by
  set f : β ≃ Subtype (fun _ : γ => True) :=
    e.trans (Equiv.subtypeUnivEquiv fun _ => trivial).symm with hf
  have hext : g.extendDomain f = e.permCongr g := by
    ext x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.extendDomain_apply_subtype g f trivial]
    simp [hf, Equiv.permCongr_apply]
  rw [← hext, Equiv.Perm.cycleType_extendDomain]

name: CongruenceTheory.ci_permCongr
statement:
theorem ci_permCongr {β γ : Type*} [Fintype β] [Fintype γ] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (e : β ≃ γ) (g : Equiv.Perm β) : ci (e.permCongr g) = ci g
proof:
:= by
  unfold ci
  rw [cycleType_permCongr e g, Fintype.card_congr e.symm]

name: CongruenceTheory.Cperm_eq_sum_of_card_eq
statement:
theorem Cperm_eq_sum_of_card_eq {β : Type*} [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] {n : ℕ}
    (hβ : Fintype.card β = n) : Cperm n = ∑ g : Equiv.Perm β, ci g
proof:
:= by
  subst hβ
  have e : β ≃ Fin (Fintype.card β) := Fintype.equivFin β
  unfold Cperm
  exact (Fintype.sum_equiv e.permCongr (fun h : Equiv.Perm β => ci h)
    (fun g : Equiv.Perm (Fin (Fintype.card β)) => ci g)
    (fun h => (ci_permCongr e h).symm)).symm

name: CongruenceTheory.fall_eq_descFactorial_nat
statement:
theorem fall_eq_descFactorial_nat (n s : ℕ) (hs : s ≤ n) :
    (fall n s : ℤ) = (n.descFactorial s : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fall, Nat.descFactorial_eq_prod_range]
  push_cast
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have his : i < s := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
  have : i ≤ n := by omega
  omega

name: CongruenceTheory.Cperm_succ_alt
statement:
theorem Cperm_succ_alt (m : ℕ) :
    Cperm (m + 1) =
      ∑ s ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (fall m s : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) * (X (s + 1) * Cperm (m - s))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hCperm : Cperm (m + 1) = ∑ g : Equiv.Perm (Fin (m + 1)), ci g :=
    Cperm_eq_sum_of_card_eq (by simp)
  rw [hCperm]
  have hbij : ∑ g : Equiv.Perm (Fin (m + 1)), ci g =
      ∑ x : (Σ i : Fin (m + 1), Σ t : CycleTuple m i.1, Equiv.Perm {y // CycleCompl m i.1 t y}),
        ci (gAssemble m x.1.1 x.2.1 x.2.2) := by
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_bij (fun x (_ : x ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Σ i : Fin (m + 1),
      Σ t : CycleTuple m i.1, Equiv.Perm {y // CycleCompl m i.1 t y}))) =>
      gAssemble m x.1.1 x.2.1 x.2.2)
    · intro a _; exact Finset.mem_univ _
    · rintro ⟨⟨r1, hr1m⟩, t1, h1⟩ _ ⟨⟨r2, hr2m⟩, t2, h2⟩ _ heq
      simp only at heq
      have hreq : r1 = r2 := r_eq_of_gAssemble_eq m r1 t1 t2 h1 h2 heq
      subst hreq
      by_cases hr0 : r1 = 0
      · subst hr0
        obtain ⟨ht, hh⟩ := gAssemble_injective_zero m t1 t2 h1 h2 heq
        subst ht
        simp only [eq_mpr_eq_cast, cast_eq] at hh
        subst hh
        rfl
      · have hrpos : 1 ≤ r1 := by omega
        obtain ⟨ht, hh⟩ := gAssemble_injective_pos m r1 hrpos t1 t2 h1 h2 heq
        subst ht
        simp only [eq_mpr_eq_cast, cast_eq] at hh
        subst hh
        rfl
    · intro g _
      by_cases hg0 : g 0 = 0
      · obtain ⟨t, h, hgh⟩ := exists_decomp_zero m g hg0
        refine ⟨⟨⟨0, by omega⟩, t, h⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
        exact hgh
      · have hg0supp : (0 : Fin (m + 1)) ∈ g.support := Equiv.Perm.mem_support.mpr hg0
        set r := (g.cycleOf 0).support.card - 1 with hr_def
        have hcardge : 2 ≤ (g.cycleOf 0).support.card :=
          Equiv.Perm.two_le_length_toList_iff_mem_support.mpr hg0supp |>.trans_eq
            (by rw [Equiv.Perm.length_toList])
        have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := by omega
        have hcard : (g.cycleOf 0).support.card = r + 1 := by omega
        have hrm : r < m + 1 := by
          have := Finset.card_le_univ (g.cycleOf 0).support
          simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at this
          omega
        obtain ⟨t, h, hgh⟩ := exists_decomp_pos m r g hr1 hcard
        refine ⟨⟨⟨r, hrm⟩, t, h⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
        exact hgh
    · intro a _
      rfl
  rw [hbij, Fintype.sum_sigma]
  rw [show (∑ i : Fin (m + 1), ∑ y : (Σ t : CycleTuple m i.1,
